oper_nm: Consolidation of FIS Empresa Social S.A.

The reimbursable financing component (IDB: US$500,000, local US$2,000,000) will be allocated to finance the purchase of inventory, equipment, fixed assets, and other productive assets for 12,500 microentrepreneurs in the southern suburbs of Buenos Aires, i.e. owners of businesses that have been operating for at least one year, who will receive microcredits from FIS under the credit regulations contained in the technical file. Approximately 60% of beneficiaries who receive financing will be women, and at least 20% will be dynamic microentrepreneurs with differentiated patterns of growth in sales, profits, or employment. Credit will be extended for between US$140 and US$650 using a group or individual lending methodology. FIS will supplement the reimbursable financing component with US$2 million in funds from other sources.

Description of irrigation water management, including: 1.1 Provincial irrigation area analysis, considering: i) public and private irrigation systems, water supply and demand evaluation for surface and underground systems, water balances, y directory plans for water resources; ii) productive capacity analysis for the irrigation areas and their potential economic development, technical assistance schedule, production transformation enablers and market access; business plans for irrigation areas; iii) evaluation of the main environmental issues regarding the development of irrigation areas and its control mechanisms. 1.2 Review the legislation concerning irrigation water: analyze provincial legislature, including the impact on irrigation system development, opening of new areas, user conflict resolution mechanisms, resource allocation mechanisms, and private sector investment incentives. 1.3 Institutional and user organizations evaluation: including i) analysis of federal and provincial institutions responsible for irrigation and coordination among other water uses, all within the basin framework; ii) organizations of irrigation users, strengthening needs and coordination among different levels; iii) analysis of the human resources for operation and maintenance, management, and research; iv) evaluation of cost recovery mechanisms, establishment of tariffs and development of water markets in order to promote a more efficient resource use. 2. Expected results: i) A document that describes the irrigation sector and includes an analysis of irrigation areas by province, a review and analysis of the legal framework at the federal and provincial level, an institutional evaluation at the federal and provincial level, and an evaluation of the provincial user organizations. ii) An integrated irrigation management strategy with consensual guidelines among public and private participants regarding legal, institutional, organizational, technical, economical, and environmental issues that will guide the behavior and investments in the sector. objtv: The objective is to support Argentina's planning, operation, and investments in the power sector, to support short-term economic recovery and to enable energy resilience.

oper_nm: Innovative Financial instruments for Biodiversity Conservation and Climate Action
objtv: The objective is to develop a strategy for Argentina based on debt management instruments for climate action and nature conservation.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation of the Neighborhood Improvement Program in the inclusion of principles of adaptation to climate change and reduction of the vulnerability profile
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation is to provide support for the preparation of the Neighborhood Improvement and Transformative Urban Interventions Program (PROMEBA V). The TC will support aspects related to the effectiveness of PROMEBA V in the areas of resilience and mitigation of climate change, gender equality, support for the economic integration of residential communities and the migrant population to host communities. In addition, this TC will generate knowledge and capacities to address the impact of climate change on migration and risk mitigation in informal settlements. To this end, the technical and management capacities of the Ministry of Territorial Development and Habitat (MDTyH), the executing agency responsible for this operation, will be strengthened.

oper_nm: Support for the Planning and Management of Water Resources with a NEXO and Water Security approach
objtv: The main objective of this TC is to support government agencies by promoting an initiative to strengthen institutional capacities focused on water resources management, including project-driven implementation processes and technology transfer of the IDB's HydroBID model suite focused on investment programs.

oper_nm: Support for the Strengthening of National Securities Commission (CNV) of Argentina
objtv: Support the institutional strengthening of the National Securities Commission (CNV), in order to deepen and facilitate access to the Argentine capital market.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation of public investments for the reactivation of the agri-food sector in Argentina
objtv: This technical cooperation has the objective of supporting the Government of Argentina (GoA) in the preparation of investments linked to food chains, in the areas of technological modernization, productivity improvement, environmental sustainability, response to climate change, international trade and strategy for the use of natural resources.

oper_nm: Agricultural public policies and monitoring of agro-environmental indicators.
objtv: To support the preparation of agricultural public policies proposals and facilitate the monitoring of agro-environmental indicators (waste, agrochemicals, emissions, deforestation, biodiversity) in Argentina.

oper_nm: Gender and Diversity Mainstreaming in the Implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development in Argentina.
objtv: Strengthen the capacities, through the Consejo Nacional de Coordinación de Políticas Sociales (CNCPS), of provinces and municipalities of Argentina to mainstream the gender and diversity in the implementation of the 2030 Agenda. For this, the project will work in partnership with the corresponding subnational governments, as well as with actors from civil society and the private business sector.

oper_nm: Support for the internationalization of High Value Added sectors
objtv: Support in the design and execution of the internationalization of High Value Added Progam. Specifically, focus will be on augmenting the export potential of Global Digital Services.

oper_nm: Institutional Strengthening of the National Public Investment System (SNIP) Stage II
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Support the institutional strengthening of the DNIP to improve the efficiency of public investment in Argentina, through the review and improvement of evaluation techniques and tools, strengthening jurisdictional relationships and improving information systems that contribute to evaluation processes and decision making. The specific objectives are: a) strengthening the operational management at the national and jurisdictional levels of the SNIP and BAPIN; b) Institutional support for information management and the optimization and implementation of computer systems and tools that assist management improvements.

oper_nm: Strengthening institutions in the mining sector in Argentina
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: The objective of the project is to strengthen the governance of the Argentine mining sector to optimize the sector's contribution to sustainable development. Within the framework of the national Green Productive Development program promoted by the National Ministry of Productive Development and in accordance with national efforts promoted through the National Mining Secretariat and the Federal Mining Council (COFEMIN), the project will support activities aimed at meeting three main goals: (i) strengthen the institutional capacities of public entities responsible for sectoral management at the national and provincial levels; (ii) improve procedures, processes, platforms and instruments for inter-institutional, inter-jurisdictional coordination and multi-stakeholder participation; and (iii) promote the dissemination and exchange of knowledge and information on best sectoral practices at the provincial, national and international levels.

oper_nm: Sustainable Mobility and Electromobility in Argentina
subsector_nm: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (BUS / TRAIN / CABLE). INFRASTRUCTURE AND EQUIPMENT
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the National Government and Subnational Governments of Argentina in the planning, design and implementation of sustainable urban transport systems, promoting the adoption of international best practices for improving the affordability, quality and accessibility of low and zero emissions public transportation, while promoting the transversalization of the gender perspective in urban transport

oper_nm: Support for the Program for the Strengthening and Integration of Health Networks in the Province of Buenos Aires - PROFIR II
objtv: The General Development Objective of the Technical Cooperation is to support the implementation of the loan operation "Program for the Strengthening and Integration of Health Networks of the Province of Buenos Aires - PROFIR II". The Specific Development Objective of the operation is to strengthen, in the context of operation AR-L1340, the state capacities to improve the effectiveness and integration of health services of different complexity and to accompany the implementation while safeguarding the environment and the social context of the community.

oper_nm: Support to the creation of an Argentine Artificial Intelligence Center
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to support the institutional strengthening of the Argentinian government, through its Science, Technology and Innovation Ministry, generating the knowledge to jump start a new artificial intelligence center that follows global good practices.

oper_nm: Support for the Federal Plan for the Reconstruction and Integration of the Argentine Health System – AMPLIAR SALUD
objtv: The General Development Objective of the Technical Cooperation is to support the implementation of the credit operation "Support Program for the Federal Plan for the Reconstruction and Integration of the Argentine Health System – AMPLIAR SALUD" (AR-L1358). The Specific Development Objective of this TC is to strengthen the national and subnational level competencies to manage the reorganization and prioritization of health care lines, through the development of diagnosis and the strengthening of competencies to implement a Management strategy of the Change that the implementation of a Health Benefits Plan will imply.

oper_nm: Support to the Program for Public Policies for Sustainable and Resilient Growth in Argentina
objtv: This TC objective is to support Argentina in the in the implementation of its National Determined Contribution (NDC) and design of its long term decarbonization strategy by 2050 (LTS) with the following specific objectives: (i) facilitate engagement with national stakeholders to understand how resilient and low carbon actions can help advance sectoral and macroeconomic development goals to improve the buy-in from national stakeholders; (ii) assess options that allow improving resilience and reaching net-zero emissions inform the design of sectoral pathways to net-zero emission and prepare analytical inputs and indicators, particularly in key sectors such as agriculture/forestry, financial market, transport and energy, urban development ; (iii) map existing relevant policies and create a policy roadmap to inform relevant decisionmakers to implement the NDC and LTS and feed the policy based loan (AR-L1351) and (iv) enhance the domestic analytical capacity to deliver the NDC and LTS objectives and share lessons learnt.

oper_nm: Support for the design of strategies for the care of aging and care of the adult population in Argentina
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to provide technical support to strengthen the care capacity and performance of the human resources that work in the care of the affiliates of the National Institute of Social Services for Retirees and Pensioners of Argentina (PAMI, including staff specialized in geriatrics, managers of health centers and socio-health personnel dedicated to the care of elderly people with some degree of dependency.

oper_nm: Care integration in frail older adults
objtv: The project aims to improve the quality of life of dependent older adults by integrating into a web-based platform a knowledge base, training and services that provides resources for themselves, their caregivers and health professionals, and other relevant older adult stakeholders. Investment in this innovation will contribute to the triple aim of clinical effectiveness, care cost reduction and patient/client satisfaction.

oper_nm: Support for the elaboration of the Agricultural Strategic Plan for Argentina 2030
objtv: To support the elaboration of the Agrobioindustrial Strategic Plan 2022-2035, which will replace the previous Participatory and Federal Agrifood and Agroindustrial Strategic Plan 2010-2020, including updated perspectives of productivity, competitiveness and environmental and social sustainability of the agricultural sector in Argentina during the next decade.

oper_nm: Support for the implementation of the Multisectoral Program to Strengthen the Public Investment Cycle
objtv: The objective of this TC is to strengthen the institutional capacities of the Ministry of Public Works (MOP) for the monitoring and governance of public investment projects. To this end, it will support with technical designs and specific plans for the implementation of the investments in digital transformation provided for in the program to improve the management of the public infrastructure project cycle, as well as the implementation of a solid governance scheme for the successful implementation of the digital transformation plan.

oper_nm: Analysis of the Regulation and Rehabilitation of the Federal Justice Infrastructure
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to provide technical assistance to support innovations in the justice administration system with federal impact, particularly to strengthen the implementation of the Federal Criminal Procedure Code (CPPF).

oper_nm: Emergency support due to forest fires in northern Argentina
objtv: The objective of the TC is to support the efforts of the national government of Argentina to provide humanitarian assistance to people affected by forest fires in the north of the country.

oper_nm: Digitalization, New Sources Of Income And Resilience Of Neighborhood Shops
objtv: The objective of the project is to offer kiosks and neighborhood stores a free online platform (Platform) that allows them to start their digitalization process, managing their business digitally, receiving electronic payments and being able to offer different digital services to the community, such as sending and receiving payments, paying bills and recharging cell phones or transportation cards.

oper_nm: Improvement of the performance of operators of solid waste management systems through the development of a GIRSU-Rating tool, the application of digital technologies and good practices.
objtv: The general objective of the cooperation is to develop and pilot tools for the improvement of performance management that, based on the application of information technologies and digitization, allow strengthening the capacities and improving the performance of service providers of performance management. solid waste in Argentina, in order to improve the operational and financial sustainability of the projects previously financed by the Bank in the waste sector (AR-L1025 and AR-L1151) and to be financed by the CCLIP line (AR-O0018) and the first individual operation of this line (AR-L1342) recently approved.

oper_nm: Support for Increasing Resilience for Extreme Hydroclimatic Events in Argentina
objtv: This technical cooperation (TC) will support the Ministry of Public Works, the Secretariat of Infrastructure and Water Policies and the National Water Agency, within the framework of CCLIP AR-O0019, promoting a program to improve institutional capacities focused on the management of water resources, specifically support to improve response capacity to flood events. This TC will assist the beneficiary to strengthen capacities in responding to flood events by (i) assessing institutional and technical gaps; (ii) analyzing the vulnerability to floods in the prioritized urban areas and/or basins in Argentina; and (iii) providing technical training on flooding assessment and modeling tool.

oper_nm: Fiscal Policy for Climate Change: Support to the Ministry of Economy of Argentina
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Support the Ministry of Economy in integrating climate action into its policy and fiscal management. To achieve this objective, this TC will finance three types of actions: (i) development of a framework for financial transparency and fiscal management for climate change; (ii) support for the implementation of green fiscal management instruments and methodologies; and (iii) knowledge dissemination and exchange of good practices.

oper_nm: Support for the strengthening of subnational governments for MSMEs' access to sustainable financing
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to support the Ministry of Economy of the Nation (MECON) in strengthening the capacities of subnational governments of the Argentine Republic to promote access to sustainable financing for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).

oper_nm: Economic resilience of the indigenous and farming communities of the Calchaquíes Valleys - Province of Tucumán
objtv: Strengthen the economic resilience of indigenous and peasant organizations in the Calchaquí Valley of Tucumán based on the development of a territorial productive model based on social and technological innovation and nature-based productions.

oper_nm: Compensations for water savings in agriculture using digital tools: pilots in Argentina
objtv: The objective is to test the use of incentives to promote the adoption of practices to increase water efficiency of small and medium farmers in basins with water scarcity, through the use of digital tools.

oper_nm: Support for the implementation of the Program to Strengthen Educational Trajectories in the Province of Buenos Aires
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the implementation of the Program for the Strengthening of Educational Trajectories in the Province of Buenos Aires (AR-L1367). As specific objectives, the TC aims to strengthen the Educational Information and Management System (SIGED) of the PBA, and to support the development and implementation of an IT solution for the registration and monitoring of the Program for the Promotion and Strengthening of Socio-Educational and Community Centers (CSC) in Popular Neighborhoods (BP), contributing to achieve the specific objective of AR-L1367 which is "to improve access to educational opportunities for children, adolescents and youth in contexts of vulnerability".

oper_nm: Support for the territorial survey of the integral management of urban solid waste in the Province of Buenos Aires
objtv: The main objective of the TC is to support the strengthening of capacities in the Integrated Management of Urban Solid Waste in the Province of Buenos Aires.

oper_nm: Support for the policy of extending the school day in Argentina
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to design a ten-year strategic plan that will allow all state-run primary schools in Argentina to have a full school day. As specific objectives, the TC seeks to: (i) prepare a diagnosis to identify the infrastructure problems that limit the extension of the school day beyond 25 hours per week; (ii) prepare a comprehensive plan that considers the requirements of school infrastructure (including demographic and urban aspects), teaching staff and school food services at the jurisdictional level.

oper_nm: Support for the strengthening of the National Road Safety Agency
objtv: The objective of this TC is to contribute to the improvement of road safety in intermediate cities of Argentina, through the elaboration of strategic road safety plans and the implementation of low-cost and high-impact interventions in prioritized municipalities.

oper_nm: Support for employment activation
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to contribute to the improvement of the functioning of the labor market, through analysis, studies and public policy proposals referring to the different key aspects that impact or condition the labor market. Topics of identification and activation of jobs and quality jobs are included vis-à-vis the activation of people, labor costs and subsidies for informality, among others. The expected result is a set of public policy proposals aimed at energizing and improving the labor market that are incorporated into the government agenda.

oper_nm: Support for the development of Argentina's integrated care system
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to develop analytical knowledge and management tools for the implementation of Argentina's integrated care system. As specific objectives, the TC seeks to: (i) support the elaboration of a scale for access to care services; (ii) strengthen the functionalities of the Federal Care Map; and, (iii) develop a pilot test for the use of telecare in care services.

oper_nm: Water Resources management adaptation to climate change in Argentina
objtv: The aim of this TC is improving the water resources management adaptation to climate change. An overall framework is proposed including a social and gender focus with the objective of identifying structural and non-structural measures. Also, enhance the quality and quantity of information related to the international agreements is proposed with the aim of improving the climate performance indicators (KPI) to reach advantageous financial opportunities for the country.

oper_nm: Mining and Territorial Development: support for the updating and implementation of the Urban and Territorial Strategic Plan of the Municipality of Perito Moreno, Province of Santa Cruz
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: The objective of this project is to promote socioeconomic development based on natural resources in Argentine Patagonia, based on synergies between the public sector, the private sector and society. To this end, and in order to contribute to the implementation of the Urban and Territorial Strategic Plan of Perito Moreno, it will support specific activities to (i) promote local and regional economic diversification based on the formulation of projects for sustainable economic development, and (ii) strengthen municipal management capacities by supporting administrative modernization and improving the skills of civil servants.

oper_nm: Digital Connectivity Plan for the Development of Competitiveness in Argentina
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the "Program for the Development of the Federal Optic Network" (AR-L1333) and design a Digital Connectivity Plan for the development of competitiveness in Argentina.

oper_nm: Design and execution of strategic transport projects in Argentina
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the National Government of Argentina (GdA) in the preparation and implementation of transport infrastructure projects, through the development of diagnostic studies, pre-feasibility (technical, economic, legal and socio-environmental) and the implementation of institutional strengthening activities for the execution of the active portfolio of transportation infrastructure projects.

oper_nm: Support to the Federal Transmission Plan and the decarbonization of the energy sector
subsector_nm: ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND RENEWABLE ENERGY IN END USE
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation is to support the Government of Argentina (GdA) in the execution of the Federal Electricity Transportation Program (PFTEE) to ensure compliance with the established goals. This will be achieved through monitoring and support for the executing agency to ensure that the projects financed by the Bank and the different co-financiers of the program are executed correctly, achieve the expected results, and are sustainable. The specific objectives are: (i) contribute to the execution of operation AR-L1354 in fiduciary, environmental, social, and technical matters; (ii) contribute to the preparation of the second operation of CCLIP AR-0OO20; (iii) support the implementation of gender action plans.

oper_nm: Support to the Productive and Export Development Program of the Province of Salta
objtv: The general objective of the technical cooperation is to support the design and beginning of execution of the Productive and Export Development Program of the Province of Salta to support its productive matrix diversification and participation in regional and global value chains.

oper_nm: Support in strengthening the capacities of CONAE to foster innovation based on satellite data
objtv: Support the National Commission on Space Activities of Argentina (CONAE) in strengthening its capacities to promote data-driven innovation based on the data produced by the SAOCOM satellite series, through improvements in data request prioritization mechanisms and the reduction of transaction costs in data access.

oper_nm: Support for the trade facilitation and internationalization agenda of Argentina
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to support the execution of the Implementation Program of the Argentine Foreign Trade Single Window Regime (AR-L1251), and the carrying out of two reverse trade missions. In particular, the TC seeks to support the Program Execution Unit by hiring individual consultants and firms.

oper_nm: Strengthening of the National Registry of Popular Neighborhoods (RENABAP) through information and management technologies and its integration with other existing systems
objtv: This TC will strengthen the institutional capacity of the Ministry of Social Development (MDS, for its acronym in Spanish) by enhancing and improving the National Registry of Popular Neighborhoods (RENABAP, for its acronym in Spanish) through: (i) the inclusion of information and management technologies to detect new informal settlements or changes in existing ones, using Artificial Intelligence (AI); and (ii) the integration of RENABAP with existing climate change prevention and mitigation systems and projects.

oper_nm: Care integration for fragile older adults
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to improve the quality of care for dependent older adults, as well as the medical management of the situation of frailty and multimorbidity often associated with dependency. The specific objective is to disseminate knowledge on the care of dependent older adults through a web platform that integrates a knowledge base, training modules and software to support clinical decision making. There is no free and open access to a clinical decision support system (CDSS) in the region. Given the shortage of geriatric experts in the region for specialized consultations, this software has the potential to be disruptive, expanding the possibility of problem solving from the first level of care.

oper_nm: Project-based learning and simulations for teachers' training in Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET)
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to design, implement and evaluate a teachers' training training model based on project based learning (PBL) approach  and the use of simulations to promote meaningful learning related to Industry 4.0 among students of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires (CABA) and the Province of Buenos Aires (PBA).

oper_nm: Strengthening the Productivity of the Fruit and Vegetable Sector while Respecting the Environment and Human Health
objtv: The objective of the project is promote a reduction in the use of agrochemicals by small and medium fruit and vegetable producers through the development of alternative technologies based on RNA and the training of producers.

oper_nm: Transition to Regenerative Agriculture to Reduce Environmental Impact
objtv: The project proposes to promote the transition to regenerative agriculture in small farmers in Argentina, through a systemic approach to the main constraints that currently prevent its adoption: awareness, training, incentives and financing.

oper_nm: Disaster and climate risk management in Argentina
objtv: The objective of the TC is to strengthen the capacities of the Government of Argentina (GoAR) to manage disaster risk management through the diagnosis, technical knowledge transfer and design of priority public investment projects, in accordance with the country's recently enacted Disaster Risk Management (DRM) law: National System for Integrated Disaster Risk Management and Civil Protection (SINAGIR, Law 27.287).

oper_nm: Expanding access to the voluntary carbon market
objtv: The objective of this prototype is to catalyze investment in environmental impact projects, piloting a solution that enables the optimization of individual access to the carbon credit market to offset their environmental footprint.

oper_nm: Matriarca: an Innovation Platform for the Internationalization of Handicrafts Made by Indigenous Women of the Argentine Gran Chaco
objtv: The proposed solution aims to boost the creative industry in the rural areas of Gran Chaco Argentino, establish a solid structure and foster innovation in the existing handicraft value chain, with the aim of achieving a significant impact on the lives of indigenous women in the Gran Chaco and ensure their participation in the benefits of technology, commerce, and tourism, trade, and tourism.

oper_nm: Smart spending. Improving efficiency in educational investment
objtv: The objective of this Non-Reimbursable Technical Cooperation (CT) is to support the National Government and/or the Provincial Governments of Argentina in rationalizing and strengthening the educational financing system. This support aims to: (i) improve the efficiency of resource allocation, (ii) enhance the quality of expenditures, and (iii) sustain educational investment.

oper_nm: EXPLEARN Facility: More time at school
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the extension of the school day at the secondary level in the Argentine provinces of Mendoza and Misiones. The specific objectives are: (i) to support the implementation of the Secondary School Transformation Policy in the Province of Misiones by creating interdisciplinary clubs for students, training teacher multipliers, designing postgraduate courses, and providing pedagogical advice to management teams, with the aim of maximizing the use of additional time in the school day and strengthening vulnerable educational trajectories; and (ii) to support the Comprehensive Improvement Plan for Secondary Education in the Province of Mendoza through a proposal to extend the school day in disadvantaged areas of Greater Mendoza, with greater coordination between education and work.

oper_nm: Emergency support due to floodings in Misiones Province
objtv: The objective of the CTE is to support the efforts of Misiones province to mitigate the impact of the hydrologic emergency on the population and address the resulting needs linked to humanitarian aid.

oper_nm: Regulatory improvement for economic competitiveness
objtv: The objective is to contribute to the reduction of transaction and regulatory compliance costs that citizens and companies in Argentina must face, through institutional reforms that contribute to a more efficient business environment.

oper_nm: Skill development and certifications for the construction sector
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to generate evidence for public policy on human capital and employment, in order to support the construction sector in the development of skills for work and in providing certifications that improve the employability of its workforce.

oper_nm: Support for sustainable agricultural development, with emphasis on agricultural innovation and biodiversity
objtv: Support the mainstreaming of the sustainability and biodiversity agenda in public policies and investment loans in the Argentine agricultural sector.

oper_nm: Support for the Strengthening of the Argentine Mining Sector - Phase 2: Development in Mining Regions
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: Promote socioeconomic development and diversification of productive activities in the department of Iglesia, Province of San Juan, based on synergies between the public sector, the private sector and society. To this end, specific activities will be supported to: (i) contribute to the updating, operationalization and governance of the Strategic Plan for Local Development of Iglesia (ii) promote local economic diversification by supporting the implementation of projects aimed at sustainable economic development (iii) strengthen municipal management capacities.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation and execution of the loan "Support for the Transition Towards a Sustainable Electricity Sector in Argentina" (AR-L1406)
objtv: Support the technical team of the Government of Argentina (GdA) in: (i) building capacities for the preparation, execution, and evaluation of the results of the Support Program for the Transition to a Sustainable Electric Sector in Argentina; and (ii) strengthening their capacities in institutional, regulatory, and planning matters to ensure the sustainability of the energy sector.

oper_nm: Innovation to improve access to justice for vulnerable populations
objtv: Consolidate Juslab as a judicial innovation laboratory in Argentina, in order to promote the development of a culture of innovation in the judicial ecosystem and foster the development of innovative ideas and startups in Legaltech.

oper_nm: Emergency support due to floodings in Corrientes
objtv: The objective of the CTE is to support the efforts of Corrientes municipality to mitigate the impact of the hydrologic emergency on the population and address the resulting needs linked to humanitarian aid.
envmntl_clssfctn_nm: Likely to cause minimal or no negative environmental and associated social impacts

oper_nm: Support for urban public transport reforms in Argentina
subsector_nm: DEMAND MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL OF URBAN TRANSPORT SYSTEMS
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to contribute to the structuring of public policies that improve the economic, social, and environmental sustainability of public transportation in metropolitan areas of Argentina, through the definition of a governance mechanism to coordinate the planning, regulation, and financing of the system.

oper_nm: Support for the improvement of the educational system and technical-professional training in the province of Neuquén
objtv: The objective of this TC is to strengthen the educational system in the province of Neuquén, from early childhood to higher education, including technical-professional training, with the aim of promoting both social inclusion and improvements in the employability of the province's residents.

oper_nm: Operational Support to the Fiscal Policy Strengthening Program
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The general objective of technical cooperation is to contribute to the fiscal sustainability of Argentina. The specific objectives include: a) supporting improvements in national and subnational tax policy and administration; and b) contribute to institutional improvements for macro fiscal management.

oper_nm: Operational support to the Children's Social Protection Program
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation is to provide technical support to the entities involved in the execution of the "Children's Social Protection Program" by producing analytical products that contribute to the implementation of the activities of Components 2 and 3 of the Program. The Specific Objectives of the Technical Cooperation are: (i) to technically support the National Secretariat for Childhood, Adolescence, and Family (SNNAF) in the redesign and implementation of the National Early Childhood Strategy, which encompasses the programmatic offerings and operational work of the Secretariat; and (ii) to support the National Council for the Coordination of Social Policies (CNCPS) in the design and implementation of the Integrated Social Information System (SIIS), through the conduct of necessary diagnostics and preliminary studies for its implementation.

oper_nm: Support for the Digital Health Program of the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires
objtv: Strengthen the competencies of the Ministry of Health of Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires to implement the Monitoring and Evaluation Plan of the "Digital Agenda of the Porteño Health System" project.

oper_nm: Support for the Digital Transformation of the National Institute of Social Services for Retirees and Pensioners (INSSJP)
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation is to provide technical support to PAMI to strengthen the implementation of its Institutional Strategic Plan, with a focus on enhancing the security of the information technology and operations ecosystem.

oper_nm: Support to the implementation of the Program to Support the Federal Policy for Enhancing Early Literacy
objtv: The objective of the Non-Reimbursable Technical Cooperation (CT) is to support the implementation of the Program to Support the Federal Policy for Enhancing Early Literacy (AR-L1377)., contributing to: (i) strengthening the coordination between the State and civil society organizations in the implementation of the National Literacy Plan, with focus in diverse groups; (ii) promoting the exchange of initial literacy experiences among various actors, including civil society organizations, based on participatory governance models implemented in other educational systems in the region and in Argentine provinces, fostering collective participation.

oper_nm: Support for the Agrobiotechnology Entrepreneurial Ecosystem in Santa Fe Province
objtv: The proposed project will contribute to the development and scaling of the agrobiotechnology entrepreneurial ecosystem in Santa Fe province by facilitating access to finance for startups in this sector.

oper_nm: Emergency support due to floodings in Entre Rios
objtv: The objective of the CTE is to support the efforts of Entre Rios province to mitigate the impact of the hydrologic emergency on the population and address the resulting needs linked to humanitarian aid.
envmntl_clssfctn_nm: Likely to cause minimal or no negative environmental and associated social impacts

oper_nm: Nat4BIO: Reducing Post-Harvest Waste in Food Chains through Nature-Based Solutions
objtv: The general objective of the project is to reduce post-harvest waste of fresh fruit in Argentina and to make the fruit and vegetable sector more profitable and sustainable, while at the same time improving the quality of life of the sector's seasonal workers

oper_nm: Knowledge Sharing to support the Federal Policy for Enhancing Early Literacy
objtv: Support the formulation, planning, implementation, and monitoring of education policies.

oper_nm: Evaluating the long-term impacts of rural infrastructure investments in Argentina
objtv: The objective of this TC is to assess the long-term term impact of rural infrastructure projects from the historical PROSAP portfolio in Argentina, using econometric impact evaluation methods (difference-in-differences and propensity scores) along with panel data from farmer household surveys.

oper_nm: Support for Promoting Risk Mitigation Instruments and Finance for Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency Investments for SMEs in Argentina with BICE II
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to continue providing support to the implementation and evaluation of the Program AR L1280, financed with resources from the Green Climate Fund (GCF) . In particular, the TC is intended to improve access to financial and non˗financial instruments and operational mechanisms to increase EE and RE investments by SME.

oper_nm: Emergency support due to forest fires in Cordoba Province
objtv: The objective of the TC is to support the efforts of the province of Córdoba to mitigate the impact of the emergency caused by fires on agricultural producers, the population, and the environment, as well as to address the resulting needs related to humanitarian assistance.

oper_nm: Skills for Work in Secondary Education
objtv: The objective of the Non-Reimbursable Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the design of the secondary education transformation plan promoted by the National Ministry of Education, contributing to: (i) creating spaces and fostering exchanges among organizations related to secondary education to agree on the main guidelines of the plan; (ii) promoting the generation of knowledge about the challenges faced by adolescents and young people of secondary school age, focusing on the limitations of job training and proposals for completing studies with labor certification; (iii) encouraging a review of the regulations and pedagogical definitions regarding educational-labor practices in oriented and technical secondary education, to address the identified gaps.

oper_nm: Private investment and deregulation for the modernization of transportation in Argentina
objtv: This Technical Cooperation aims to support the structuring of transport projects under public-private partnership (PPP) schemes, by identifying best practices and international experiences from countries in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) and other regions.

oper_nm: Support for capacity development to confront organized crime
objtv: Strengthen the Ministry of National Security's capabilities to combat organized crime nationwide, with special emphasis on areas considered hotbeds of vulnerability and violence.

oper_nm: Support for the defederalization of drug micro-trafficking
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the development of a Strategic Plan for the Criminal Prosecution of Drug Dealing that will strengthen the implementation of the new Federal Criminal Procedure Code (CPPF).

oper_nm: Adoption of Agricultural Technologies in Argentina: Evaluation of Results, Operational Efficiency, and New Public-Private Collaboration Schemes
objtv: Support the development of new technologies and their adoption by producers, as well as the generation of strategic information to prioritize international negotiations and enhance exports of innovative and value-added agro-industrial products.

oper_nm: Smart Spending in Education

oper_nm: Learning Exchange in Digital Identification and Public Sector Transformation
objtv: The Government of The Bahamas (GoBH) has engaged the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB) to develop an operation, ‘Digital Transformation of Government to Strengthen Competitiveness' (BH-L1045), with the overall objective of fostering competitiveness of The Bahamas by reducing the costs of conducting business with the government. Specifically, the largest component of the operation seeks to simplify and digitize government procedures. Among other activities, it will include the simplification and reengineering of procedures, giving priority to those related to starting a business and registering a property; and will also provide the necessary support to facilitate the role of the National Insurance Board (NIB) cards as a mechanism to identify persons. The Government of Uruguay (GoUR) had embarked on a similar path toward digitalization of government with the support of the IDB. The Bank has approved various loans and TCs for Uruguay in the sector: (i) E-Government Management Program Assistance in Uruguay (UR-L1042) (ii) Project for Electronic Government Management in the Health Sector (UR-X1009) and (iii) Support for the Modernization of the Civil Registry (UR-T1052). As a result of GoUR's extensive reformations in this sector, Uruguay has emerged as 1st ranked among the Latin American and Caribbean countries in the UN Global e-Government Development Index, and 26th globally. The objective of technical cooperation is to provide relevant technical leads across GoBH with a practical opportunity to benefit from Uruguay's leadership in digital government. Therefore, the IDB is seeking to facilitate a technical learning exchange between GoBH and GoUR.This objective is consistent with the objectives and standards of the Ordinary Capital Strategic Development Program for Countries whose objectives include: to "strengthen the technical and managerial capacity of national and/or subnational governments (...)" and to " expand access to intraregional experiences and advance the exchange of cooperative know-how among all borrowing member countries". oper_nm: Impact of protection of blue natural capital and promotion of the blue economy in The Bahamas
objtv:
The first objective of this TC aims to support the Monitoring and Evaluation of outcome indicators tied to the specific development goal of "Promoting sustainable economic activities related to Marine Protected Areas (MPAs) through the implementation of management plans" of BH-L1058. This objective aligns with the overarching goal of fostering sustainable growth, both of which are integral to Component 3 of the loan. This support will involve producing follow-up estimates for the following indicators listed in the operation's Results Matrix.

- Annual contribution of nursery habitat in MPA network of Abaco and Andros to lobster revenue
- Annual expenditures of tourists attributable to MPA network in Abaco and Andros
- Annual contribution of nursery habitat in 5 MPA in Abaco and Andros to lobster revenue
- Annual expenditures of tourists attributable to the implementation of management plans in 5 MPA in Abaco and Andros

The Monitoring and Evaluation Plan of BH-L1058 will employ the Stanford NatCap Integrated Valuation of Ecosystem Services and Tradeoffs (InVEST) model to assess these outcomes. The InVEST model is designed to help decision-makers visualize the impacts of potential actions by quantifying ecosystem services and trade-offs.

The second objective of the TC focuses on building and transferring the capacity to both the counterparts and the Bank to run and update the InVEST model. In particular, this capacity will enable them to comprehend and operate the specific elements of the InVEST model that are pertinent to the evaluation of the aforementioned outcomes in longer term evaluations of BH-L1058, or in similar projects in other Bahamian islands or countries.

The third objective of the TC is dedicated to supporting the Monitoring and Evaluation of outcome indicators linked to the specific development goal of "Supporting the continuity and growth of tourism-related businesses within the project's area of influence." This is associated with Subcomponent 1.2 of the loan. The support will be provided by producing estimates of the nightlight indicators (annual median radiance) for the locations where the program will establish infrastructure to enhance tourism activities. This approach will help quantify the impact of the program's interventions on local tourism development.

oper_nm: Support for Improving Disaster and Climate Resilience in Sustainable Tourism
objtv: The general objective of the TC is to support the Sustainable Tourism Program II (STP II) approved in October 2015 in its aim to mainstream disaster and climate resilience in tourism destination planning in Belize, emphasizing ecosystem-based adaptation and risk reduction. The specific objective of the TC is to increase the availability of destination-specific risk information, addressing existing and future vulnerabilities, in order to improve risk awareness and knowledge, inform local level tourism plans and the design and feasibility of physical investments to be implemented as part of the STP II. The National Integrated Coastal Zone Management (ICZM) Plan identifies Corozal as one of the areas with the highest vulnerability to flooding and erosion from storms and sea level rise, being one most concentrated population centers along the coast. The ICZM recommends the incorporation of adaptation strategies in management planning in all coastal and marine sectors of Corozal in order to reduce this high vulnerability. Therefore, this TC will develop the design of shoreline stabilization measures for Corozal, creating capacities for other coastal studies considered in STP II and include the following components: i) Coastal risk baseline studies and monitoring; ii) Design and feasibility analysis of shoreline stabilization measures; and iii) Capacity building in coastal risk reduction and shoreline stabilization measures. The expected outputs and results are i) Studies carried out to support the design and implementation of innovative disaster risk management programs base on ecosystem adaptation; and ii) Belize has increased its knowledge on disaster risk management, coastal management and ecosystem base adaptation and are fully consistent with the IDB's Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services (BIO) Program, which includes as one of its main lines of action the mainstreaming of natural capital in strategic economic sectors such as tourism. The operation is consistent with the objective of promoting ecosystem-based solutions to coastal risk reduction. It is also consistent with the Multidonor Disaster Prevention Fund, which provides non-reimbursable technical assistance to support countries in activities such as identifying risks to natural hazards; preparing disaster prevention projects; designing prevention and mitigation investments in high-risk areas. This TC is consistent with the IDB Country Strategy with Belize (2013-2017; GN-2746) which identifies tourism as a priority area for support. Disaster risk management and climate change adaptation are also identified as cross cutting issue of the Country Strategy. The TC is also consistent with Belize's Growth and Sustainable Development Strategy, which considers climate resilience and the maintenance of ecosystem services key elements of the overall strategy. It is also directly aligned with the objectives of the National Climate Resilience Investment Plan which emphasizes the integration of climate change adaptation and disaster risk management in national development. Finally, this operation is also aligned with the GCI-9 priorities of (i) supporting development in small and vulnerable countries (GN-2616-2); and ii) climate change, sustainable energy and environmental sustainability.

oper_nm: Emergency Caused by Rain, Flooding and Mud Slides in Bolivia
objtv: Desde el inicio del año 2006 se han presentado intensas lluvias, las cuales han causado inundaciones y des-lizamientos en gran parte del territorio de Bolivia, especialmente en las regiones norte, oriental y los valles "bajos". El origen de las precipitaciones intensas se asocia a la presencia de un frente "cuasi-estacionario", típico de la estación del verano suramericano. Este nivel de precipitación generó un incremento considerable en los niveles de varios ríos y quebradas y el tránsito de caudales torrenciales cargados de materiales sólidos (lodo, piedras, detritos vegetales, etc.), lo que provocó su desbordamiento. Esta situación hizo inevitable la movilización preventiva de grupos fami-liares localizados en las áreas más expuestas y vulnerables, principalmente en los Departamentos de La Paz, Santa Cruz, Beni y Pando. La situación problemática también se ha presentado, aunque en menor escala, en los Departamentos de Chuquisaca, Tarija, Oruro y Potosí, lo cual le da a esta emergencia un carácter de ni-vel nacional. En estos Departamentos, las estimaciones de los daños indican que el impacto de las lluvias ocasionó la inundación de viviendas (principalmente de personas de bajos ingresos), cultivos y el daño, a veces irreparable de infraestructura fluvial (puentes, drenajes, canales de riego, etc.) Adicionalmente, se han producido múltiples deslizamientos y aludes torrenciales de lodo que han afectado la infraestructura vial (caminos, cortes, rellenos) y laderas cultivadas Se requiere, con urgencia, apoyar al país en la ejecución de medidas inmediatas para el alojamiento y ali-mentación de las personas afectadas, así como para evitar la propagación de situaciones que puedan afectar la salud pública. En ese sentido, es necesario dotar a los albergues con alimentos y equipos y a los centros de salud con medicinas y vacunas para disminuir la incidencia de los vectores epidemiológicos. Asimismo, es necesario apoyar en las acciones de evacuación y atención de los damnificados en las áreas expuestas y afectadas. Preliminarmente se ha previsto adquirir, entre otros: i) frazadas, pañales desechables, sacos o bolsas para dormir, colchonetas; ii) medicinas (e.g. antibióticos, antipiréticos, antidiarreicos, vacunas antitetánicas, an-tigripales, etc.); iii) equipos de campaña (e.g. cocinas, baños portátiles, botas, carpas, lámparas, fuentes por-tátiles de electricidad); iv) agua potable, productos alimenticios y de primera necesidad; v) herramientas li-geras (e.g. picos, palas, carretillas, etc.) para remover escombros y vi) brindar apoyo en la provisión de ser-vicios de socorro y transporte de dichos elementos a las áreas afectadas.

oper_nm: Ecomicro – Financial Inclusion, Sustainable And Harmonic Forest Use With Biodiversity In The Bolivian Amazon
objtv: This technical cooperation aims to contribute to the reduction of indiscriminate deforestation of the Bolivian Amazon, through actions of green financial inclusion, access to green markets and environmental awareness, which promotes the return to sustainable use of forest products and forest biodiversity by indigenous peoples and rural communities. By investing and accelerating bioeconomy, this fund will promote regeneration of natural capital as sustainable means of living, aligned with ancestral values of conservation, and contemporary substitutes for colonial extractive practices. The TC will complement the operation "TC BO-T1369 Ecomicro - Financial Inclusion, Sustainable Forest Use and Harmony with Biodiversity in Guarayos – Bolivia", a fund supporting communities generate and scale their own business, using natural capital regeneration as the cornerstone for a community-based (indigenous) sustainable economy, raising awareness about the opportunities and ways of establishing enterprises that generate enough income to live in alignment with their traditional knowledge for safeguarding the forest. This Project will allow the public and private sector to articulate with the indigenous populations to influence the reduction of illegal deforestation and open new opportunities for the sustainable use of non-timber resources found inside the forest; in this way it is intended to transform the value chain of the forestry sector by diversifying its risks, implementing financial education, developing financial mechanisms focused on promoting investments considering social and environmental safeguards that will emphasize sustainable forest use, reducing illegal deforestation and therefore reducing greenhouse gas (CO2) emissions while benefiting biodiversity. For this purpose, initially, a diagnosis will be undertaken to rescue information on the natural capital that is affected in the process of carrying out forest exploitation and that to date is not consolidated and used for the identification of high potential bio-businesses and services for the environmental sustainability that the Indigenous Forest Associations (AFI) and Community Forest Organizations (OFC) could offer to contribute to the regeneration of natural capital. Likewise, the capacities of indigenous populations will be strengthened to develop bio-businesses in a more informed way and that will articulate their knowledge in the conservation of biodiversity and adequate forest management, with new private companies (interested in conservation) to generate additional income for both. The project will support Indigenous communities to advocate public policies for the implementation of regulations that favor the sustainable use of the forest and sustainable productive development in the region. It will also help to mitigate agricultural pressure and illegal logging of the forest, by making the sector more efficient, transparent, and diversifying opportunities.

oper_nm: Support for strengthening governance and planning of water resources in the Misicuni basin
objtv: The general objective of the technical cooperation (TC) is to contribute to strengthening water governance in the Misicuni basin through the implementation of effective management strategies. The specific objectives are: (i) to support the Misicuni Company (MS) in the strategic planning of the basin under an integrated water resources management and climate change approach; (ii) to strengthen the capacities of sectoral entities and operators, and to identify intervention strategies under a sustainability approach; and (iii) to develop studies and plans that contribute to the efficient operation strategy of the Misicuni multiple system (SMM).

oper_nm: Support Bolivia's agenda on Gender and Diversity

oper_nm: Humanitarian Assistance for population affected by heavy rains in Bolivia

oper_nm: Support for the Program to Strengthen capacities for research, innovation and technology transfer
objtv: The main objective of this Technical Cooperation is to strengthen the institutional capacities of the Vice Ministry of Science and Technology (VCT) of Bolivia to boost its efforts in initiatives related to research, innovation, and technology transfer. The specific objectives are: (i) to support ongoing actions developed by the VCT to invigorate the national Science Technology and Innovation (STI) system; and (ii) to assist in the design of new instruments for linking or articulating actors within the STI ecosystem and to promote strategic science, technology, and innovation actions to foster socio-productive development with environmental sustainability.

oper_nm: Evaluating the Effect of Bolivia’s Environmental Rural Cadaster on Deforestation
objtv: The broad objective of this TC is to evaluate the efficacy of Bolivia ERC, and to distill the implications for forest conservation and land tenure policy both in Bolivia and throughout Latin America and the Caribbean. The specific objectives of the TC are to answer three related research questions. First, what is the effect of the ERC on deforestation in the Bolivian lowlands, where the vast majority of the countries forest loss has occurred? Second, how are these effects moderated by the geophysical, socioeconomic, and institutional characteristics of rural properties? And finally, what are the implications of the answers to the first two research questions for the design and implementation of Bolivia's ERC and more broadly, for forest conservation and land regularization interventions in Latin American and the Caribbean?

objtv: Support to the Plurinational Government of Bolivia in the preparation of comprehensive programs for the sustainable development of Amazonian, biodiverse, and metropolitan cities. oper_nm: PUPA: INNOVATIVE FINANCING FOR EARLY CHILDHOOD DEVELOPMENT
objtv:
The purpose of the project is to provide a US$3 million secured loan from the Opportunities for the Majority (OMJ) Financing Facility to launch PUPA (PUPA Empreendimentos Educacionais e Representação LTDA), a new social business developed by ZOOM Editora (Zoom Editora Educational LTDA). ZOOM Editora is the exclusive representative of LEGO Education in Brazil. The PUPA program will address one of the most important gaps in educational services in Brazil: the lack of quality Early Childhood Education. There are currently an estimated 10 million low-income children in Brazil ages 0-6 who are not in daycare or preschool. PUPA will provide educational materials to children aged 0-6 years old, and training to their parents and caregivers, from low-income communities. The new social business aims to offer a distinctive educational program and tools that will enable parents and informal caregivers to provide ageappropriate educational activities for children in formal or informal care settings.

The PUPA program will provide easy-to-follow educational play activities through colorful magazines, LEGO toys, and audio-visual aids. PUPA will also provide training for parents and caregivers in Early Childhood Education techniques, as well as in the use of the creative play materials. PUPA will contribute to the improvement of Early Childhood Education for children who do not have access to formal care centers and whose parents, relatives and informal caregivers lack the knowledge or tools to stimulate their cognitive development. The PUPA product will be sold both to parents and informal caregivers, through a network of Non-
Governmental Organizations (NGOs) partners and micro-franchisees.

The NGOs will be local non-profit organizations or foundations involved in early childhood development in low-income communities. Micro-franchisees, self-employed women, will be responsible for signing up customers, helping them select the appropriate PUPA packages for their children, doing ¿last-mile delivery¿ of PUPA packets, checking in regularly with customers to ensure that the PUPA program is being implemented well, and conducting mini-surveys to track social performance indicators. PUPA will deliver early childhood development training to
parents and caregivers, given the central importance of training to the effectiveness of the overall program.

The OMJ project will provide needed seed capital to enable PUPA to reach scale and become financially successful and sustainable. In the seven-year tenor of the loan, PUPA is seeking to become not only a developer and distributor of Early Childhood Education products for the Base of the Pyramid, but a key partner in low-income communities by improving the skills and competencies of over 56,000 caregivers, strengthening the role of NGOs, and providing training and employment opportunities for over 1,400 women microfranchisees. Finally, PUPA, through its educational kits and improved Early Childhood Education services seeks to improve and measure socio-emotional development and readiness to learn of over 224,000 children across Brazil.

oper_nm: Building a local economic development policy in the state of Rio de Janeiro
objtv: Between 1960s and 1990s, the state of Rio de Janeiro went through a process of loosing much of its administrative/political functions and economic activities, which set the basis for a very unequal development across its regions. Today, the investments realized in light of the World Cup and the Olympics, on one hand, and the investments realized by the oil and ship building industries, on the other hand, are creating the opportunities for a more encompassing form of development, one that is not only concentrated in the metropolitan region of Rio de Janeiro, but that also extends to peripheral areas of the state. This Project aims to support the state government of Rio de Janeiro to develop its own competitiveness policy through the promotion of SMEs, taking into account the appreciation of the territorial assets in the state. The project will create a policy dialogue involving public actors (all levels of government) and private stakeholders around a concrete experience in two regions of the state (Baixadas Litoraneas and Noroeste Fluminense). In each region, a local economic development (LED) strategy will be designed and implemented, including the realization of concrete actions identified in the strategy. By involving from the beginning of the process the highest level of the state government, by fostering the exchange of experiences, modifications and improvement to the strategies, and by generating evidence, the Project will strengthen local capacities for the adoption of LED policies, and will lay the foundations for the creation of a state-wide LED policy. Thanks to the experience of the Project, and through the generation of evidence, the Project also seeks to influence other Brazilian state governments for the application of similar model of interventions and policies. A dialogue with the federal government will be also sought in an effort to influence policy making at that level.

oper_nm: Waste 2 Energy: Generating bioenergy and carbon credits from acai waste
objtv: The project concerns the generation of carbon credits by low income people through the collection and processing of açai waste into an exportable biomass in Belém, State of Para. By organizing the collection mainly through catadores (waste collectors), new income earning opportunities are created for a substantial number of disadvantaged people. After being processed in food, the açai pits are normally being dumped illegally or at a local landfill. By processing açai residues into biomass for energy generation in Europe, organic waste methanisation is avoided. In this way, the beneficiaries will earn additional income from carbon credit sales under the Clean Development Mechanism. The private sector is involved in this initiative through the participation of the company VAR do Brazil. The company plans to arrange 80% of its açai residue requirement through catadores who will be organized through a cooperative.

objtv: The objective of this TC is to expand to subnational level the Investments Monitor for Sustainability and Innovation, an infrastructure planning and management tool developed in partnership with the Brazilian Federal Government. The Monitor will enhance subnational governments´ efforts in the planning, governance, and transparency of infrastructure investments, while integrating sustainability concepts throughout the entire life cycle of infrastructure projects, from planning to decommissioning. The project will also deliver on enhancement of state governments' institutional capacity to plan and develop a pipeline of infrastructure projects that are: i) of better quality; ii) more sustainable (greener, inclusive, equitable, and based on sound governance); bankable, and that iv) can more easily attract private investors. The tool construction will allow for the determination of criteria to identify, align, prioritize, and present the most relevant information on each state's infrastructure: (i) present status, (ii) expansion plans (iii) strategies to attract investments and (iv) progress achieved. Components include: 1. Development of the Investments Monitor for Sustainability and Innovation tool at Subnational Level; 2. Adaptation of the integrated sustainability methodology and tool of the Investments Monitor at subnational level; and 3. Governance and Integration of National and Subnational Monitors.

oper_nm: Behavioral Nudges for Early Childhood Development
objtv: Support municipal governments to increase enrollment rates and parental engagement on early childhood development (ECD) (for children from 0 to 5 years old).

oper_nm: Urban Development and Low-Carbon Strategies for the Decarbonization of Brazilian Cities
objtv: The objective of the TC is to create tools and technical outputs to allow Brazilian cities to grow on a low-carbon path by (i) promoting territorial strategies for sustainable urban development; (ii) financing pre-investments studies for low carbon interventions and pilot projects; and (iii) building capacity by incorporating climate change mitigation considerations in urban planning frameworks. In other words, this TC seeks to reduce the Brazilian infrastructure gap sustainably through low-carbon investments and achieve a green recovery post-COVID-19 towards a more resilient society.

oper_nm: Integrated Urban Development Strategies and Sustainable Mobility in Brazilian Cities
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to promote urban development with land-use planning strategies aligned to sustainable mobility in Brazilian cities. Specifically, based on a comprehensive sector diagnosis, this TC seeks to deliver sustainable urban plans focusing on sustainable mobility and land uses for Brazilian municipalities. These plans will identify urban strategies and investment needs for sustainable urban mobility infrastructure for the next 20 years.

oper_nm: Prevention of blindness and visual impairment in Brazil by utilizing smartphone attachment medical devices for ophthalmology
objtv: To establish an innovative model using portable/smartphone attachment medical devices with artificial intelligence, to deliver eye care in Brazilian indigenous population and thereby to contribute to the Universal Health Coverage.

oper_nm: Modal Shift for Zero Carbon Cargo and Passenger in Brazil
subsector_nm: LOGISTIC PLANNING, MULTIMODAL TRANSPORT AND LOGISTIC PLATFORMS
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support Brazilian government to implement the national decarbonization plan in federal transport sector. The TC aims to achieve its objective by: (i) developing regulatory frameworks, transport logistics and the relationship with the territorial planning and pre-feasibility studies to facilitate investments in low carbon transportation modes and climate resilience infrastructures; (ii) piloting technologies/initiatives to support low carbon transition in Brazil; and (iii) updating the elements of the Integrated Transport Planning, particularly National Logistics Plan and the General Plans of Public Actions or Partnership, to meet the country‘s target for Decarbonization.

oper_nm: Strengthening financial instruments and capital markets for low carbon infrastructure in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC), is to support Brazilian national and sub-national development banks, financial institutions, and public entities to mobilize private investment for low-carbon infrastructure projects in the energy, transport, waste, water and sanitation sectors in Brazil. The TC aims to achieve its objective by i) piloting innovative green financial instruments and structuring climate-related de-risking mechanisms; and ii) developing the Brazilian capital market and enhancing legal, regulatory, and institutional systems.

oper_nm: ReFormar: structuring an innovative market for low-income housing renovation
objtv: To generate a permanent and effective change in the low-income housing renovation market in Brazil (and the region), it is proposed to consolidate and scale the unique and innovative B2B2C solution developed by the Brazilian startup Vivenda. With a systemic and comprehensive approach, Vivenda's solution is unique in the low-income housing renovation sector in Brazil and in the region, as it provides a complete solution aimed at vulnerable families, consisting of: (i) offering a standardized technical service thanks to a system of micro franchises that simplify and cheapen interventions by qualified professionals; (ii) offering affordable micro financing thanks to innovative funding specifically for vulnerable populations; and (iii) offering lower cost and easily accessible building materials thanks to agreements with large national companies and neighborhood stores.

oper_nm: Scaling-Up Sustainable Debt Capital Markets Financing for Brazil´s Economic Recovery
objtv: The general objective of the TC is to promote Brazil´s sustainable economic recovery. The specific objective of the TC is to scale-up the use of innovative debt capital market instruments such as asset-backed securitizations, bond issuances, as well as other sustainable financing alternatives, to enhance the availability of medium-to-long term financing to sustainable investments in the country.

oper_nm: Bio-Cities of the Amazon in Brazil: Solutions for a Sustainable Future
objtv: Create contextualized urban development models for the challenges faced by Amazonian cities in order to protect their biodiversity, halt accelerated urban sprawl and consequent deforestation, and attract bioeconomy-related investments. The TC will also help intermediate cities in the Amazon Basin to develop sustainable and inclusive green urban development plans for all their inhabitants, facilitating their positioning as resilient urban nodes with high environmental and urban quality standards.

oper_nm: Support ProSocial (Education) operations' design
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the dialogue and preparation of operations under ProSocial's CCLIP, which has the goal of increase efficiency in the administration of social spending in Brazil. This CCLIP, an multisectoral type II (MM-II) according to CCLIP's policy GN-2246-13, contemplates multisectoral interventions that cover services throughout the citizen's life cycle, including actions in: (i) early childhood development; (ii) education (primary and secondary); (iii) health; (iv) labor markets; and (v) pension systems. This TC will focus on designing operations regarding the education sector.

oper_nm: Post-COVID Recovery: Investment Opportunities in Brazil
objtv: This project will support the Brazilian government in developing a complementary investment attraction and export promotion strategy. Furthermore, the main objective of this project is to support the Brazilian government and its subnational entities in the development and implementation of activities (i.e., Brazilian Investment Forum - BIF, business matchmaking, digital roundtables, etc.) leading to investment attraction and trade openness at national and sub-national levels. 2022 started with the world in the midst of an asymmetrical recovery, where in some countries COVID-19 infection rates have fallen significantly, while in others, the virus remains difficult to control. But whether governments are actively managing outbreaks or returning to normalcy, economic recovery is central to their forward-looking agenda. The effects of Russia's invasion of Ukraine have caused more profound shocks. It has disrupted markets in energy and, crucially, food in ways which highlight the need for more broadly based supplies. For these reasons, the IMF recently revised and reduced its projection for economic growth. Global growth is now projected to slow from an estimated 6.1 percent in 2021 to 3.6 percent in 2022 and 2023. This is 0.8 and 0.2 percentage points lower for 2022 and 2023 than projected in January. According to a November 2021 McKinsey survey, regionalization remains a priority for most global companies and almost 90 percent of respondents expect to pursue some degree of regionalization in their supply chains during the next three years. BlackRock's annual letter to shareholders spotlights Brazil as one of the most direct beneficiaries of this Global Value Chain (GVC) realignment. As stated by the Economist, decision-makers are increasingly concerned that GVCs should be robust, not just efficient. Governments and firms are constantly reminded that resilience also comes from diversification. Brazil can provide many of the solutions that the region needs right now –from realigned and resilient supply chains to abundant, solid, and sustainable investment options across many sectors. Economic growth resumed in Brazil in 2021. GDP grew by around 4.6% in 2021, outweighing 2020's 3.9% decline. Recent trade data estimates that Brazil's exports grew almost 35% in 2021. The Brazilian economy is also performing well in 2022. The economy grew 1.0% in the first quarter, unemployment fell to 10.5% (down from 14.8% during the pandemic) and business and consumer confidence are increasing. Also, after the strong retraction of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in 2020, international investors have resumed their appetite for investing in Brazil.

oper_nm: Cybersecurity and use of new technologies in the public sector
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to deepen the digital transformation of Brazilian governments by strengthening capacities in cybersecurity and the use of new technologies.

oper_nm: Strengthening the management of precatorios
objtv: The general objective is to support the Ministry of Economy of Brasil, strengthening governance and processes for the management of judicial and precatory actions and the liabilities associated with the relationship between the federal government and the states. The specific objectives are: (i) to increase the effectiveness of the management of judicial and precatory actions, through the implementation of processes aimed at proactive action in the identification and mitigation of risks, with emphasis on the use of new technologies and jurisdictional functionality to improve said processes; and (ii) to improve the management and monitoring of agreements with the states under the Tax Recovery Regime through the implementation of a system, with effective results for the federal government and the states.

oper_nm: Support to strengthening of the fiscal management and public policies evaluation
objtv: Strengthen the governance and processes of fiscal management and the evaluation of public policies to improve the efficiency in the use of public resources by governments. The specific objectives are: (i) to strengthen the ex-ante and ex post evaluation process, as well as to strengthen the follow-up of the evaluation results and their feedback to the public budget; and (ii) strengthen and expand the diagnosis of Fiscal Management Maturity and Performance (MD-GEFIS) to support strategic action and prioritization of initiatives by state and municipal public managers.

oper_nm: Support for the Digital Transformation of the Tax Administration in Brazil
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Support the Federal Revenue Agency of Brazil (Receita Federal do Brasil, RFB) in its efforts to strengthen and modernize its institutional capacity, specifically the digital transformation of the tax administration.

oper_nm: State Government of Pará: Structuring the Payment for Environmental Services Program under the Amazônia Agora Plan (ParáPSA1)
objtv: The Objective of the TC is to structure a Payment for Environmental Services (PES) Program in the state of Pará to meet the goals of the Amazônia Agora Plan of socioeconomic development through neutralization of greenhouse gas emissions from land use and deforestation. The project will develop the methodological framework for implementation of a PES Program based on valuation of its natural capital, including ecossystem, climatic, and regulatory services.

oper_nm: Emergency support to the states of Bahia and Minas Gerais in Brazil for the massive flooding in late 2021
objtv: The objective of the proposed TC is to support the efforts of the Brazilian Government in the provision of humanitarian assistance to the affected population by the heavy floods in the states of Bahía y Minas Gerais.

oper_nm: Development of a toolkit for assessment and digitalization of early literacy content.
objtv:
