The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the tools of the Let´s all learn to read1 program. This will include a reading fluency and accuracy assessment instrument and a hybrid course for literacy training. 
Background. Brazil stands out in LAC for having a national literacy policy that highlights the importance of this process in the initial years of primary education. Proof of this are the results in the Estudio Regional Comparativo y Explicativo (ERCE) 2019 tests where 57% of the students in the fourth year of primary school achieved the expected learning in the reading test. Minister Milton Ribeiro expressed the following regarding the test results: "Our results in the 4th grade are among the best and we will improve even more, since literacy is one of the priorities of this administration." Despite this achievement, the same results show that four out of ten students in 4th grade are not literate, showing that there is still a way to go. 
Additionally, after two years of school closures due to the COVID-19 pandemic and no national evaluations that indicate student performance, it is likely that progress has suffered a setback in learning in reading that will have lasting consequences in the academic performance of students. The early years of learning to read are critical to later academic success. 
To support the Brazilian government in its objective of increasing the percentage of literate students at the appropriate age (end of 3rd grade of Ensino Fundamental 1), at the request of the National Education Council (CNE), the IDB allocated resources from Improvement of Efficiency and Service Delivery of Education in Brazil in times of COVID19, (BR- T1447) to the adaptation of the materials of the Let's All Learn to Read program in Portuguese. During the process of adapting materials, it was identified that the program did not have a teacher training component or an evaluation instrument to measure the progress of students during their school career, which are cornerstones to offer the educational system a comprehensive program. That is why, at the beginning of 2022, we received a new request from the CNE to continue developing the components of the Let's all learn to read program with a view to responding effectively to the needs of the educational system. 
The teaching of initial reading and writing, due to the age of the children, the availability of resources and the nature of the process, in addition to the digital gaps, the lack of teacher training to teach remotely, and the inequalities in the homes for supporting children pose additional challenges. 
A successful distance education requires the development of digital and printed teaching materials, as well as evaluation instruments and distance teacher training. Likewise, evaluation instruments are required to measure the learning levels of students in distance modalities. Additionally, it is necessary to adapt and prepare materials for the eventual return to classes, either in person or in hybrid modalities.

oper_nm: Support for Digital Transformation in the Health Sector in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support various operations in Brazil including BR-L1518, BR-L1568, BR-L1583, and BR-L1591 to: (i) improve the quality, efficiency and equity of health services through the adoption of digital interventions; (ii) support adoption and adaptation of regional (Latin America and the Caribbean) approaches and best practices for digital transformation of the health sector, related to the design and implementation of electronic health records, telehealth and implementation of international standards for interoperability in health in Brazil; and (iii) document lessons learned from the Brazil context.

oper_nm: Strengthening strategies with local governments in Brazil and promoting an operational agenda for the Prosocial CCLIP
objtv: The objective of the TC is to support dialogue and strategies with local governments in Brazil, promoting an operational agenda for LMK in the context of Prosocial CCLIP.

oper_nm: Support to Public Policy Convergence to OECD Practices
objtv: Support the Ministry of the Economy's (ME) efforts to adopt good practices from OECD member countries on critical public policies which are under the ME's institutional mandate.

oper_nm: Support for the Preparation of the Joinville Sustainable Sanitation Program - PROSAJ
objtv: The TC aims to support the preparation of studies, operational documents, projects and other activities required for the definition, planning and adequate preparation of the Sustainable Sanitation Program of Joinville - PROSAJ, and at the same time generate conditions for an efficient execution of this.

oper_nm: Source of Innovation: Facility to Foster Innovation in Brazil's Basic Sanitation Sector
objtv: The objective is to promote the development and adoption of innovative solutions in the Basic Sanitation sector of Brazil

oper_nm: Fiscal Policy for Climate Change in Brazil
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The objective of the project is to provide assistance to the Ministry of the Economy of Brazil (ME) in the integration of climate action regarding policy and fiscal management. To achieve this objective, this TC will finance three types of actions: (i) development of a financial transparency and fiscal management framework for climate change; (ii) support for the implementation of green fiscal management instruments and methodologies; and (iii) dissemination of knowledge and exchange of good practices.

oper_nm: Support for the Preparation of the Environmental and Sanitation Program of CAESB - CAESB II
objtv: The TC aims to support the preparation of studies, operational documents, projects and other activities required for the definition, planning and adequate preparation of the Environmental Sanitation Program of the CAESB - CAESB II, and at the same time generate conditions for an efficient execution of this Program.

oper_nm: Downstream support for the development of PPPs in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this TC is to provide upstream and downstream specialized advisory service to the preparation of PPP projects in Brazil, in order to further develop the private participation in infrastructure in the country and to address key bottle necks to promote continued improvement of the country's infrastructure trough private participation. Therefore, this TC will: (i) support the development or improvement of specific institutional arrangements in the PPP sector, and (ii) provide advisory service for the appraisal and structuring of specific PPP projects, either for the Federal Government or for Subnational Entities, in accordance with the IDB's institutional strategies and country priorities.

oper_nm: Modernization of the Brazilian Power Sector
subsector_nm: ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND RENEWABLE ENERGY IN END USE
objtv: Support the Government of Brazil (GoB) to strengthen its institutional, technical, and regulatory capabilities to promote a greater integration of low carbon technologies in the Brazilian energy matrix

oper_nm: Brazil More Productive Program: new growth paths taking advantage of the reconfiguration of global value chains
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to contribute to the consolidation of capabilities in the Government of Brazil and its public institutions in charge of designing and implementing policies for productive development, to increase productivity and competitiveness. The three specific objectives are: (i) to develop a comprehensive strategic framework for structural change, taking advantage of the opportunities brought about by the reconfiguration of global value chains in the transition towards a decarbonized economy that is resilient to climate change; (ii) to explore the design and experimentation of policy interventions to promote innovation and productive development aligned with climate goals; and (iii) to generate instances of dialogue and awareness among policy makers and business chambers on the pending challenges in terms of inclusive and sustainable productive development through communication and knowledge dissemination activities.

oper_nm: Improving Amazon’s sustainable development through technical education (TVET) course for açaí
objtv: Pilot TVET course regarding açaí production

oper_nm: Trial Reservoir: A Sustainable Source of Resources to Innovate in Water and Sanitation
objtv: The objetive of the project is to accelerate the adoption at scale of novel tech-based solutions which can help the water sector achieve efficiency by testing during 3 years a new financing mechanism for tech trials in the water sector in Brazil that will move the sectorbeyond the "trial, trial, trial" phase by scaling the impact of tech-based solutions and developing capabilities for innovation absorption in the water sector.

oper_nm: Promote Sustainable Forest Management through Innovative Carbon Accounting Solution for Tackling Climate Change
objtv: The overall objective of the project is to increase the capacity of government institutions, the third sector and private companies to conduct large-scale spatial monitoring of native vegetation restoration initiatives in Brazil. The specific objective is to apply orbital remote sensing methods combined with field survey data to perform biomass gain assessments and carbon stock calculations as a function of vegetation structure and phytophysiognomies in areas under restoration initiatives.

oper_nm: Public sector digital transformation and cybersecurity capabilities
objtv: Support Brazil's public sector digital transformation and cybersecurity capabilities at the federal, state and local levels.

oper_nm: Strengthening the analytical and operational agenda of gender and diversity mainstreaming in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen analytical and operational knowledge of the gender and diversity (G&D) agenda in Brazil, at the national and subnational level, to: i) support the mainstreaming of G&D in the IDB's operations in Brazil at the national and sub-national level; and ii) support policy dialogue and the identification of interventions to help reduce inequalities and promote policies in favor of the inclusion of women and diverse groups.

oper_nm: Bioeconomy Ecosystem Hubs: Enhancing bioeconomy businesses in the Amazon
objtv: The objective of the project is the creation of Bioeconomy Ecosystem Hubs in the Legal Amazon Region to strengthen and articulate the local bioeconomy businesses through supporting programs and training; creation of a network to connect local actors and stakeholders, so that they can strengthen local networks; and the creation of mechanisms so that this model can be adopted and/or replicated as public policy in the territory.

oper_nm: Decarbonizing the Brazilian Amazon: Policy Reforms Support
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the State of Pará on the implementation of policy reforms aligned with the Policy Based Loan "Descarbonize Pará: Policy Reform Project for Sustainable Development in the Amazon" (BR-L1613 – US$ 300M). The proposed loan operation aims to accelerate structural reforms of public policies to promote carbon-efficient and sustainable economic development, in order to (i) promote fiscal sustainability in line with the decarbonization of the economy, (ii) consolidate climate governance at the state level; (iii) conserve and restore ecosystems with high carbon storage and removal capacity, using Nature-Based Solutions (NbS); (iv) develop Bioeconomy chains and promote climate-smart agriculture through low carbon agrosilvopastoral production; (v) promote financial instruments that consolidate the decarbonization trajectory of Amazonian states and (vi) promote gender, equality and inclusion in policy reforms towards a green economy.

oper_nm: Promoting State Research Support Foundations for Innovation in Bioeconomy in the Legal Amazon
objtv: To promote research, technological development, and innovation, aimed at promoting the sustainable development of Legal Amazon, while maintaining its natural capital.

oper_nm: Support for capacity development in Citizen Security and Justice institutions in Brazil
objtv: Strengthen institutional capacity to improve the effectiveness of policies, plans and programs for citizen security and justice in Brazil, through the integration of scientific evidence on its contents, along design and implementation processes.

oper_nm: Fiscal Management Challenges in the Next 10 Years
objtv: Support the Brazilian government exploring potential solutions and collaborative governance models of fiscal management to look toward the challenges in the next 10 years, through two types of actions: (i) development and implementation of diagnoses, recommendations and methodologies to face the challenges of fiscal management; and (ii) dissemination of knowledge, design of collaborative solutions, and training for the exchange of good practices.

oper_nm: Mechanisms to Reduce Litigation in Brazilian Tax Litigation
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to the reduction of tax litigations by the federal government through the following actions: (i) promote tax compliance and foster legal certainty; (ii) strengthen the relationship of trust and loyalty between taxpayers and the Treasury/tax administration; (iii) reduce the number of pending tax disputes (also known as "stock"); (iv) improve the speed in the resolution of cases, through the use of advanced technological tools, including artificial intelligence, and consensual solutions through the use of alternative resolution methods; and (v) promote the exchange of good practices at the national and international level to prevent and reduce tax litigation.

oper_nm: Brazil Mais Digital Implementation Support - Digital Government Axis II
objtv: To strengthen the capacities of Brazilian subnational governments for the design and effective implementation of Digital Government programs. This objective is expected to be achieved through technical assistance consultancies and knowledge exchanges in a community of practice environment that will allow: (i) improved digital governance; (ii) better diagnostics, indicators and economic analysis in digital government; (iii) a menu of appropriate solutions to the identified challenges; and (iv) strengthened project management.

oper_nm: Brazil - Amazon Bioeconomy Marketplace
objtv: To contribute to improve socioeconomic conditions, fight climate change, restore ecosystems and implement sustainable development practices in the Brazilian Amazon region. To that end, the activities in this TC aim to support the development of an online Amazon Bioeconomy Marketplace (ABM) to help bio-businesses in the Amazon region increase and diversify their exports and attract investment.

oper_nm: Support for the Strategic Agenda of the Brazilian Ministry of Health
objtv: The general objective of this CT is to support the Brazilian Ministry of Health (MoH) in strengthening the strategic areas of digital health, primary care and the organization of specialized services and the health industrial complex. The specific objective is to strengthen the MoH capacities and to support the MoH policy making process, for the next four years, in its strategic agenda.

oper_nm: Support for the Strategic Agenda of Brazilian Ministry of Social Development and Assistance
objtv: The general objective of this CT is to support the Brazilian Ministry of Social Development (MDS) in strengthening its capacities to deal with this strategic and urgent issues on the country's social agenda. The specific objectives are (i) to strengthen the Unified System of Social Assistance (SUAS) and (ii) to support the strategic programs of MDS for the next four years.

oper_nm: Technical support to the transport sector in Brazil
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to provide support to the transportation sector in Brazil, assisting both the Federal Government and subnational entities in initiatives and projects that promote safe, sustainable, resilient and inclusive transportation and logistics infrastructure and services, as well as the incorporation of innovative solutions that support the digital transformation of the sector in the country. The specific objectives of the TC are: (i) to provide comprehensive technical assistance for the planning, design and implementation of projects, including specialized studies, prefeasibility, technical, economic and environmental assessment, and social management plans, among others; and (ii) to support institutional strengthening and provide technical assistance to improve the sustainability and resilience of transport infrastructure and services, as well as to promote innovation, gender equality and inclusion in the sector.

oper_nm: Support for the connectivity infrastructure pillar of the CCLIP Brazil More Digital
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen technical capabilities for the formulation of digital connectivity projects and strategic regulations in Brazil, with a focus on the Amazon Region.

oper_nm: Tourism climate action in Brazil: policy development and innovative approaches
objtv: The main objective of the TC is to strengthen the Brazilian tourism sector capabilities to adequately respond to climate change associated challenges. Its specific objectives are: (i) to support the development of principles for public policies and operational guidelines to lead and coordinate climate action between national and subnational stakeholders, (ii) to increase the sector's capabilities to climate action, mobilizing partnerships and identifying financial instruments that will allow the implementation of the guidelines developed, and (iii) to promote the identification of key-challenges for adaptation and mitigation with tourism private-sector stakeholders and support their resolution through solutions provided by the local innovation ecosystem. Knowledge dissemination activities, as events and publications, are also planned by the TC, as well as the definition of the basic framework for a future tourism climate action national policy.

oper_nm: Institutional capacity building for PPP program implementation in national and subnational public entities in Brazil
objtv: Address key bottlenecks for the implementation of the PPP process cycle that have been identified by the Introscope 2022, specifically (1) the delivery of capacity building exercises that will enable the consolidation of Project Preparation Facilities focused on sustainable projects that add value to public sector and service users in less mature public entities; (2) the implementation of standardized key methodologies for PPP project appraisal and preparation in terms of key value for money drivers and bankability as well as methodologies to enable comparison of entities responsible for PPP implementation in order to identify and replicate good practices in terms of governance, contractual models and processes for PPP prioritization, selection and preparation.

oper_nm: Support to the social agenda in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this operation is to contribute to improve the social agenda in Brazil, in preparation of the G20 meeting that will take place in the country in 2024, through knowledge generation and dissemination and policy dialogue.

oper_nm: Support for the identification and structuring of Public-Private synergies for environmental assets in the Brazilian Amazon Basin
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation is to support the identification of public-private synergies for the sustainable management of environmental assets, with emphasis on the conservation of forests and parks in the Brazilian territory of the Amazon Basin and to support the structuring and implementation of Public-Private Partnership (PPP) projects in these sectors.

oper_nm: Strengthening institutions to address issues of racial equality and discrimination against LGBTQIA+ individuals
objtv: The aim of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to provide support for the diversity agenda in Brazil at the national and subnational levels, with a specific focus on i) Assisting in shaping public policies aimed at reducing racial inequalities by strengthening SINAPIR at both the national and subnational levels; ii) supporting initiatives to facilitate the implementation of the National Plan for the Promotion of Citizenship and Human Rights of LGBTQIA+ individuals, as well as the protection of their rights and autonomy.

oper_nm: Enhancing subnational environmental governance in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this TC is to enhance subnational environmental governance in Brazil according to evidence-based public policy analysis. The project will build on relevant reference methodologies, such as IDB's "Environmental Governance Indicators for Latin America and the Caribbean" and Centro de Liderança Pública (CLP)'s Ranking of Green Assets, to consolidate a comprehensive and efficient methodology to evaluate subnational environmental governance in Brazil. This methodology will contribute to the identification of gaps on environmental policy at state-level and to the provision of evidence informed recommendations for policy reforms.

oper_nm: Innovation and Digital Health to improve health in the Amazon region
objtv: Support the design of strategic digital health initiatives in Brazil

oper_nm: Improving the Management of the Macrocompetences of the National Treasury
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Contribute to the balance of public finances by strengthening the governance of the Secretary of the National Treasury (STN), considering best practices in environmental and diversity and inclusion matters.

oper_nm: Strengthening of the planning and budget process of Brazilian Federal Government
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Ministry of Planning and Budget (MPO), in strengthening the processes and methodologies of fiscal planning and public policies, medium and long-term budgeting, as well as management of public investment, contributing to the technical and allocative improvement of public spending.

oper_nm: Strengthening Sub-national Innovation Statistics in Brazil
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation is to improve the institutional capacity of subnational governments to enhance innovation policies in Brazil by strengthening the availability and dissemination of data related to innovation at the level of the federative states of Brazil. To do so, this technical cooperation will support creation of an index for innovation for the federative states of Brazil, through the development, systematization and publishing of indicators disaggregated at the state level.

oper_nm: Support for the Implementation of the Tax Reform
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to provide support to the Brazilian government in the implementation of the new consumption taxation model, which is based on a dual VAT system. Specifically, this TC aims to facilitate the design of the Tax on Goods and Services (IBS, by its acronym in Portuguese) model, which will serve as the cornerstone for the new VAT collection framework at the state and municipal levels.

oper_nm: MMA institutional strengthening in support of Brazil's bioeconomy
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to assist the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change (MMA) to strengthen Brazil's bioeconomy sector as an alternative to deforestation-based economic activities, supporting the Action Plan for the Prevention and Control of Deforestation on Brazilian Biomes (PPCD), especially in the Amazon region (PPCDAm). The TC aims to achieve this objective by: (i) enabling institutional strengthening within MMA; (ii) mainstreaming the Bioeconomy Plan into the Ecological Transition Plan delivered by the Ministry of Finance and (iii) promoting policy and financial solutions for bio businesses to thrive.

oper_nm: Improvement of the institutional capacity of Banco do Nordeste
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (CT) is to enhance the institutional capacity of Banco do Nordeste - BNB to provide it with the necessary capacities for the efficient and effective execution of sustainable infrastructure loans and preparation of public-private partnerships (PPPs). This objective will be achieved through support for: (i) promoting the use of technological innovations in the preparation and appraisal of infrastructure projects; (ii) supporting the implementation of the PDI Platform; and (iii) strengthening BNB's internal capacities in the operation of its Project Factory.

oper_nm: Support for the Finance Track of the G20 Brazilian Presidency
objtv: The objective of this non-reimbursable TC is to support the Brazilian presidency in shaping international policy towards a more resilient and inclusive infrastructure through knowledge generation, dissemination, and policy dialogue in preparation for the G20 Summit that will take place in the country in 2024.

oper_nm: Support the Credit Expansion Program for Investments in Telecommunications Networks in Brazil
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to strengthen the institutional capacities of MCOM to design, monitor and evaluate financial mechanisms that can make efficient use of the scarce resources of the FUST to enforce the universalization policies of telecommunications services, equipping MCOM with conditions to scale MCOM's FUST in partnership with current and new FAs.

oper_nm: Structuring of Public-Private Partnerships for the recovery of the national forests in the Amazon Basin
objtv: The aim of the technical cooperation will be to structure public-private partnerships to make a concession program for reforesting national degraded areas in the Amazon feasible, as well as to make it possible to use the carbon credit market as an instrument for financing projects.

oper_nm: Nature Based Solutions: supporting the advancement of decarbonization in the State of Pará
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to improve the institutional, technological, and technical capacities of the State of Pará, promoting a sustainable and integrated approach to environmental management throughout the territory. This holistic strategy is designed to effectively address the complex challenges of decarbonizing the state's economy. To achieve a meaningful and lasting impact, this TC emphasizes a commitment to transformational change, by prioritizing the adoption of cross-functional models such as climate-smart agriculture. It also promotes Sustainable Production Systems, Practices, Products and Processes (SPSABC) and Nature-Based Solutions (NbS) to increase productivity, adaptation and mitigation.

oper_nm: Support the Interministerial Committee on Climate Change – CIM in the institutional strengthening of Brazilian climate governance and mitigation actions for the Brazil National Plan on Climate Change 2024 – 2035 (Plano Clima)
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the Brazilian government in restructuring its national climate policy and governance, while enhancing the country's environmental and social systems to improve their effectiveness, by providing technical assistance to the Interministerial Committee on Climate Change (CIM). At the same time, it aims to realign national public policies to support sectoral mitigation and adaptation actions to promote a just transition to a low-carbon and resilient economy.

oper_nm: Support to the implementation of the natural disasters risk management policy in the state of São Paulo
objtv: The objective of the TC is to improve the effectiveness of disaster risk management in the State of São Paulo through increased knowledge of risks, enhanced governance, and the application of innovative methodologies for risk identification and analysis, monitoring, response preparedness, and disaster risk reduction.

oper_nm: Support for the implementation of the Low Carbon Agriculture Plan (ABC+) in the State of Pará
objtv: The objective of the TC is to support the State of Pará in promoting the implementation of low-carbon, resilient and sustainable productive systems among small and medium-scale farmers, especially in the cocoa and açaí production chains, contributing to the implementation of the Pará State Low Carbon Agriculture Plan (ABC+/PA). To achieve this objective, the TC will work by: (i) improving the capacities of Technical Assistance and Rural Extension (ATER) technicians and farmers on resilient and sustainable bioeconomy production systems and on the credit policies that support them; (ii) contributing to the development and implementation of bioeconomy-based projects to be presented to credit institutions.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation and execution of the COP30 in Brazil
objtv: This technical cooperation (TC) aims to directly support the Secretariat of the COP30 Presidency by both promoting effective stakeholder engagement during the preparatory process leading up to the Conference and ensuring the successful delivery of the Conference itself.

oper_nm: Support for the Environment and Climate Agenda within the SFWG at the G20 under the Brazilian Presidency
objtv: The objective of this non-reimbursable TC is to support the Brazilian Presidency in shaping international policy to climate and sustainable finance through knowledge generation, dissemination, and policy dialogue, in particular within the Sustainable Finance Working Group, in preparation for the G20 Summit that will take place in the country in 2024.

oper_nm: Enhancing Brazil's G20 Leadership through Knowledge and Capacity Building on Institutions for Development
objtv: The objective is to support the Brazilian presidency of the G20 Summit that will take place in Brazil in 2024 in shaping international policy in areas such as Anti-Corruption, Digital Economy, International Financial Architecture, Sustainable Finance, Global Partnership for Financial Inclusion, International Taxation Agenda, Institutional Capacity Building, Productivity, and Financial Sector Issues. By contributing to this discussion, the IDB positions itself as a knowledge base institution with one of its goals to contribute to the development of a public policy agenda.

oper_nm: ClimateScanner: Application of a Rapid Review Tool for Climate Action
objtv: The objective of this TC is to provide support for the Brazilian Supreme Audit Institution (TCU) to apply ClimateScanner in Brazil, as well as disseminate its results and attract other countries to join the initiative, mainly in Latin America and the Caribbean. This will be done through i) capacity building activities, ii) assessment of the tool and its operationalization, including improvements` recommendations and international dissemination, and iii) adjustments for its application at the subnational level.

oper_nm: Strengthening regulatory capacities for competitiveness and the improvement of the business environment in Brazil
objtv: To support the development of institutional capacities for better regulation in Brazil, with a view to enhancing competitiveness, improving the business environment, and providing better public services. To achieve this, the TC will support the following specific objectives: (i) strengthening a regulatory quality monitoring system; (ii) generating a menu of options to measure regulatory costs; (iii) enhancing capacities in regulating new technologies and climate change; and (iv) supporting administrative simplification and better regulation initiatives at the subnational level.

oper_nm: Sustainable Investment Attraction and Export Promotion
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation is to support investment attraction and export promotion activities in the Brazilian Amazon region, including: (i) the design, capacity-building and execution of a strategy for export promotion and investment attraction in the Amazon region, including the creation and implementation of a possible structure for investment attraction and export promotion in the Amazon region and (ii) export promotion and investment attraction activities, particularly in the bioeconomy, food, and beverages sectors.

oper_nm: Support to Brazil's New Integration Agenda
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to provide technical and financial assistance to the new regional integration agenda led by the government of Brazil which include: (i) the identification, design and implementation of priority integration routes, understood as integration and development corridors, and projects with neighboring countries and Brazil's border states and municipalities; (ii) institutional strengthening to structure integration corridors and projects and to commit the participation in regional work instances; and (iii) regional dialogues and dissemination of Brazil's integration initiatives.

oper_nm: Operational Support to PRODIGITAL - Digital Transformation of States and Municipalities
objtv: Strengthening the institutional capacities of state and municipal governments to formulate and execute digital transformation projects. This strengthening will occur within the context of structuring and executing sub-loans linked to PRODIGITAL - Federal Program for Government and Digital Infrastructure (BR-L1627). Additionally, this Technical Cooperation will support the development of inputs for the design and implementation of the Program.

oper_nm: Challenges and proposals for Basic Education in the Legal Amazon (AL)
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the LA states in the production of diagnoses and identification of strategies and policies to strengthen the educational offer, with emphasis on three important areas: school infrastructure, connectivity, quality of the offer teaching and access to educational services in isolated areas.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation of Salvador Capital Afro Program (BR-L1636)
objtv: The overall objective of technical cooperation is to support the preparation of technical studies, operational documents and other activities necessary for the adequate preparation of the Salvador Capital Afro Program (BR-L1636), contributing to the generation of the necessary conditions for its satisfactory execution.

oper_nm: EXPLEARN Facility: Supporting Expansion of Full-Time Education in Brazil
objtv: Support decision-making and the design of more effective and inclusive public policies to improve educational policies and quality, regarding Full-Time Education (FTE).

oper_nm: Technical support to promote electromobility and decarbonization in urban mobility in Brazil
subsector_nm: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (BUS / TRAIN / CABLE). INFRASTRUCTURE AND EQUIPMENT
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to provide technical support to promote decarbonization and electromobility in urban mobility in Brazil, assisting both the Federal Government and subnational entities.The specific objectives of the TC are: (i) to support the preparation and execution of new credit operations; and (ii) to support the structuring of new business models for the financing and operation of sustainable urban mobility services, as well as dialogues to foster public policies that promote decarbonization in urban mobility and an incentive to the use of Public Transportation (PT).

oper_nm: Support for the development of an IDB CLIMA pilot project in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the design of the IDB CLIMA Pilot Project (BR-L1638), as well as to accelerate Brazil's access to thematic green capital markets through: (i) the integration of climate aspects in public investment; (ii) the development of capacities and systems to scale investments that facilitate the achievement of the climate commitments assumed by the country; and (iii) the development of systems and capacities to monitor, report and verify these investments and their compliance with environmental objectives.

oper_nm: Technical support for the prevention and control of environmental crime in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation is to contribute to the effectiveness and efficiency of environmental crime prevention and control activities, through the development of institutional capacity to collect, analyze and disseminate relevant statistical information.

oper_nm: PROMORAR (Prohousing) II – Supporting Innovative Strategies for Housing and Habitat in Brazil
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support existing operations to promote new housing and habitat improvement strategies in Brazil, focusing on the low-income population to contribute to socio-economic development and reduce social inequalities in the country. Specifically, this TC seeks to strengthen the operations at the federal and local levels of government with initiatives related to innovations in housing production and improvement, habitat upgrading, and neighborhood improvement, as well as sector strengthening in Brazil.

oper_nm: Operational Support for the PRO-SEGURANÇA - CCLIP
objtv: The objective of this TC is to strengthen the institutional capacities of the federal government (and its bodies), state and municipal governments to formulate and execute citizen security and justice projects effectively and efficiently, that are based on evidence, as well as the design and implementation of loans and activities of the PROSEGURANÇA Conditional Credit Line (CCLIP) (BR-O001).

oper_nm: Project to support the Quilombola Bioeconomy and the Georeferencing of Territories in the Legal Amazon
objtv: The implementation of policies that enhance visibility, inclusion, and georeferenced information for these communities, along with the promotion of culturally appropriate bioeconomy practices.

oper_nm: Strengthening Financial Capacities of Subnational Governments
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the National Treasury Secretariat (STN), an agency of the Ministry of Finance (MH) of Brazil, in strengthening the financial capacities of the states and municipalities of Brazil, through actions such as training in public finance, promoting workshops, courses, analytical studies, toolkits, and the exchange of experiences.

oper_nm: Operational Support for PROFISCO III
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: El objetivo de esta Cooperación Técnica (CT) no reembolsable es apoyar la elaboración de diagnósticos y propuestas de soluciones para fortalecer la implementación de la Línea de Crédito Condicional para Proyectos de Inversión (CCLIP) Programa de Modernización de la Gestión Fiscal en Brasil PROFISCO III (BR-O0016).

oper_nm: Qualification for Young People in Belém
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to provide training for young people in vulnerable situation in the city of Belém, located in northern Brazil, thereby promoting more sustainable and inclusive development in the region. This area, rich in biodiversity and culture, faces significant challenges that need to be addressed through education and skills training. The TC aims to expand opportunities for vulnerable youth in productive inclusion through technical training and qualification, and strength ties with the local productive sector. Also, the city will host the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP 30) in 2025.

oper_nm: Building Synergies to Support the Interstate Legal Amazon Consortium
objtv: The main objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to build synergies that promote and reinforce in a coordinated way the actions of the Interstate Legal Amazon Consortium for the sustainable and integrated development of the Amazon region. Through the partnership between the IDB and the Consortium, the discourse of the region's public managers becomes more unified and states in the Legal Amazon become politically stronger to attract more solid projects that lead to development on a sustainable and inclusive basis. This TC will also leverage the private sector through the cooperation in the Amazon region in the context of investment opportunities and synergies between the public and the private sectors. The specific objectives of this Technical Cooperation include: i) supporting the strengthening of land Institutes and Secretariats through coordinated actions that contribute to the acceleration of land regularization processes in the states of the Brazilian Legal Amazon; ii) supporting the development of initiatives to analyze and improve the business environment of bioeconomy chains; iii) carrying out diagnoses of the fiscal situation of the states in the Legal Amazon that can support public managers in their investment decision-making processes; and iv) disseminating and sharing knowledge and experiences with strategic stakeholders.

oper_nm: Technical Assistance to support the design and implementation of the Foreign Private Capital Mobilization and Currency Hedging Program
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to support the design and implementation of Brazil´s Foreign Private Capital Mobilization and Currency Hedging Program to facilitate foreign investments in sustainable infrastructure and support the country´s ecological transformation. The specific objectives are to support (i) the implementation of certain reforms under the purview of Brazil's National Monetary Council and regulations to be issued by the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change; and (ii) the design and implementation of specific lines of credit to be operationalized by Brazil´s Climate Fund geared towards private capital mobilization and currency hedging.

oper_nm: Support for the Preparation of the Macambira Anicuns Goiânia GO 2nd Stage Urban Environmental Program – PUAMA II
objtv: Support in the preparation of studies, operational documents, projects and other activities required for the definition, planning and adequate preparation of the Macambira Anicuns Goiânia GO 2nd Stage Urban Environmental Program – PUAMA II, and at the same time generate conditions for an efficient execution of the Program.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange on public expenditure quality management tools
objtv: This operation will support the Government of Brazil in the implementation of quality management tools for public spending, especially those related to the Expenditure Review process, the Medium-Term Framework and the Public Investment Governance Model.
envmntl_clssfctn_nm: Likely to cause minimal or no negative environmental and associated social impacts

oper_nm: Energy Transition Program II - Brazil
subsector_nm: ENERGY INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING AND CAPACITY BUILDING
objtv: The objective of this TC is to extend the activities and analytical studies initiated under the Energy Transition Program I (PTE-I), through the TC BR-T1432, to achieve the decarbonization of the Brazilian economy by the year 2050, through the development of the second phase of the Energy Transition Program (PTE-II). The specific objectives of this TC are to: (i) create a stakeholder forum to discuss, evaluate and propose improvements to institutional, legal, and regulatory frameworks that promotes the development and adoption of technologies and business models focused in reducing Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions and removing carbon in a cost efficient manner; (ii) update and enhance the energy transition scenarios carried out in PTE-I; (iii) evaluate the different macroeconomic impacts (investment, GDP, job and income generation) and sectoral resulting from the updating scenarios, with a focus on the development of a net-zero economy that increases the competitiveness of Brazilian industry; and (iv) development of Indicative Sectoral Roadmaps 2025-2040 to guide the Brazilian energy transition and decarbonization process by 2050.

oper_nm: Technical Support for Banco do Brasil in preparation for BB Amazônia Program
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to support BB to promote sustainable development in the Brazilian Legal Amazon by: (i) supporting the expansion of a technical assistance program to promote bio-business' development, stakeholder engagement and credit access expansion, and (ii) supporting the development of the classification methodology, impact indicators, monitoring plan, reporting processes, gender and diversity related aspects of the BB's Bioeconomy Program.

oper_nm: Strengthening the institutional and operational development of the Development Financial Institutions (DFIs) in Brazil
objtv: Given Brazil's current needs to meet the goals established in its ecological transformation plan and considering the guaranteed sovereign operations under development, seeking to support Brazil in promoting sustainable and low carbon development, private investments leverage, and low carbon infrastructure promotion, the proposed TCs objective falls withing its scope. The specific objectives are to (i) support DFIs and related government institutions of the SNF with technical assistance in analysis, studies and sectorial diagnostics focused on sustainable development and low carbon economy, institutional framework developments, financial inclusion analysis and action plans for the design of gender and diversity programs, as well as overall support for the implementation of key projects; (ii) promote capacity building activities as publications, workshops, trainings and events related to the agenda of sustainable finance and financial inclusion in DFIs of the SNF; and (iii) support the development of innovative financial business models, MSMEs lending platforms, risk mitigation mechanisms aiming at scaling up financial flows towards sustainable finance, capital markets, and specific high impact events, like disasters.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange between Brazil and Colombia on Human Rights of LGBTQIA+ People
objtv: This Technical Cooperation aims to strengthen ties between Brazil and Colombia in the areas of LGBTQIA+ shelters, civil society engagement, and public policy. To this end, it proposes a visit by a delegation composed of representatives from Brazil's National LGBTQIA+ Council and Colombian government officials. The exchange will allow Brazil to learn from Colombia's experiences and explore solutions that enhance public policies and services for the LGBTQIA+ population, promoting greater inclusivity and policy democratization.

oper_nm: Technical Support for the preparation of the Integrated Well Living Action Plan for Indigenous Peoples 2024-2027
objtv: This technical cooperation aims to strengthen the capacity of the Ministry of Indigenous Peoples (MPI) and the National Foundation for Indigenous Peoples (FUNAI), the agencies responsible for indigenous policy, in developing the Integrated Plan for Indigenous Well-Being for the peoples of the Amazon region. Its specific objectives are: i) to support actions for the implementation of the National Policy for Territorial and Environmental Management of Indigenous Lands (PNGATI) by monitoring the implementation of the Territorial and Environmental Management Plans (PGTA) of selected indigenous lands in the Amazon region; ii) to develop recommendations for supporting and promoting an agroecology-based economy and indigenous socio-biodiversity, as well as for supporting and promoting indigenous ecological restoration initiatives; and iii) to support processes related to the regularization of indigenous lands (TI), particularly the qualification of claims and the analysis of technical documents produced during the demarcation process.

oper_nm: Structuring public-private partnerships for the recovery of subnational forests in the Brazilian Amazon basin
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the structuring of Public-Private Partnership (PPP) projects for the sustainable management of subnational environmental assets, including forest management projects and/or the recovery of degraded areas in the Brazilian Amazon. This support to subnational governments will be provided through BNDES and in coordination with the Brazilian Forest Service (SFB).

oper_nm: Design of the operation “More Productive Acre Program - PROAMP
objtv: The objective of PROAMP is to reduce rural poverty in the State of Acre, through the sustainable development of forestry, agroforestry and agricultural production, avoiding deforestation and promoting climate change adaptation.

oper_nm: Emergency support due to floods and landslides in Rio Grande do Sul State
objtv: The objective of the CTE is to support efforts to mitigate the impact of floodings and landslides on the population and address the humanitarian needs in the Rio Grande do Sul State.
envmntl_clssfctn_nm: Likely to cause minimal or no negative environmental and associated social impacts

oper_nm: Support for the development of the reconstruction plan for the State of Rio Grande do Sul
objtv: Support the government of the State of Rio Grande do Sul in the development of a multi-sectoral plan that contributes to a resilient reconstruction after the severe floods of May 2024.

oper_nm: AMAZON JOURNEY: Developing innovative bioeconomy business in the Amazon
objtv: The objective of this project is to quickly and assertively induce the birth of bioeconomy startups and strengthen the still fragile existing ones, thus originating a pipeline of qualified sustainable bioeconomy businesses in the Amazon Impact Innovation Ecosystem, maintaining the robustness and longevity of bioeconomy startups that directly and indirectly are capable of keeping the forest standing.

oper_nm: Remote OBGYN Monitoring Leveraging the iCTG Wearable Platform
objtv: The project has the objective of piloting and rolling out iCTG state-of-the-art device developed by Melody, a Japanese startup, within the Obstetrics and Gynecology Department HCFMUSP and later in less complex or resource-poor health units in P&V communities to provide a cost-effective telehealth solution by allowing cardiotocography examinations to be performed remotely and efficiently. The project beneficiaries include over 600 high-risk pregnant women from the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS), as well as over 50 patients in a remote P&V municipality.

oper_nm: Support for the establishment of recovery credit Programs for the State of Rio Grande do Sul by Public Development Banks
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to strengthen the institutional capacity of Public Development Banks in Rio Grande do Sul to support the region's recovery from the flooding disaster. The specific objective of this TC is to support development banks that operate in the region in the diagnosis of financial needs and design of adequate financial solutions with gender and indigenous people lenses to support the recovery and continuity of economic activities through SME credit, and financing for resilient and sustainable infrastructure projects, including sustainable urbanization and reconstruction of essential infrastructures.

oper_nm: Support to Regulatory Sustainability of Basic Sanitation Services in Brazil
objtv: The general objective of the TC is to strengthen the sustainability of the regulation of drinking water, sewage, solid waste and drainage services developed in Brazil by the National Water and Sanitation Agency (ANA), and in that way, promoting the sustainable development of these services.

oper_nm: Open innovation solutions for subnational development challenges
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation is to improve the institutional capacity of subnational governments to apply open innovation tools to address development challenges. Specifically, it will aim to provide technical support to state and municipal governments in implementing innovative solutions through different public procurement for innovation instruments established under the Legal Framework for Startups.

oper_nm: Fostering renewable energy integration projects through Banco do Nordeste
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (CT) is to strengthen the Project Factory that has been created at the BNB in partnership with the IDB, enhancing its capabilities on the preparation of public private partnerships projects of renewable energy infrastructure. The objective will be achieved through the preparation of technical, pre-feasibility/feasibility studies, and institutional strengthening activities that will focus on promoting the integration of VRE into the National Integrated System (NIS).

oper_nm: Inova Program for Protected Areas in the Brazilian Amazon
objtv: The general objective of this project is to support the management and governance of natural protected areas in the Brazilian Amazon by strengthening effective planning and implementation of sustainable tourism frameworks in the pilot selected area of the area of Tapajós, in Pará (Brazil).

oper_nm: Strengthening the National Monitoring and Evaluation System
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation (TC) is to support the Brazilian government in strengthening the National Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) System. Although Brazil has an adequate M&E system compared to OECD standards (e.g., production of performance information, quality of evaluation work, etc.), the system presents several challenges in institutionalization, integration, and scaling of its different parts and processes.

oper_nm: Aging Facility: Support to the creation of the registry of caregivers for older people in the State of Paraná (Cadastro de Cuidadores do Paraná)
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to design an electronic registry of caregivers for older people, a key component of the Paraná Amigo da Pessoa Idosa Program, promoted by the Secretariat of State for Women, Racial Equality and the Elderly (SEMIPI) of Paraná, Brazil, and currently in the process of parliamentary discussion. The registry will include unpaid and paid caregivers.

oper_nm: Evaluation of Brazilian Work Sharing Program in the Context of COVID-19
objtv: The objective of this TC is to produce evidence on the effects of the Emergency Benefit Program (BEm) on labor market outcomes. This work-sharing initiative, implemented in Brazil during the critical years of the coronavirus pandemic, provided subsidies to cover working hours and salary reductions. Such evidence is scarce in Latin America, and even less is known about the implementation of these programs under extreme unpredictable emergency scenarios. The TC aims to address this evidence gap.

oper_nm: Afroestima Impact Evaluation: a Promising case of Prodetur Salvador
objtv: The objective of this TC is to develop and implement an impact evaluation of the Afroestima Training Program (AFE), financed by operation BR-L1412 (Prodetur Salvador), and provide inputs for the design of optimal interventions under the scope of the new loan in preparation, BR-L1636 (Salvador Capital Afro).

oper_nm: Assessing the Effectiveness of Anti-Racist Training in Education
objtv: Esta Cooperación Técnica (CT) describe una evaluación de impacto utilizando un diseño de Ensayo Controlado Aleatorio (RCT) para evaluar si las intervenciones de capacitación antirracista cambian los prejuicios raciales de los docentes y los estudiantes, promueven prácticas más inclusivas dentro de las escuelas, mejoran el clima escolar y los sentimientos de pertenencia a la escuela, y, en última instancia, mejoran los resultados académicos, como la asistencia escolar, las calificaciones y las tasas de promoción.

oper_nm: Support to the implementation of the Paraná Amigo da Pessoa Idosa program
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) project aims to support the State Ministry for Women, Racial Equality and Older People (SEMIPI) of Paraná, Brazil, in the development and implementation of some components of the Paraná Amigo da Pessoa Idosa (Paraná Friend of Older People) program, including: (i) the development of a registry of institutional long-term care service providers; (ii) training of caregivers with a person-centered approach; (iii) the development of a community-based care needs prevention strategy; and (iv) the design of an investment plan for this policy.

oper_nm: Evaluation of Program for the Modernization of Fiscal Management in Brazil (PROFISCO)
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: To strengthen the capacity of Brazilian subnational secretaries of finance in data analysis and use of evidence for policy making. The specific objectives are providing technical assistance for the design and implementation of the impact evaluations of to the CCLIP PROFISCO II (BR-X1039) and PROFISCO III (BR-O0016) ; and contributing to strengthen the body of knowledge through rigorous evidence of the effectiveness and impact of the products financed by PROFISCO.

oper_nm: Enhancing the Bioeconomy through Innovative Financial Instruments within the ARPA Communities Program
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the Brazilian government, through the Ministry of Environment and Climate Change, to structure and implement innovative financial instruments that promote the bioeconomy and support communities in strengthening their bio-businesses and value chains by building new ventures focused on non-timber forest products, sustainable management and agroforestry systems which, in turn, simultaneously conserve the forest and offer economic alternatives for the populations living and working in sustainable-use protected areas that are part of the Amazon Region Protected Areas Program (ARPA).

oper_nm: Upscaling Biodiversity Units by Engaging Forest-Dependent Communities in the Conservation and Sustainable Use of Forests and Landscapes
objtv: The Project objective is to operationalize and scale up Biodiversity Units in the Amazon region of Brazil, in the State of Pará. Biodiversity Units will be underpinned by a payment for environmental success structure, creating results-oriented, long-term programs that will increase the likelihood of nature-positive outcomes and improved livelihoods for local communities and corporate entities willing to invest in it.

oper_nm: Building new development models in indigenous economies
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation is to promote the economic and sustainable development of the indigenous communities in the Brazilian Amazon by strengthening and promoting productive activities in the region. This initiative is based on the value of the indigenous communities' knowledge about their territory, their human, cultural, social, political, and ecological identity, while also respecting their governance structure and local leadership.

oper_nm: EXPLEARN Facility: Teaching Artificial Intelligence in full-time schools
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to pilot an AI course in Brazil's public schools, especially in full-time education. The TC will finance the first pilot in the state of Pará, developing specific materials for teacher training and an evaluation tool to measure students' development, and then scale it to two other states/municipalities.

oper_nm: Urban mobility project for passenger transport on rails in the State of São Paulo, Brazil
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation ("TC") is to support the government of the State of São Paulo through its Secretary of Partnerships in Investments (SPI) and the São Paulo Partnerships Company ("CPP") – the beneficiaries – in carrying out the studies for the structuring process of a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) for the construction, operation, and maintenance of four passenger rail transport projects in the state of São Paulo (Brazil).

oper_nm: Support to strengthening policies to promote gender equality and inclusion of diverse populations in Brazil
objtv: The main objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the strengthening of policies aimed at promoting gender and racial equality in Brazil, in a context of structural inequalities that disproportionately affect women and the Afro-descendant (AD) population, including quilombola communities, traditional communities, Afro-Brazilian religious groups ("terreiros"), and Roma people. Specifically, the TC will provide technical assistance to: (i) strengthen regulatory frameworks, reforms, and public policies that promote gender and racial equality; and (ii) enhance the institutional capacities of federal ministries that work, either directly or transversally, on policies aimed at improving the living conditions of women, the AD population, and traditional communities.

oper_nm: Brazil Mais Digital Implementation Support - Digital Government Axis III
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the institutional strengthening of state governments in Brazil, to accelerate digital transformation at the subnational level, increasing citizen satisfaction and generating savings in the use of public services. The specific objectives include: (i) strengthening institutional capacity to design and execute digital government programs; and (ii) strengthening coordination and the exchange of experiences to optimize resources, generate synergies, and promote the scalability and replicability of successful initiatives.

oper_nm: Support for the implementation of sustainable rural development operations in Brazil
objtv: The general objective of the TC is to improve the performance and impact of operations that support sustainable rural development in Brazil. The specific objectives are to: (i) strengthen the institutional and operational capacities of key state-level executing and co-executing agencies responsible for the implementation of IDB-funded projects; (ii) foster policy dialogue on sustainable agriculture at state and federal levels.

oper_nm: Strengthening the Effectiveness of Public Policies and Citizen Security and Justice Programs in Brazil
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacities of the security and justice agencies of the Federative Republic of Brazil, in coordination with the National Secretariat of Public Security of the Ministry of Justice and Public Security, to address organized crime in the country through innovative solutions that help tackle this phenomenon and reinforce public policies and programs on citizen security and justice in Brazil.

oper_nm: Support ProSocial's Education Programs - 2
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the dialogue, preparation and execution of operations under ProSocial's CCLIP, which has the goal of increase efficiency in the administration of social spending in Brazil. This CCLIP, an multisectoral type II (MM-II) according to CCLIP's policy GN-2246-13, contemplates multisectoral interventions that cover services throughout the citizen's life cycle, including actions in: (i) early childhood development; (ii) education (primary and secondary); (iii) health; (iv) labor markets; and (v) pension systems. This TC will focus on designing and executing operations regarding the education sector.

oper_nm: Support for the Operational Model of Brazil's Tax Reform
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the Government of Brazil, particularly the Receita Federal de Brasil (RFB), in generating knowledge and designing the operational model for the implementation of the consumption tax reform (RCT) in Brazil.

oper_nm: Institutional Strengthening of the Ministry of Finance: Technological Innovation and Ecological Transformation
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Support the institutional strengthening of the Ministry of Finance (MH) in order to incorporate new technologies into its governance and strategic management model, as well as adapt its processes to the challenges of the ecological transformation.

oper_nm: Strengthening the Government's judicial representation in tax matters
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Supports the Brazilian government, particularly the Attorney General's Office of the National Treasury (PGFN), in enhancing its capacity to manage the Union's active debt and collecting tax credits efficiently.

oper_nm: Strengthening Sustainable finance and financial innovation in Brazil through the Laboratory of Financial Innovation in Brazil - LAB
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacity of the Laboratory of Financial Innovation (LAB), a key platform for promoting multisectoral public-private dialogue in Brazil and Latin America, to contribute to sustainable finance and financial innovations in Brazil. These resources will drive the development of financial solutions that promote financial inclusion, green finance practices, and innovation in the Brazilian financial regulatory landscape, while contributing to financial institutions (FIs) capacity building in the National Development System (SNF).

oper_nm: Amazon More Connected and Sustainable - Quality and resilient digital infrastructure for the sustainable development of the amazon region
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacity of federal and subnational governments, as well as Development Finance Institutions (DFIs), to design and implement digital connectivity initiatives that drive sustainable, inclusive, and climate-resilient development across Brazil's Amazon region. Through a programmatic and coordinated approach, the TC will contribute to empowering the Amazon with a transformative connectivity strategy that drives sustainable development, investment and climate action. To that end, the TC will finance: (i) the formulation of a regional strategy for digital connectivity; (ii) the design of quality and resilient digital infrastructure solutions; (iii) the development of innovative financial mechanisms to scale investments; and (iv) the promotion of connectivity uses cases that support decarbonization. The TC will pursue the following specific objectives: (i) support the development of a comprehensive regional strategy to expand digital connectivity across the Brazilian Amazon, ensuring alignment with national and subnational priorities and fostering multi-stakeholder coordination; (ii) design and prepare investment operations and global credit programs in collaboration with national and subnational governments, as well as DFIs, with a focus on mobilizing public and private capital for digital infrastructure; (iii) develop practical use cases and pilot projects that integrate digital connectivity into initiatives aimed at reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, particularly in sectors such as sustainable agriculture, forest monitoring, telemedicine, digital education, and smart logistics.

oper_nm: Support for the Operational Strategy to Improve Climate Resilience and Risk Management in Transport Infrastructure in Brazil (focus on the Amazon)
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to improve the resilience of the Brazil transport infrastructure, with focus on the Amazon transport network, the national and subnational projects strategic to improve the resilience and redundance of the transport network and, the transport projects in execution and/or preparation with IDB resources. The specific objectives are: (i) a pilot project to design a regional dynamic WRF model to improve the threat information necessary to contribute to develop the adaptive capacity and to reduce the vulnerability to climate risk to the Brazilian transport network; (ii) to develop tools that contribute to asses and reduce climate vulnerability of the Brazilian transport network, and improve institutional capacity, dialogue and coordination among decision makers in transport climate risk management in Brazil and; (iii) to develop a policy and technical roadmap for the development of the Amazonian transport network in Brazil, based on a set of standards of resilience, green infrastructure, and nature based solutions.

oper_nm: Support to the Sustainable Economic Development Program of the State of Tocantins
objtv: The Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the Government of Tocantins in the design and initial implementation of the Programa de Desenvolvimento Econômico Sustentável do Estado de Tocantins (Tocantins Mais Sustentável). This will be achieved by conducting diagnostic studies, providing technical assistance and capacity-building to strengthen institutional frameworks, enhance productive sector competitiveness, and improve investment and trade facilitation mechanisms.

oper_nm: Innovative urban integration approaches for poverty reduction
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to strengthen poverty reduction and social inclusion components in housing and urban development plans and operations. The TC has three specific objectives. First, to identify innovative arrangements and experiences to overcome traditional bottlenecks to the integration of poverty reduction and social inclusion components in urban development projects. Second, to find replicable and scalable ways to address information gaps in favelas, mainly in economic and social indicators. Third, to build the capacity of housing and urban development departments to effectively integrate poverty reduction and social inclusion components. While these objectives are broadly relevant to Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), this TC is specifically designed to support the State of São Paulo in its poverty reduction initiatives. It will develop innovative urban integration approaches for poverty alleviation within the 'Baixada Santista-São Paulo-Campinas' corridor, clearly outlining opportunities for IDB engagement and support.

oper_nm: Support to Brazil's Trade and Investment Facilitation Initiatives
objtv: The main objective of this project is designed to support the Brazilian government—at both federal and subnational levels—in strengthening and implementing trade and investment promotion initiatives to advance Brazil's participation in the global economy.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation of the Belo Horizonte Environmental Recovery Program – DRENURBS 2nd Phase
objtv: The CT aims to support the preparation of studies, operational documents, projects and other activities required for the definition, planning and adequate preparation of the Belo Horizonte Environmental Recovery Program – DRENURBS 2, and at the same time generate conditions for its efficient execution.

oper_nm: Strengthening the operational agenda with states, municipalities and local development banks
objtv: The objective of this cooperation is to support actions in the labor market, productive inclusion, social protection and in the pension system in Brazil, prioritizing two fronts: (i) support in structuring project scopes together with federal and local governments, aligned with the strategic priorities of these governments and those of the IDB; (ii) design of action strategies with local development banks, considering the themes of labor market and social protection.

oper_nm: Live and Sustainable Amazon (Metareilá)
objtv: The general objective of the TC is to promote the sustainable management and conservation of the Sete de Setembro Indigenous Territory. This will be achieved by enhancing territorial monitoring capacities; developing sustainable bioeconomy products; restoring degraded lands; and strengthening local governance—especially the roles of women and youth.

oper_nm: Strengthening the Indigenous Health Subsystem
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Federative Republic of Brazil, through its Ministry of Health (MS), by strengthening the technical capacities of the Indigenous Health Secretariat (SESAI), of the Specialized Indigenous Health Districts (DSEIS, linked to the MS) in the Amazon Legal Region (RAL) and other relevant actors such as states and municipalities in the same region. The specific objectives of the TC are: (i) to develop protocols to address climate emergencies and environmental disasters in the region; (ii) to generate knowledge about alternatives and technologies for the permanent supply of water in these indigenous communities in the region; and (iii) to train and prepare public actors, as well as indigenous communities to respond quickly to climate emergencies.

oper_nm: Integrated urban development and climate resilience in Brazilian cities
objtv: This TC aims to support Brazilian cities in designing integrated and resilient urban development projects that promote sustainability and social inclusion. This TC focuses on improving the living conditions of low-income and vulnerable populations through targeted interventions addressing entrenched inequalities and promoting inclusive urban growth. Specifically, this TC will (i) provide technical assistance to municipalities for the design, preparation, and execution of integrated urban development programs, with a focus on sustainability and climate resilience; and (ii) strengthen institutional capacities to ensure projects incorporate technical, environmental, and social analyses, consistent with international and sectoral best practices.

oper_nm: Support to the execution of the Program “Pará More Connected - Meaningful and Sustainable Connectivity for the Digital Transformation of Pará”
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is supporting the strengthening of the institutional capacity of the State of Pará and of the Empresa de Tecnología da Informação e Comunicação do Estado do Pará (PRODEPA) to enhance internet connectivity in the State of Pará. This TC also aims to contribute to the successful execution of operation "Pará More Connected - Meaningful and Sustainable Connectivity for the Digital Transformation of Pará" (BR-L1644), a project co-financed by the IDB and Agence Française de Développement (AFD). The specific objectives of this TC are: (i) support for the technical capacities and sustainability of PRODEPA; (ii) support for PRODEPA's organizational reform, and (iii) support regional integration.

oper_nm: Support the Brazilian government in developing the platform and investment tools related to the Ecological Transformation Plan
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) project aims to support the Ministry of Finance in Brazil, through its National Treasury Secretary, with the development and implementation of a georeferenced digital platform to enhance transparency, governance, and accountability of the Eco Invest Brasil Program.

oper_nm: Aging Facility: Support to the Government of the State of Bahia to develop an intersectoral model of care for the elderly
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to develop in the State of Bahia an intersectoral model of care for the elderly, with a focus on those diagnosed with dementia and their families, involving sectoral policies and actions in Health, Social Assistance and Human Rights.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange between Brazil, Chile and Costa Rica on prison infrastructure and recidivism prevention
objtv: The objective is to foster an exchange of experiences with technical experts from Costa Rica's Ministry of Justice and Peace in the fields of prison infrastructure that upholds human rights, education, vocational training, and employment access for incarcerated populations, as well as restorative justice. Additionally, it seeks to exchange experiences with technical experts from Chile's Gendarmerie (penitentiary service) regarding the implementation of the Risk-Needs-Responsivity (RNR) model.

oper_nm: Bridging Climate Action and Biodiversity Conservation through Bioeconomy towards COP30 - Bio COP30
objtv: This technical cooperation (TC) aims to directly support the Presidency of COP30 by providing technical inputs on key aspects of the transition to a low-carbon and climateresilient global economy. It will integrate mitigation, and adaptation approaches by exploring how bioeconomy contributes to sustainable development, with a focus on biodiversity conservation, traditional knowledge, and climate resilience. Additionally, the TC will emphasize the role of carbon accounting, developing methodologies that account for life cycle emissions, align with the realities of countries with clean energy matrices, and support carbon credit generation through sustainable land use and bioenergy production. By addressing both financing and trade challenges, it will provide actionable insights for policymakers, investors, and international organizations, reinforcing the bioeconomy's role in global climate and economic strategies.

oper_nm: Support for creating institutional capacities for the implementation of the Foreign Private Capital Mobilization and Exchange Protection Program
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support Brazil's public institutions' capacity to advance policy, institutional reforms, and programs toward accelerating investment growth for the Ecological Transformation of Brazil and improving the business environment. The TC will also support the policy based loan operation "Reforms for Implementing the Foreign Private Capital Mobilization and Exchange Protection Program and Support for Structural Improvements in Brazil's Institutional and Business Environment (BR-L1639)", and other targeted programs looking for synergies related to the Ecological Transformation Plan.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange between Brazil and Chile on public policies aimed at combating poverty
objtv: The CT aims to promote institutional cooperation between the Secretariat for Social Development of the State of São Paulo (SEDS) and the Government of Chile, with the aim of fostering the exchange of experiences and knowledge on public policy instruments and methodologies aimed at combating poverty. It is understood that poverty is not limited to insufficient income, but also to the lack of access to essential goods and services, such as health, education, housing, food security, among others. SEDS recognizes the importance of collaboration between public agencies as a catalyst for significant advances in the dissemination of good practices. In this sense, the Secretariat is particularly interested in learning about the Puente-Chile Solidario Program, developed by the Chilean Government, with the aim of enriching its own initiatives and aligning itself with international best practices.

oper_nm: Strengthening Social Protection and Development Policies in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacities of the Ministry of Social Development and Assistance, Family and Fight against Hunger (MDS) to address challenges to overcoming poverty in Brazil and improve the social and care agendas. The specific objective is to support initiatives aimed at overcoming poverty and social vulnerability, contributing to the enhancement of MDS's strategic programs focused on productive inclusion and opportunity generation, including the strengthening of policies that promote the socioeconomic inclusion of individuals registered in the Unified Registry for Federal Government Social Programs (CadÚnico).

oper_nm: Support for the Modernization Program for Energy Resilience and Sustainability in Santa Catarina
