objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the operation of the Energy Modernization for Climate Resilience and Sustainability Program in Santa Catarina (BR-L1664) by conducting the necessary economic, environmental, social inclusion, productivity, and legal studies. The specific objectives are: (i) to finance economic, social inclusion, productivity, and legal studies to assess the overall feasibility, sustainability, and enabling framework of the program; (ii) to finance technical and environmental studies that support the technical design of the program and ensure its alignment with the principles of climate sustainability and operational efficiency; and (iii) to finance complementary engineering studies and analyses required for the definition and structuring of the program.

oper_nm: Support to the Piloting and Evaluating Home-Based Care Services for Older Adults in Brazil
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the piloting and evaluation of an integrated home care model for older adults with functional dependency in Brazil, while providing support to unpaid family caregivers, particularly women. This TC will contribute to the early implementation of the National Care Policy (Law No. 15.069/2024), which establishes care as a universal right and promotes shared responsibility for its provision among families, communities, the State, and the private sector.

oper_nm: AI-Powered Solutions for Health Visit Follow-Ups: Enhancing Care for Vulnerable Populations
objtv: This impact evaluation will examine whether and how AI-powered tools improve treatment adherence and ongoing engagement with healthcare, especially among vulnerable users and with a focus on non-communicable diseases, such as diabetes and hypertension. Specifically, the project will develop and implement an individual-level randomized controlled trial (RCT) to evaluate different models of follow-up support to patients.

oper_nm: Structuring of a PPP project for the construction, maintenance, and operation of a hospital facility in Viamão (Rio Grande do Sul/Brazil)
objtv: Support studies for the PPP structuring process for the construction, operation and maintenance of the Hospital Metropolitano do Rio Grande do Sul, in the city of Viamão, Brazil.

oper_nm: Impact of improving the quality of hospital networks in the Municipality of São Paulo
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to generate rigorous national-level evidence on the effectiveness of interventions aimed at improving the quality of management in public hospital services provided by the Municipality of São Paulo (MSP).

oper_nm: Support for the impact evaluation of the Vida Nova Program (BR-L1588)
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to design and support the implementation of the impact evaluation of the Vida Nova Program (BR-L1588), a housing initiative in Paraná that promotes the resettlement of vulnerable families into adequate housing with secure tenure and access to basic services.

oper_nm: Testing and Scaling an Artificial Intelligence-Based Functional Literacy Program
objtv: Conduct an RCT with circa 70,000 students to measure the impacts of an AI-based Program designed by Letrus in reducing the functional literacy gap in Brazilian public schools.

oper_nm: Project Readiness Assessment (PRA) for PPP of Belo Horizonte Metropolitan region (RMBH) Metro System Lines 3 and 4
subsector_nm: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (BUS / TRAIN / CABLE). INFRASTRUCTURE AND EQUIPMENT
objtv: The project aims to structure a DBFOM (design, build, finance, operate and maintain) PPP for the implementation of Metro Lines 3 and 4 in the in Belo Horizonte's Metropolitan Region (RMBH). Line 3 is expected to have around 4.6km of subterranean tracks with 6 stations in the central area of Belo Horizonte, the State's capital, and reaching the city of Nova Lima, in the RMBH. It will be integrated with the existing Line 1.Line 4 is expected to have around 22.6km divided on superficial tracks and light rail, with 18 stations in the cities of Contagem and Betin within RMBH. It will also be integrated with existing Line 1. As the government of Minas Gerais already has several engineering, demand and environmental studies carried out over several years on these two passenger transport lines, the PRA is important to help identify the overall quality of existing studies, their fundamental gaps, the existing data and if it is outdated or not, and which data or studies already carried out can still be used. This identification can bring more rationality when creating the terms of reference for project structuring, optimizing costs and timeframe for PPP structuring activities.

oper_nm: Concession Project for the Ecological Restoration of the Triunfo do Xingu Recovery Unit, Altamira - Pará
objtv: The General Development Objective is to enhance natural capital by increasing carbon sequestration in the Triunfo do Xingu Recovery Unit (URTX) area, thus contributing to mitigation efforts. The Specific Development Objectives are: (i) effective mobilization of private resources for the reforestation and conservation of the URTX under the concession agreement; and (ii) to reforest the URTX area.

The overall objective of the program is to help improve the operation of the Chilean Parliament by developing the Library of Congress of Chile and to promote a closer relationship between Congress and the Chilean people. The earthquake and tsunami generated mass destruction in the disaster area (regions VI, VII and VIII that have high rates of relative poverty in the country). It is estimated that around 25% of FE clients in these territories lost their home and / or your business (infrastructure and / or fixed assets). The remaining 75% keep their home or business infrastructure but have total or partial loss of goods and / or machinery and not have the resources to restrain this. FE needed to continue their services, restructure the impaired portfolio and provide a solution to these women to enable them to continue their businesses and support their families.

The TC will finance the design and implementation of a critical route that considers the professional training and work experience of migrants and, from there, suggest ways for formal labor insertion through employment or legal enterprises.

oper_nm: Support for the institutional strengthening of the Ministry for Women and Gender Equity
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to support the efforts of the Government of Chile to promote inclusive economic growth by strengthening the empowerment of women. For this, this TC will accompany the Ministry of Women and Gender Equality in strengthening (i) care actions for victims of gender violence and (ii) the institutional capacities of the Ministry, with a focus on mainstreaming.

oper_nm: Support for the effectiveness of employment and training policies in Chile
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the efforts of the Government of Chile to improve the design, management and implementation of labor policies. Specifically, the CT seeks: (i) to carry out studies and proposals to improve the design and implementation of public training and employment policies; and (ii) support the integration and improvements of digital service channels for employers and job seekers.

oper_nm: Support for the strategy to strengthen mental health policy in Chile.
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation is to contribute to the expansion of coverage and opportunity for mental health care in the country, through the construction of a regulatory framework that incorporates new elements into the service model and provides financing guarantees to enhance capacity response of the health system. The specific objective of the project is to generate knowledge products that contribute to the discussion for the formulation of the comprehensive mental health bill and other necessary initiatives to improve the response of the health system in this area.

oper_nm: Support to the Preparation of the Innovation and Institutional Strengthening for Food Security Program
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation is to support the preparation of a future Program for Innovation and Institutional Strengthening for Food Security (CH-L1171), which will seek to strengthen the functions of MINAGRI to protect and monitor essential assets (sanitary, genetic and natural resources) for food security; provide better quality services to farmers, agro-exporters and food importers; and support the digital transformation of the Servicio Agrícola y Ganadero (SAG) and the Instituto Nacional de Investigaciones Agropecuarias (INIA). The TC will support the design of the Program, since it will make it possible to define the priority investments and create the necessary capacities for the supervision and evaluation of the main results (KPIs) that the Program would have. In turn, the TC will contribute to strengthening the MINAGRI's skills budget preparation process, by generating products that will make it possible to substantiate the need for certain investments, which is essential for MINAGRI to have the budgetary space to include the IDB program.

oper_nm: Reinforce the Global Services Agenda and Investment Attraction at the Sub-National level
objtv: Operation execution reinforcement and design of Phase II of operation CH-L1138 (Support program for the export of global services; 4362/OC-CH). This is mainly aimed at developing a new policy and institutional framework for investment attraction, with strong focus on developing opportunities at the subnational level. Furthermore, this Technical Cooperation (TC) also looks forward to support trade facilitation projects, like promoting actions related to achieving greater interoperability. The CT will help to complete operation 4362/OC-Ch by supporting the services export sector and the attraction of investment in Chile. The multiplicity of institutions participating in activities related to strengthening export capacities and attracting investment from the global services sector makes it essential to reinforce coordination efforts.

oper_nm: Support for the Preparation of the Program to Strengthen the Housing Emergency Plan and Containment of the Urban Deficit
objtv: This technical cooperation aims to support the Ministerio de Vivienda y Urbanismo (MINVU) of Chile in the preparatory activities of the loan Support for the Housing Emergency Plan and Containment of the Urban Deficit (CH-L1173), which seeks to contribute to the reduction of the housing deficit that Chile through the : (i) development of comprehensive strategies for the regeneration of neighborhoods and deteriorating property; (ii) promotion of the production of industrialized housing with low-carbon urban and social infrastructure and non-traditional construction systems through planning and implementation of institutional frameworks; and (iii) strengthening of design, planning and execution capacities, improvement of tools and innovation in the ministry's technological systems in housing and land management programs.

oper_nm: Support for the diagnosis and strengthening of the line of action on migration issues of the Housing Emergency Plan and Containment of the Urban Deficit.
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation is to support the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MINVU) of Chile in the preparatory activities for the implementation of the Plan de Emergencia Habitacional (PEH), especially in its dimension linked to the migrant population, through the PBR "Support for the Housing Emergency Plan and Containment of the Urban Deficit (CH -L1173)". This loan will contribute to the reduction of the housing deficit in Chile through (i) facilitating the collection and analysis of data flows and the housing deficit of the migrant population in order to improve capacity in the formulation of integration policies urban and social, and (ii) ensure access to housing for this target population.

oper_nm: Support for the citizen security and justice agenda in Chile
objtv: Contribute to the efforts of the Government of Chile to strengthen the capacity of the MISP in the management of public security, and of the MJYDH to provide better social reinsertion services to persons in conflict with criminal law. Specifically, this TC will make it possible to carry out the studies, diagnoses, and process and impact evaluations necessary to (i) modernize and consolidate the intervention model, including the differentiated programmatic offer; and (ii) strengthen the management mechanisms that facilitate the operation of the new SNRSJ.

oper_nm: Support Regional and Municipal Governments on Solid Waste Management and the Promotion of the Circular Economy
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to support the preparation and implementation of a results-based investment loan (PBR) to build capacity among Regional Governments (GORE) and Municipal Governments (GOM) in solid waste management and the promotion of the circular economy. Specific objectives include: i) supporting the Subsecretariat of Regional and Administrative Development (SUBDERE) in strengthening GOREs and GOMs (municipalities and associations of municipalities) in planning and coordination; and ii) capacity building for solid waste management and circular economy.

oper_nm: Emergency Support to Zones Affected by Fires
objtv: The objective of the operation is to support the Republic of Chile in the execution of humanitarian assistance actions in order to partially mitigate the emergency situation currently facing the affected area of the country, that is, in the regions of Ñuble, Biobío and the Araucanía. Said actions could include attention to essential needs; supplies, medicines, transportation, and other materials that allow the immediate needs of the population to be met. The acquisition of goods is contemplated for: (a) drinking water, food and basic necessities; (b) provide support in the provision of relief and transportation of said elements to the affected areas (for example, rental of transport equipment and fuel) and any other goods necessary to meet the basic humanitarian needs of the population affected by the emergency.

oper_nm: Fiscal Policy for Climate Change: Support to the Ministry of Finance of Chile
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the Chilean Ministry of Finance (MH) in the development of tools that promote the integration of climate action in its fiscal policy and management, mainly through the development of two tools: the definition of the structural elements for the elaboration of a Classification System of Environmentally Sustainable Economic Activities of Chile ("Taxonomy"); the implementation of a compensation system within the framework of the green tax (SCIV); and the development of energy efficiency levels for the implementation of a new tax on emissions.

oper_nm: Support for the Regional Productive Development Program of Chile
objtv: The main objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is the strengthening of Chilean financial institutions. For this, knowledge will be generated and training will be carried out for greater financial inclusion and risk reduction in the face of Climate Change (CC).

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange Brazil-Chile in Water Governance
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to facilitate the exchange of knowledge between the Government of Chile and the National Water Authority of Brazil on: i) water governance at the national and subnational levels; ii) development process of Basin Organizations/Councils; and iii) sustainability of rural water systems.

oper_nm: Accelerator of Efficient Technologies in Chile
objtv: The objective of the project is to support the financing of climate innovation startups in Chile through the Aster acceleration and financing program implemented in the Antofagasta Region.

oper_nm: Support to the Tourism Business Competitiveness Model
objtv: The objective of this TC is to improve the performance and resilience of the tourism characteristic activities (TCA), through support for the final design and deployment of the Chilean tourism business competitiveness model that is being conceptualized by the National Tourism Service (Sernatur).

oper_nm: Support the achievement of the country’s climate and biodiversity goals
objtv: The goal of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the achievement of the country's climate and biodiversity objectives, which are essential for meeting the targets set in operation CH-L1179, both in the first and second operations of the programmatic series. The specific objectives of the TC are: (i) to support the design and implementation of instruments derived from the Framework Law on Climate Change for climate planning at the sectoral and subnational levels; (ii) to strengthen the country's institutional capacity for climate action, sustainable development, and biodiversity protection; and (iii) to introduce policies that incentivize public and private investments in carbon-neutral and resilient initiatives.

oper_nm: Support for the Acceleration of Investment for Sustainable Development in Chile
objtv: The general objective of Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Ministry of Economy, Development, and Tourism in strengthening and implementing its investment streamlining plans for sustainable productive development. The specific objectives are: (i) to strengthen the tools for supporting sustainable productive development in Chile; and (ii) to improve the permitting processes to facilitate investments.

oper_nm: Support the Rapa Nui Water and Electricity Services Sustainability Program
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the preparation and implementation of the Rapa Nui Water and Electricity Services Sustainability Program (CH-L1182). The specific objectives are: (i) to finance the financial, technical, institutional, and environmental analyses required for the preparation of the program; and (ii) finance the engineering studies required to define the Program's investment portfolio.

oper_nm: Support the Transition Program Towards a Carbon Neutral and Resilient Economy
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation is to support the materialization of the policy measures included in the Transition Program towards a Carbon Neutral and Resilient Economy (CH-L1179), both in its first and second operation. The specific objectives are: (i) to support the policy measures associated with climate planning in all sectors and levels of government (national, regional, municipal); (ii) support the policy measures associated with the strengthening of climate and environmental institutions, specifically in terms of optimization of sectoral permits; and (iii) support policy measures associated with the introduction of regulations that incentivize public and private investments aligned with carbon neutrality and resilience.

oper_nm: Support for the Digital Transformation Strategy of the State of Chile
objtv: The objective of this TC is to contribute to the efforts of the Government of Chile to strengthen institutional capacities that accelerate the digital transformation of the State and finance key inputs for the development of key activities of operation 5758/OC-CH. Specifically, this TC will support the design and implementation of studies, plans and diagnoses aimed at strengthening enabling digital conditions in public entities.

oper_nm: Adaptation, implementation and evaluation of strategies for the prevention, investigation and prosecution of violent crimes in the context of organized crime
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the efforts of the key institutions of the security and justice system in the management, implementation and evaluation of key initiatives in the prevention and investigation of violent crimes in contexts of complex crime. Specifically, this TC will allow the studies, diagnoses, and process and impact evaluations necessary to: (i) improve the decision-making instruments of public security managers, driven by data and based on evidence; and (ii) modernize violence prevention and control models, through the generation of knowledge and empirical evidence.

oper_nm: Support for the subnational decentralization for carbon-neutral and resilient urban planning and resilience
objtv: Support the Undersecretariat of Regional and Administrative Development (SUBDERE) in carrying out activities that complement the implementation of loans CH-L1180 and CH-L1176 (5924/OC-CH), within the subnational decentralization process—covering Regional Governments (GORE), Metropolitan Areas, as well as local governments and their neighborhood-scale interventions. Both operations will foster inclusive and resilient urban planning and management by strengthening subnational teams and promoting the use of territorial planning instruments and local programs for decentralized infrastructure management.

oper_nm: Improved Efficiency of Public Expenditure through Public Procurement
objtv: The objective of the CT is to support ChileCompra, which has requested support from the IDB to improve the efficiency and transparency of public procurement spending through the strengthening of the State's public procurement system during the implementation of Law 21,634.

oper_nm: Supporting sustainable management of Chilean native forests
objtv: The TC aims to provide technical support to the National Forestry Corporation (CONAF) for the sustainable management of native forests in the regions of Los Ríos and Los Lagos, which cover 25.4% of Chile's national native forest area. This TC has 3 specific objectives: (i) support the creation of knowledge and capacity building for the native forest industry and landowners to incorporate climate change and biodiversity; (ii) support the design of climate change and biodiversity plans and forest management tools; and (iii) promote the incorporation of natural capital into decision-making.

oper_nm: National Public Account Forum: Promoting Transparency and Corporate Responsibility in Mining - Phase 2
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is the progressive implementation of the Forum National Sustainability and Public Accounts of Anglo-American Chile, in accordance with the guidelines established within the framework of the CH-T1265 project and within the framework of policy commitments public in the mining sector with the improvement of transparency and accountability.

oper_nm: Support for the productive, territorial and social development of the Magallanes Region
objtv: The objective of Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the generation of evidence for the design of public policies and the strengthening of capacities in the areas of sustainable development in the Magallanes and Chilean Antarctic Region (region Magellan).

oper_nm: Sustainable, innovative, and efficient Public-Private Partnerships in Chile: analysis, implementation, and evaluation of initiatives
objtv: Support and develop recommendations for strengthening the Chilean Concessions Program through the General Directorate of Concessions, in the identification, analysis, implementation, and evaluation of sustainable, innovative, and efficient concession initiatives.

oper_nm: Technical support for the preparation and execution of the Port Development Support Program in the Central Region of Chile - First Individual Operation
objtv: The objectives of the TC are to provide technical inputs to port companies that will support and strengthen the development of the project "Program for Port Development Support in the Central Region of Chile - First Individual Operation," through consultancies, analysis, and other studies.

oper_nm: Strengthening Investment, Data and Human Capital for the Global Services Sector in Chile
objtv: The aim is to support the design and execution of the CH-L1181 loan operation by strengthening the institutions and mechanisms related to investment attraction, data, and human capital for the global services sector in Chile. This will be achieved by meeting the specific objectives of: (i) modernizing the tools of specialized agencies to streamline investment attraction and export promotion processes, which require innovation and are linked to economic growth and productivity increases; (ii) gathering and analyzing data from the services sector to make adjustments to public policy supporting global services exports, a key sector in the country's productive agenda; (iii) streamlining training processes and developing specific human capital capabilities, which contribute to increasing the country's competitiveness and productivity.

oper_nm: Emergency support due to wildfire in Valparaiso Region
objtv: The objective of the CTE is to support efforts to mitigate the impact of the forest fire emergency on the population and address the resulting needs linked to humanitarian aid in the Valparaíso Region.

oper_nm: Ainwater: Optimizing water management for access to drinking water in rural areas
objtv: The objective is to improve drinking water management in rural areas through a digital platform based on artificial intelligence that allows (i) autonomous management of drinking water production for Rural Sanitation Services and (ii) facilitates decision-making in water management at the community and regional levels.

oper_nm: Startup Campus
objtv: The objective of the project is to launch and consolidate Startup Campus as the first space in Chile that brings together the offer of support for dynamic entrepreneurship and catalyzes the growth of startups with socio-environmental impact, based on science and technology and whose innovations contribute to combating the effects of climate change. This through access to infrastructure, laboratories and services aimed at their development and scaling, in order to achieve financial sustainability and socio-environmental impact.

oper_nm: Support for the implementation of Science, Technology and Innovation policies in Chile
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the strengthening of the capacities of the Ministry of Sciences, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation (MCTCI) of Chile for the implementation of public policy in the sector and to better address the challenges of decarbonization and adaptation to climate change. The specific objectives are: (i) to support the MCTCI in the implementation of three bills presented to Congress that seek to strengthen the sector; (ii) to support the MCTCI in the implementation and strengthening of the current agenda of technology transfer and science-based technology companies; and (iii) to support the MCTCI in its role as the Technical Secretariat of the Scientific Advisory Committee on Climate Change in the framework of the preparation of the second update of Chile's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC).

oper_nm: Strengthening the energy transition process and carbon neutrality of the electricity sector in Chile
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to contribute to the development of a reliable, affordable, sustainable, and resilient electricity sector through the conduct of studies that support the Ministry of Energy in Chile in the preparation of public policy projects and regulations that will help achieve decarbonization goals.

oper_nm: Support to Emergency for the Rains in Chile
objtv: Support Chile in the execution of humanitarian assistance actions to mitigate the impact of the emergency due to the effects of the frontal system on the population and address the resulting needs in the affected areas.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange in Revitalization of Historic Centers and Governance Models
objtv: Contribute to technical capacities and institutional strengthening based on innovation and knowledge exchange, rescuing successful experiences and learning, within the framework of the revitalization of historic centers and their governance models. In particular, the case linked to the experience of PROLIMA, the Municipal Program for the Recovery of the Historic Center of Lima, will be reviewed to understand the process, project and results, through interviews with key actors, and the comparison with the chilean experience in the matter.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange between SENASICA Mexico and SAG Chile for the design and implementation of a Health Intelligence Unit in Chile
objtv: Strengthen the design and implementation of an Intelligence Unit at the SAG in Chile, based on collaboration and exchange of experiences with SENASICA Mexico.

oper_nm: From Pilot to Scale: Evaluating the Expansion of Chile’s AI-Powered Teacher Induction Program
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the expansion of the virtual mentoring system in 2025 to meet the legal mandate of providing mentoring for all novice teachers and to conduct a rigorous evaluation to assess its effectiveness.

oper_nm: Strengthening the social security system
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the pension system reform process in Chile, in accordance with the guidelines established by Law 21.735. The specific objectives are: (i) to support the development and operational and technological transformation process resulting from the implementation of the reform, with an emphasis on the main changes that the Social Security Institute (IPS) and the Superintendence of Pensions (SP) will need to undertake; and (ii) to support the design and implementation of a public communication and pension education strategy aimed at informing citizens about the changes introduced by the reform, their benefits, and rights, with a special focus on women.

oper_nm: Support for Sustainable Construction in Chile
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is the institutional strengthening of the wood-based construction sector, particularly of the Ministry of Housing and Urbanism (MINVU) and the Production Development Corporation (CORFO), to promote sustainable construction in Chile. The specific objectives are: (i) to encourage the sustainable development of the wood and industrialized wood construction industry with a gender perspective to promote equitable participation in the sector; and (ii) to support the formulation of a sustainable bond and other instruments that guide the demand for wood-based social housing.

oper_nm: Support for the development and strengthening of institutional capacities for the management of public security and organized crime
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to strengthening institutional capacities for the management of public security, criminal prosecution, organized crime, and justice in Chile. Specifically, this TC will allow for the necessary studies, diagnoses, and evaluations to contribute to strengthening the Ministry of Public Security as the governing body in this area, and to decision-making in crime prevention and the fight against organized crime through the generation of timely and relevant knowledge and information.

oper_nm: Support the Digital Transformation and Sustainable Growth Program II
objtv: The overall objective of this Non-Reimbursable Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the implementation of the Policy Measures (PMs) included in the Digital Transformation and Sustainable Growth Program II. The specific objectives are: (i) to support the PMs associated with the specific objective of accelerating digital transformation; (ii) to support the PMs associated with the specific objective of accelerating the transition towards circular production models; and (iii) to support the PMs associated with the specific objective of promoting employment formalization.

oper_nm: Support the public sector modernization, digital transformation and the new data strategy of Chile
objtv: Contribute to the modernization of the Chilean public sector through the implementation of digitalization, data, and innovation strategies to improve the efficiency, transparency, and quality of public services. Specifically, this TC will continue supporting the implementation of the Digital Transformation Law, including data governance, and will help strengthen cybersecurity and the development of AI in the public sector. Additionally, it will promote innovation and government management initiatives and improve efficiency and transparency in public administration.

oper_nm: Knowledge exchange between Chile and Colombia on Metropolitan Governance based on the cases of the Bogota-Cundinamarca Metropolitan Area and the Aburra Valley.
objtv: Contribute to the technical capabilities of the Subsecretaría de Desarrollo Regional y Administrativo (SUBDERE) and representatives of the Regional Governments with the purpose of strengthening the development of metropolitan areas and the capacities to lead territorial transformation processes in the implementation of metropolitan governance models, public-private articulation and social urbanism, carried out through exploration and learning from the experience of Antioquía Department, Colombia.

oper_nm: Support to the Chilean Ministry of Agriculture for the execution of loan CH-L1171 through the use of new technologies
objtv: The objective is to support the Chilean Ministry of Agriculture (MINAGRI) in the implementation of the program Innovation and Institutional Strengthening for Food Security (CH-L1171) through the adoption of new technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and digital solutions.

oper_nm: Knowledge exchange between Chile-Colombia-Brazil of multi-sector groups in criminal prosecution of organized crime
objtv: Exchange of experiences to contribute to strengthen strategies for prosecuting organized crime crimes and deepening knowledge on the subject between Chile, Colombia and Brazil.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange between Chile and Costa Rica on youth violence prevention strategies
objtv: Exchange experiences on youth violence prevention strategies, specifically those combining state of the art infrastructure with evidence based interventions for youth in vulnerable communities.

oper_nm: Assessing the Impact of New Electronic Procurement Procedures in Chile
objtv: The objective of this proposal is to evaluate the impact of the new electronic procurement procedures on public procurement efficiency, competition and savings through the development of electronic tools for the simplified procedure "Agile Procurement" and Circular Economy.

oper_nm: Impact evaluation of Chile Global Services Export Program II
objtv: The objective of the CT is to finance the impact evaluation of some key dimensions of Operation 5969/OC-CH, ‘Chile Global Export Services Program II.' In particular, the evaluation will assess the impact of export promotion and investment attraction support on firms' international integration, as well as the impact of labor training programs on individuals' employability. Since the program is currently in the eligibility stage and is a continuation of Loan 4362/OC-CH, the evaluation will start with the latter, as the data and methodology to be used will be the same and will serve as a basis for subsequently updating the study once 5969/OC-CH is completed or sufficiently advanced to allow for its evaluation. This proposal was submitted to and approved by the Development Effectiveness Intelligence Fund (DEIF)

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange between Chile and Uruguay in Care Systems

oper_nm: Implementation of Free Trade Agreements and Seizing of Commercial Opportunities
objtv: The general objective of this TC proposal is to maximize Colombia¿s ability to take advantage of the market access opportunities in the high-value added services sector provided by the trade and investment agreements adopted by the country in recent years. As a result of the new generation of free trade agreements subscribed by Colombia in recent years (with, for example, the United States, the European Union, EFTA, Canada, and Peru), the country needs to improve its regulatory framework and institutional capacity to implement those agreements adequately and to seize the opportunities offered by the liberalization of trade, particularly in key sectors where there is value-added, such as services. Moreover, in the global offshoring services market, competition from the region and Asian destinations is gravitating towards the increasingly lucrative higher value services space. While Colombia has a robust Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) sector, especially in voice-based process, it can tap further into the global outsourcing market by expanding its services portfolio and focusing on the faster growing segments of Knowledge Process Outsourcing (KPO) and Information Technology Outsourcing (ITO). According to the Bank¿s estimates Colombia¿s offshoring industry can be worth USD 1.75 billion by 2014, out of which USD 700 million could come from the KPO sector (including USD 500 million in pharmaceutical services). By focusing on the KPO sector and the Colombian Government¿s Programa de Transformacion Productiva within the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Tourism, this TC seeks to support a loan operation (CO-L1094) aimed at both the development of innovative public policies to foster Colombia¿s competitiveness and the strengthening of its institutional capacity to seize the opportunities of the new trade agreements that boost the global services market. This loan is in direct alignment with the Bank¿s country strategy for Colombia: a) promotion and diversification of the exportable supply of offshoring global services in the segments of KPO, BPO and ITO; and b) strengthening of institutional technical capacity to implement and benefit from trade agreements (See, Chapter III, D, 3.15).

objtv:
The Technical Cooperation (TC) will support the implementation of a water resources management system for the large Magdalena River basin, and a support system for the monitoring of the navigable channel through the implementation of the IDB's model suite, called HydroBID. The information generated by the models will be fed into a geographic information system that will provide data for decision-making both at the level of the Magdalena River Basin and at the level of the sub-basins corresponding to the different autonomous corporations and local governments.

HydroBID will provide information on water quantity and quality, water balances, effects of climate change, land-use change from the operation of reservoirs on runoff flowing into the Magdalena River, while HydroBID Flood will provide hydrodynamic information on levels, velocities, and processes of erosion and sedimentation in the navigation channel, as well as information on the likelihood of flooding in areas of risk and contamination risks. Results produced by the HydroBID model will not only feed the Information system, but will also generate Information about the quantity of water that reach the navigation channel, which will help to predict variations related to reservoirs operation or precipitations that may occur along the watershed, this data will then be used by the HydroBID Flood model to produce detailed information related to water depths, which represent information of great importance for the navigation and also to assess the environmental conditions of the river.

The TC will be developed mainly under the guided implementation structure, through which teams of local technicians will develop the implementation of the models under the guidance and continuous supervision of specialists in the different areas, which will additionally guarantee the correct transfer of technology and knowledge.

oper_nm: Support for policy reforms for the social and economic inclusion of the Venezuelan migrant population in Colombia

(Condition 4.2.1). Description of the associated loan. This will give the tools to public institutions to adapt themselves to changes that energy transition is creating in the sector.

oper_nm: Support to contribute to a greater and more effective internationalization of the Colombian economy.

oper_nm: Amazonas Initiative: Investment Plan for Colombia within the framework of the Deforestation Containment Plan

The specific objective of the TC is to support the design of an Investment Plan under the framework of the AI-IDB that contributes to the Plan to Contain Deforestation in the Amazon region led by the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development

oper_nm: Support for the Implementation of the Multipurpose Cadastre in Colombia

oper_nm: Sandbox: Developing creative talent to diversify job opportunities in Colombia

oper_nm: Universities as engines of sustainable economic development of the Pacific region

oper_nm: Climate change and transport in Colombia : intermodality and new technologies
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the efforts to mitigate climate change in the transport sector in Colombia through the deployment of sustainable low-carbon and resilient transport infrastructure by supporting the Colombian government to promote and implement: (i) electric mobility, (ii) intermodal infrastructure, particularly rail and river modes, and (iii) sustainable urban mobility.

oper_nm: Support the Ministry of Health and Social Protection in the digital transformation of the health system

oper_nm: Conducive Financing Frameworks and Instruments in Sustainable Infrastructure in Colombia
objtv: The objective of this TC is to foster innovation within the financial system, by supporting the financial supervisor to consolidate sustainable infrastructure finance ecosystem in Colombia. The Program works on paving the way to eliminate all potential barriers that hinder bankability of a pipeline of sustainable projects. It will help to mobilize investment in infrastructure to achieve strong, inclusive, and balanced economic growth that will set Colombia on a more sustainable and inclusive development path.

oper_nm: Support for the digital transformation agenda in Colombia
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen institutional capacities to accelerate the digital transformation of the public sector in Colombia. In particular, this TC will support: (i) the identification of barriers and opportunities for the development of enabling capacities for digital transformation in public entities of the public investment management and control system; and (ii) the prototyping of solutions that accelerate digital transformation.

oper_nm: Strengthening of Strategic Management of the National Planning Department
objtv: To support the National Planning Department (DNP) in strengthening its management model, technical capacities and institutional coordination, in order to achieve greater efficiency and effectiveness, improving the results of the fulfillment of its functions and competencies. Specifically, it will accompany the process of reforming the structure of the entity promoted since the end of 2021 as a result of a strategic planning exercise carried out since 2019, which suggested the need to optimize its internal management. Such institutional modernization requires the strengthening of human capital as well as strategic processes.

oper_nm: Heal to Grow: Emotional Wellbeing and Mental Health in Early Childhood
objtv: It is imperative to understand the impact that the COVID-19 pandemic has had on the mental health of students, caregivers, and teachers, and identify solutions to support young children. Against this background, the objective of the proposed TC is to evaluate a program to support the mental and emotional health of young children (3-5 years of age).

oper_nm: Energy Efficiency for the Transition to Carbon Neutral Cities in Colombia
objtv: The general objective of the project is to contribute to reducing CO2 emissions by increasing energy efficiency in the construction sector, particularly in the cities of Barranquilla, Cali and Pasto, through the development of actions that involve different stages of the life cycle of buildings and interventions in public space.

oper_nm: Sustainable infrastructure standards and green finance for transport PPPs in Colombia
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to support the National Infrastructure Agency -ANI- and the Government of Colombia (GoC) in their efforts to promote sustainable infrastructure standards in the private-public partnerships (PPP) project portfolio, with an emphasis on climate change mitigation and adaptation measures, and to facilitate green finance schemes that incentivize private investments for the development of sustainable infrastructure in Colombia's transport sector.

oper_nm: Fiscal Policy for Climate Change in Colombia

objtv: Support the integration of climate change approaches in fiscal policy and management at the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit (MHCP), and in public investment management at the National Planning Department (DNP).

oper_nm: Institutional strengthening and results-based financing for better jobs in Bogota

oper_nm: Support for the Sectoral Innovation Ecosystem in Colombia
objtv: This technical cooperation aims to promote collaboration between public water and sanitation utilities (W&S) and local entrepreneurs in W&S to develop innovative solutions to the challenges in providing these services.

oper_nm: Strengthening gender equity, diversity, and inclusion programs and policies in Colombia
objtv: To support the implementation of policies, services, and programs related to the Public Policy on Gender Equity for Women (CONPES 4080) and the design and implementation of the National Care Policy. Specific objectives: (i) Strengthen gender-based violence prevention programs, and services for the promotion of women's autonomy in all their diversity; (ii) Promote the recognition, reduction, and redistribution of unpaid care work focusing on caregivers; (iii) Support the design and definition of social policies, the improvement of care services and strengthening information systems.

oper_nm: Innovative Fiscal Policy for Colombia
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Strengthen institutional capacities for the identification and elaboration of fiscal policy initiatives focused on fostering growth and fiscal sustainability, applying a solution-based approach.

oper_nm: Support the Colombian Ministry of Housing, City and Territory (MVCT) in the development of social housing prototypes for different climate zones and strategies to increase and/or improve housing in underserved areas
objtv: Support the Colombian Ministry of Housing, City and Territory (MVCT) in the development of social housing prototypes for different climate zones and strategies to increase and/or improve housing in underserved areas. The specific objectives are: (i) propose differentiated housing schemes that respond to the needs of low-income people and in accordance with regional characteristics associated with climatic and cultural conditions, promoting gender equity and diversity, as well as the formation of new low-carbon, sustainable and resilient households; (ii) identify key aspects that allow the feasibility of developing differential housing projects with emphasis on municipalities in categories 4, 5 and 6 and in rural areas; and (iii) identify housing solutions that contribute to improve or expand housing according to the needs identified by region.

oper_nm: Informal City: Urban Models in Colombia - Barrios de Paz Program
objtv: Support the Ministry of Housing, City and Territory (MVCT) in the design of pilot programs for the Barrios de Paz program in municipalities historically affected by the armed conflict.

oper_nm: Digital Connectivity Plan for the social and productive transformation of Colombia
objtv: The general objective of this operation will be to support the design and implementation of a Digital Connectivity Plan for the social and productive transformation of Colombia that will increase access to and meaningful use of digital connectivity. In order to fulfill the general objective, the following are defined as specific objectives: (i) identification of infrastructure needs in areas without Internet access, which allow the connection of homes, public institutions (educational centers, health centers, Government, etc.), and of the strategic points for the productive matrix of Colombia, (ii) identification of the main digital skills to be developed to increase the significant use of digital connectivity, with a gender approach, and (iii) scheme of the necessary institutional framework, of the necessary regulatory and policy reforms to facilitate access to digital connectivity, with a gender approach. Support the design and implementation of a Digital Connectivity Plan for the social and productive transformation of Colombia that allows increasing access and significant use of digital connectivity.

oper_nm: Support the development of Primary Health Care Services in the Colombian Amazon Region
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Ministry of Health and Social Protection (MSPS) in implementing a program to improve access to health services for vulnerable populations. Specifically, the TC will focus on supporting: (i) the design of special primary health care guidelines for Indigenous populations and other communities with a significant presence in the Amazon; (ii) the development of a strategic plan to strengthen primary health care in the Amazon; (iii) the pilot project to assess the connectivity and interoperability capabilities of public hospitals in the Amazon with public hospitals across the country; and (iv) a plan to enhance digital health services and telemedicine for public hospitals.

oper_nm: Promotion of Institutional Capacities Towards Greater Gender Equity and Diversity in the Financial Sector in Colombia

The CT would contemplate activities to improve institutional capacities, strengthen financial product design efforts, improve financial autonomy, support the development of a better evaluation of current programs and contribute to a better formulation of policies in the public financial system.

oper_nm: Support for the Gender and Transparency Agenda in the Justice and Citizen Security Sectors in Colombia

oper_nm: Support for the development of policies to increase access to quality and equitable higher education

oper_nm: Support for the energy transition in the Amazon
subsector_nm: ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND RENEWABLE ENERGY IN END USE

oper_nm: Support the Energy Cities initiative in Colombian cities

oper_nm: Support for intermodal transport policy in Colombia
subsector_nm: LOGISTIC PLANNING, MULTIMODAL TRANSPORT AND LOGISTIC PLATFORMS
objtv: Promote the development of resilient infrastructure projects in Colombia and foster multimodality as a mechanism to promote territorial convergence and the consolidation of peace processes. In particular, it will support the Government of Colombia in: (i) the inclusion of climate resilience components in the planning and design of transportation infrastructure projects; and (ii) the strengthening of capacities and technical regulations to encourage investment and improve the efficiency of air, rail, maritime and river transportation modes.

oper_nm: Labor inclusion program for migrants and host population in transportation non-conventional jobs
objtv: Promote the economic integration of migrants and host populations in the District of Bogota, in non-conventional urban mass transportation jobs.

oper_nm: Prevention of gender-based violence in municipalities with a high presence of ethnic groups
objtv: Support the formulation and implementation of instruments for the prevention and treatment of gender-based violence with an ethnic and territorial approach for indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, and peasants of the Colombian Amazon.

oper_nm: Support for the design of the Program to Strengthen Equality Policies in Colombia (PBL)

The cooperation will focus on providing assistance to ensure compliance with policy measures related to: i) prevention and comprehensive care for Gender-Based Violence; ii) mainstreaming gender and sexual diversity approaches for the equity of women and the LGBTQ+ population; iii) strengthening the normative and operational framework for the implementation of the National Care System.

oper_nm: Support for the redesign of cash transfer programs

oper_nm: Integral rural development strategy with a focus on gender

oper_nm: Management model for a sustainable tourism development in Colombia

oper_nm: Just transition, green jobs and gender perspective in the framework of climate change policies in Colombia
objtv: Support the Government of Colombia in the design and implementation of policy tools, development of case studies or pilot projects for the incorporation of just transition and green jobs approaches in sectoral climate change policies, within the framework of E2050 and the NDC, ensuring a gender perspective.

oper_nm: Institutional strengthening for the formulation, implementation and monitoring of mission-oriented Research, Development and Innovation policies

oper_nm: Support for the design and implementation of innovative solutions to boost productive transformation

oper_nm: Support for the Program for Sustainable and Equitable Fiscal Policies

oper_nm: Support for the institutional strengthening of the Bicentennial Group
objtv: The general objective of the CT is the institutional strengthening of the Bicentennial Group (GB) in order to increase the coordination and alignment of public financial institutions of the country with the development objectives of the national public policy and the sustainable development objectives (SDGS). The specific objectives of the CT are: (i) Strengthen the GB governance structure as a public financial conglomerate; (ii) develop GB business strategies and public financial institutions that integrate it; and (iii) generate knowledge and lessons learned about the contribution of GB institutions to reach SDGs.

oper_nm: Support for the Strengthening of the State Data Infrastructure
objtv: The main objective of this technical cooperation is to support the Government of Colombia in the strengthening of governance and the construction of the IT infrastructure (Data Center) necessary to improve the administration, storage, availability and sovereignty (security) of State data, that guarantees the massification of State public services to citizens and massifies the use of information exchange systems between public entities through the creation of the Government Private Cloud.

oper_nm: INDII Fund - Indigenous Fund Capitalized By Natural Capital Token In The Colombian Amazon
objtv: The proposed solution is the implementation of a prototype for the tokenisation of natural capital in the Colombian Amazon. The Indii token is a non-fungible token whose initial value is based on the valuation of the natural capital of a hectare of Amazonian forest present in the indigenous reserves.hectare of Amazonian forest present in the indigenous reserves. By means of marketing campaigns, the general public will beincentivised to buy Indii tokens linked to the improvement of the living conditions of the indigenous communities and the conservation orrestoration of the ecosystems of the Amazon biome. The purchase of these tokens offers the public the possibility of making financial contributionstraceable financial contributions to projects developed by the communities.

oper_nm: Support for strengthening the institutional capacity of public management
objtv: Support the strengthening of public management through strategic activities prioritized by the new administration, and provide technical assistance to strengthen and consolidate transparency platforms in Colombia.

oper_nm: Energy Transition Roadmap Implementation
objtv: Support the development of activities that will provide baseline information on the energy situation for the definition of a program of interventions in the Colombian Pacific Coast (LPC).

oper_nm: Guidelines for mitigation and adaptation to climate change articulated with risk management for resilient Land Use Management Plans
objtv: To increase the local level capacity building for climate action, focused on vulnerability reduction, by developing a set of policy guidelines to implement adaptation and mitigation measures of climate change articulated with risk management for resilient Land Use Management Plans of the municipalities and regions of the country

oper_nm: Enhancing the market for biodiversity credits through the implementation of digital tokens under an integrity protocol
objtv: This proposal seeks to capitalize the insights gained from Habitat Banking and the mandatory biodiversity credits model to create a new, reliable, and high integrity product that combines the concept of biodiversity credits with digital tokens. This product will ensure greater traceability and transparency, enabling a more efficient and accountable conservation efforts.

oper_nm: Renewable Energy Integration - support to green hydrogen projects
objtv: Provide technical assistance to accelerate the country's clean and inclusive energy transition, by supporting the development of green hydrogen projects that will contribute to the decarbonization of difficult-to-electrify sectors.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange between Chile and Colombia on Programs to Promote Access to Higher Education and Guarantee Quality
objtv: Support the exchange of experiences between Chile and Colombia regarding programs that promote the immediate transition of vulnerable youth from secondary school to higher education.
envmntl_clssfctn_nm: Likely to cause minimal or no negative environmental and associated social impacts

oper_nm: SOCIAL IMPACT BONDS, PHASE II: Scaling Up Results Based Finance Interventions in Peru and Colombia
objtv: The objective is to aim at fostering and mainstreaming outcome-based finance in mainly in Peru, and Colombia, with potential interventions in other IDB borrowing countries.

oper_nm: Innovative Urban Storm Drainage Systems in Colombia: a differential approach to manage extreme events caused by climate change considering planning, gender, and sustainability aspects
objtv: The main objective of this TC is to address the implementation of the Sectoral Strategic Plan for Urban Storm Drainage in Colombia (PESDU), in accordance with the results of the Plan prepared in 2022 , in an innovative way. The TC will: i) implement innovative tools and technologies in two municipalities to identify technologies to prevent, measure, and manage urban drainage; ii) include new variables and sectors to consider in the integral management of urban storm drainage, such as adaptation to climate change, urban and territorial planning, sustainable infrastructure (gray, green, and blue), and gender; iii) align the technical and regulatory aspects to promote the implementation of new technologies for urban drainage; iv) use of projects and the link with regulation at the national level, considering the approach of proven technologies and enabling conditions in the country.

oper_nm: Caquetá Native Species Seed Bank
objtv: The objective of Amazonía Emprende with the project "Native Seed Bank of Caquetá" is to improve the scalability of ecosystem restoration in the Colombian Amazon and contribute to climate change mitigation by increasing the availability and supply of plant material (seeds/seedlings) of native forest species.

oper_nm: Promotion of the digital industrial ecosystem at the subregional level in Colombia - Strategy for capacity building of the Guatiguará Technology Park, Santander
objtv: The general objective of this project is to provide technical support to the National Planning Department to promote the development of the digital industry in Colombia through the Strengthening of the Guatiguará Technology Park (PTG). This TC will help develop the preparatory work for the design of a strategy to strengthen said technology park. The strategy and its implementation will be developed starting in 2024 within the framework of cooperation from the Government of South Korea through the Korean Technology Parks Agency (KTPA). Under this initiative, non-refundable support is provided for an amount of up to US$ 7 million to promote the digital industrial ecosystem in Santander, one of the most strategic departments in Colombia for the development of the digital industry.

oper_nm: Support for the Integration of Migration Information in Colombia
objtv: The TC aims to enhance data interoperability and management for an efficient and secure exchange of migration information among entities that produce or consume related data, supporting evidence-based policies and decision-making processes for migrants' and host communities' socioeconomic integration. The TC will contribute to the consolidation of an integrated migration information system in Colombia in the short and medium term. Its specific objectives are to: (i) facilitate the interoperability of migration information among various systems and entities, as well as the interinstitutional coordination for agile, timely, and secure management of interchangeable information; and (ii) strengthen existing digital tools and institutional capacities to ensure that the information exchanged is accurate and up to date.

oper_nm: Support for the Implementation of the National Care System
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation is to support the Ministry of Equality and Equity in the implementation of the National Care System. The specific objectives are: (i) develop and pilot caregiving training programs; (ii) develop guidelines for coordinating healthcare and long-term care; and (iii) support the inclusion of persons with disabilities (PwD).

oper_nm: Climate action at the subnational level in line with Colombia's NDC and LTS
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen capabilities for climate action and biodiversity conservation at the subnational level in Colombia, in line with the decarbonization and climate adaptation goals and priorities established in the country's Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC) and Long-Term Climate Strategy (E2050).

oper_nm: Support for the implementation of the Reformulated Multipurpose Cadastre Program
objtv: Institutional strengthening of the central government institutions responsible for implementing the Multipurpose Cadastre in Colombia, in particular DNP, IGAC, ANT and SNR. This will be achieved by providing operational support to loan CO-L1164, "Program for the Adoption and Implementation of a Rural-Urban Multipurpose Cadastre", which is in the process of being reformulated and extended and has the objective of improving land management in Colombia by implementing a multipurpose cadastral system that includes institutional and technological strengthening of the responsible agencies, which will increase the legal certainty of land tenure, strengthen fiscal management, and ensure more effective land-use planning.

oper_nm: Promotion of women's bio-economy initiatives in the Colombian Amazon
objtv: The general objective is to design and implement a training and mentoring program for women entrepreneurs in the bio-business sector in the Colombian Amazon. The specific objectives are: (i) Strengthening of leadership, production and business skills for women entrepreneurs in bioeconomy; (ii) Strengthening the voice and agency of women in the bioeconomy.

oper_nm: Bioeconomy in the Amazon: enabling environments, policy development and institutional strengthening
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to support the development of public policies and technical instruments that enable the competitive development of the bioeconomy in the Amazon region of Colombia, in coordination with subnational governments at the departmental level. The specific objectives of the TC are: (i) to strengthen policy frameworks on bioeconomy as a sustainable development alternative; (ii) to support the development of value chains that enhance the bioeconomy in the Amazon region; and (iii) to promote the strengthening of institutional capacities and knowledge management related to bioeconomy chains. It focuses on working with the departments of Guaviare, Putumayo, and Guainía.

oper_nm: Support the development of the IDB Clima pilot project in Colombia
objtv: Support the implementation of the IDB CLIMA Pilot Program Roadmap (IDB CLIMA Roadmap) in Colombia, within the framework of the credit operation CO-L1287 with the Financiera de Desarrollo Nacional (FDN). To achieve this objective, the TC will support: (i) complementary activities required to meet the targets of the Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) linked to the IDB CLIMA reward; and (ii) activities that contribute to the advancement of climate and biodiversity ambition and capacity building in other areas of intervention identified in the IDB CLIMA Roadmap.

oper_nm: Support for the execution of Lines 1 and 2 of the Bogotá Metro.
subsector_nm: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (BUS / TRAIN / CABLE). INFRASTRUCTURE AND EQUIPMENT
objtv: Support the execution of the Bogotá Metro Line 1 and Line 2 projects, through technical, financial and managerial support to strengthen social, environmental, technical and risk management, in order to guarantee the correct construction of the metro network in the city.

oper_nm: Support for Colombia's cybersecurity and digital government agenda
objtv: The objective of this TC is to strengthen the institutional capacities to accelerate the digital transformation of the public sector and the development of the digital safety in Colombia.

oper_nm: Support for the institutional strengthening of the mining and energy sector
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen institutional capacities that accelerate the digital transformation of the mining and energy sector in Colombia. In particular, this TC will support the strengthening of: (i) the institutional and technical capacities of the digital transformation of the mining and energy sector for the Just Energy Transition based on the INTEGRAME tool and, (ii) the operational capabilities of the digital transformation of the mining and energy sector from the use and appropriation of the INTEGRAME tool.

oper_nm: Strengthening Guatiguará Techno-Park (GTP) for enhancing the IT sector in Colombia
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the Information Technology (IT) capabilities of Guatiguará Techno-Park (GTP), a strategic actor/asset for the articulation and development of the digital industrial ecosystem in Santander, Colombia. Santander is one of Colombia's most strategic departments for the development of the IT sector due to their capabilities of research, development and the use of specialized human capital in relation to the rest of the country. The project will (i) provide and install high-tech IT equipment and utilities to guarantee the access of Colombian firms to cutting-edge technology, (ii) strengthen IT human capital and management capabilities of the GTP, (iii) support SMEs, startups and entrepreneurs in the IT sector and the strengthen their capabilities to adopt and use emerging digital technologies; and (iv) Strengthen international cooperation in the IT field between the Republic of Korea and Colombia.

oper_nm: Support to Bancoldex for the Execution of the Loan Programs under the CCLIP for Business Development in Colombia
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen Bancóldex's institutional capacity for the development of new products and innovative financial solutions, with a focus on credit inclusion, productive modernization, and environmental sustainability. The specific objectives are: (i) to develop new financial products for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs), focusing on financial inclusion, productive modernization (innovation and digitalization), and the environmental sustainability of production; (ii) to develop new solutions to support bioeconomy enterprises in the Amazon region; and (iii) to expand its portfolio of financial products for women and diverse populations. The TC will also support Bancóldex's institutional capacities to: (i) align its portfolio with the Paris Agreement; and (ii) improve data collection and impact evaluation of its interventions with the Bank.

oper_nm: Support for the development of policies and programs to improve access and graduation in secondary education
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to support the design of strategies to improve access and graduation in secondary education (SE) in Colombia.

oper_nm: Technical and logistical support for the preparation and execution of the CBD's COP16 in Colombia
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development (MADS) in the technical and logistical coordination for the preparation and execution of the 16th meeting of the Conference of the Parties (COP16) to the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) convene in Colombia between October and November 2024, and its corresponding protocols: the 11th Meeting of the Parties (MOP) to the Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety (CP-MOP-11) and the 5th MOP to the Nagoya Protocol on Access to Genetic Resources and the Fair and Equitable Sharing of the Benefits Arising from their Utilization (NP-MOP-5). In the technical aspects of COP16, the IDB will support MADS in positioning innovative financial instruments for biodiversity conservation.

oper_nm: The Way of the Panther
objtv: The objective of the project, "El camino de la Pantera", is to promote the generation of sustainable economic opportunities in the Colombian Amazon through a program of awareness, training, financing and support for bio-businesses.

oper_nm: VIVE AMAZONAS: TOURISM, COMMUNITIES, TECHNOLOGY AND CONSERVATION
objtv: The objective of the project is to promote nature tourism as an alternative for sustainable development in the Colombian Amazon, by strengthening the capacities of local nature tourism organizations, with conservation and environmental restoration initiatives, measuring the social and environmental impact of these organizations, monitoring biodiversity and connecting with high-value markets through technology.

oper_nm: Design and Evaluation of Skills Certification Programs for Migrant Workers in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: This technical cooperation aims to evaluate the effectiveness of IDB-funded operation CO-L1250, designed to improve migrants' employability by mitigating informational gaps with skills certification.

oper_nm: Support to the Bicentenario Group to Channel Financing to Projects in the Colombian Amazon
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the institutional strengthening of the PFIs of the Bicentenario Group (GB) to improve their contribution to channeling more public and private resources towards projects in the Colombian Amazon that favor the fulfillment of the Objectives of Sustainable Development (SDG). The specific objectives of the TC are: (i) generate synergies between the PFIs of the GB; (ii) support the preparation of high-impact projects in the Amazon; (iii) develop financial products adapted for the bioeconomy; and (iv) strengthen the national and regional dialogue of the financial sector.

oper_nm: Science, Technology, and Innovation Districts as drivers of productivity and growth of Colombian cities
objtv: This TC aims to provide specialized technical support to the cities of Bogotá and Medellín to guide the effective and sustainable implementation of the Science, Technology, and Innovation (STI) tools and services of their Innovation Districts (ID). To achieve this, the follow specific objectives are: (i) support the cities in defining service offer, instruments, and incentive schemes to promote entrepreneurship and business innovation in their IDs; (ii) strengthen the capabilities, instruments, and models for planning, articulation, and multilevel governance of their IDs; and (iii) create spaces for dialogue and exchange of experiences, and promote the transfer of good international practices to inform the implementation of the districts in the cities of Bogotá and Medellín.

oper_nm: NODOS: Sustainable Development and Opportunity Clusters
objtv: The objective of the project is to provide technical and technological strengthening for the viche production chain led by low-income, Afro-descendant women in the rural areas of Buenaventura for building and expanding their businesses.

oper_nm: Knowledge exchange on new instruments to promote and finance innovation and S&T-based entrepreneurship
objtv: To share and transfer knowledge from the Chilean experience with financing innovation, promoting science and technology-based entrepreneurship, implementing testbeds and regulatory sandboxes for new technologies, and managing innovation districts, which can inform strategies for deploying Innovation Districts in the cities of Bogotá and Medellín.
