objtv: The objective of the operation is to support Peru in the execution of humanitarian assistance actions in order to partially alleviate the emergency situation currently facing the affected area of ​​the country, that is, in those districts of the Departments of Amazonas, Cajamarca , Loreto and San Martin where the State of Emergency was declared. Such actions could include attention to essential needs; provisions, medicines, transportation, and other materials that allow meeting the immediate needs of the population.

oper_nm: Strengthening Sustainable Value Chains of Native Communities in the Peruvian Amazon.
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the capacities of the indigenous community of Belgica, located in the Madre de Dios region next to the border with Brazil, for its insertion in the dynamics of regional sustainable development and transfrontier integration. This TC will contribute to improving the quality of life of families in the community of Belgica, who face high levels of poverty and malnutrition.

oper_nm: Energy Transition and Universal Access Program for the Peruvian Amazon
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to provide support to the Peruvian Government in identifying and developing public investment projects in order to achieve a universal and sustainable access to electricity by 2030

oper_nm: Proinversion health sector PPP Projects preparation
objtv: Support Proinversión in all activities related to the transaction phase of two specialized hospitals in Piura and Chimbote structured under the PPP scheme.

oper_nm: Design of the Road Infrastructure Program for Regional Competitiveness 2 (PROREGION 2)
objtv: Finance pre-investment studies, specific component studies for the design of the Road Infrastructure Program for Regional Competitiveness 2 (PROREGION 2)

oper_nm: Humanitarian and Environmental Emergency Assistance to Overcome the Oil Spill Crisis in Peru
objtv: The objective of this action is to support the necessary activities to alleviate the emergency situation currently faced by the population living in the coastal areas severely affected by this oil spill.

oper_nm: Support for management transformation and digitization of the public administration
objtv: The general objective will be to support the implementation of Peru's Digital Transformation Agenda with the purpose of coordinating government initiatives related to the use of digital technologies, with a focus on economic development, digital inclusion of all Peruvians and the construction of an efficient and citizen-centered government.

oper_nm: Humanitarian Assistance for the rains in the Department of Cajamarca, Peru
objtv: The objective of the operation is to support Peru in the execution of humanitarian assistance actions in order to partially alleviate the emergency situation currently facing the affected area of ​​the country, that is, in those districts of the Department of Cajamarca where the State of Emergency was declared. Such actions could include attention to essential needs; provisions, medicines, transportation, and other materials that allow meeting the immediate needs of the population.

oper_nm: Sector Market Booster- Energy: Market transition to low carbon and energy efficiency technologies
objtv: The three main objectives are to (1) develop a road map for the energy transition to a low carbon sector in Peru in line with the decarbonization long term plan (2050) and the country's low carbon strategies, (2) review and analyze the alternatives for the introduction and promotion of private participation in the development of new nonconventional renewable energy sources into the energy matrix resulting from the energy transition roadmap, and (3) to support the Ministry of Energy and Mines (MINEM) in promoting the creation of a market of certified energy auditors and disseminating the benefits of carrying out energy audits and the implementation of the proposed improvements.

oper_nm: Sustainable Infrastructure to Municipal Wastewater Treatment
objtv: The objetive of the TC is to support SEDAPAL and the MVCS : 1) in updating the current wastewater infraestructure design regulation, 2) in developing project pre-factibility studies for sustainable WWTP and , 3) in improving the eneregy efficiency for SEDAPAL system.

oper_nm: Support Program for Sustainable Urban Transport in Lima and Callao
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to design short- and medium-term actions that will improve mobility and transportation in Lima and Callao in a sustainable manner. Among the actions, it is planned to intervene in the mass bus transportation of the complementary corridors, including the design of infrastructure improvements, as well as the analysis of new business models and electromobility solutions that promote the reduction of greenhouse gas emissions. Furthermore, technical assistance will be provided to the Urban Transportation Authority for Lima and Callao (ATU) for the monitoring of the Urban Mobility Plan (PMU) for Lima and Callao.

oper_nm: Protect education trajectories of children and youth through tutoring and mentoring with a focus on gender in Peru.
objtv: Protect the trajectories of vulnerable children and youth in Peru between 9 and 14 years old and help recover the learnings lost due to school closures generated by the sanitary crisis of COVID19. This would be achieved by providing alternative education mechanisms such as personalized tutoring and mentoring that help increase the level math achievement which will reduce inter-anual drop-out rates and promote progression rates.

oper_nm: Promote alternative financing to MSMEs through a “micro-investment crowdfunding” platform in Peru
objtv: The proposed solution aims to deploy a "micro-investment crowdfunding" platform, an alternative financing scheme in the Peruvian financial sector, for channeling a massive number of Peruvian individuals' micro-investments to finance Peruvian MSMEs, and thereby to contribute to financial inclusion.

oper_nm: Digital Identity for Small Nondigital Rural Producers
objtv: The objective of the project is the creation of an open platform of commercial articulation built on the AGROS Digital Identity (solution currently deployed in the LACCHAIN network) that works without the need for internet, integrating a digital identity wallet for noninternet, integrating a digital identity wallet for non-digital users (using voice as the control interface), which will as a control interface), which will make family farmers visible by generating verifiable blockchain proofs of their verifiable evidence in blockchain of each farmer's information, facilitating the linkage with agro-exporting companies by agro-exporting companies by sharing information on the status of their crops, production experience and facilitating the "Duefacilitating the process of "Due Dilliegence" in the commercial articulation.

oper_nm: Structuring and Implementing investment projects in infrastructure through Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs)
objtv: Strengthen the capacities in the structuring and implementation of infrastructure investment projects under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) mechanism, considering the best practices and lessons learned.

oper_nm: Fiscal Policy for Climate Change: Support to the Ministry of Economy and Finance of Peru
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The objective of the project is to support the Ministry of Economy and Finance of Peru in the integration of climate action in its policy and fiscal management. To achieve this objective, this TC will finance three types of actions: (i) development of a framework for financial transparency and fiscal management for climate change; (ii) support for the implementation of green fiscal management instruments and methodologies; and (iii) dissemination of knowledge and exchange of good practices.

oper_nm: Promotion of Territorial Development in the Mariscal Ramón Castilla Border Province
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to elevate the levels of competitiveness of the fishery value chain in the province of Ramón Castilla, through the consolidation of associative structures, thus reinforcing their integration into the dynamics of regional sustainable development and border integration. This will be achieved through the management of sustainable production and marketing models of Amazonian fish species and their derivatives, that address the challenges inherent to formal and legal production in risk contexts. This TC will contribute to revitalizing the local economy and, consequently, improve the quality of life of the families of fishery producers on the border of the province Ramón Castilla.

oper_nm: Innovative Pilot Project for the Provision of Water and Sanitation Services for SUMQ WASI Rural Homes in Peru
objtv: The objective of this project is to implement an innovative pilot to improve access to safe water and sanitary disposal of excreta for families that have access to the SUMAQ WASI modules and thus, comply with SDG 6 and raise the standard of quality of life for families affected by frost or cold temperatures (above 3.500 meters above sea level), with economic and sustainable technological options.

oper_nm: Support for the development of integrated urban projects: innovation for urban intervention strategies
objtv: The Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the Ministry of Housing, Construction and Sanitation (MVCS) in the design and implementation of urban intervention strategies that promote social integration, urban regeneration and climate risk management, with a focus on vulnerable neighborhoods.

oper_nm: Support for the Strengthening of Peru's Social Protection System
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the restructuring and improvement of the Social Programs of the Ministry of Development and Social Inclusion (MIDIS), through the financing of activities that contribute to the management of the Programs, with emphasis on the expansion and quality of the provision of services, and in improving information management.

oper_nm: Strengthening bilingual intercultural education strategies in teacher training institutes
objtv: Strengthen Bilingual Intercultural Education training strategies that the Ministry of Education of Peru offers to two public teacher training institutes located in the Department of Madre de Dios and Cusco.

oper_nm: Supporting the inclusion of women and diverse groups in bioeconomy initiatives
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to design and implement a program to train women entrepreneurs in bio-business skills and business, promote access to financial opportunities, and align with strategies for preventing violence against women and family members. To achieve this, immediate and specific activities identified by indigenous and community associations in the territory will be implemented to reduce, from some urban and rural centers, certain gaps in financial access and gender-based violence, and possibly human trafficking.

oper_nm: Strengthening strategies to prevent and act against racism and discrimination in Peru: indigenous peoples, afro-peruvians, migrants and LGBTQ+ population.
objtv: Improve tools for reporting, prevention and response to cases of racism and discrimination in Peru with a differential approach for indigenous people, Afro-Peruvians, migrants and LGBTQ+ population

oper_nm: Support the reform agenda to improve Peruvian trade facilitation services through its Single Window for Foreign Trade
subsector_nm: TRADE FACILITATION, TRADE LOGISTICS AND CUSTOMS
objtv: The objective of the CT is to support the execution of the Program for the Improvement of Foreign Trade Facilitation Services through the Single Window for Foreign Trade (VUCE), Second Stage (PE-L1159). The specific objectives are to strengthen institutional technical capacities needed for the operation of new functionalities of the Single Window, and ensuring compliance with the activities of the loan contract.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation of Program for the the provision of Water, sanitation and urban drainage services for Juliaca, Puno
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation (TC) is to support the Ministry of Housing, Construction and Sanitation (MVCS) in the preparation of studies for the preparation and implementation of the Program for the the provision of Water, sanitation and urban drainage services for Juliaca, Puno. The projects included in the loan will be aligned with the Sanitation National Plan and the circular economy principles to decrease greenhouse gases emissions.

oper_nm: Energy transition in the Peruvian Amazon: Iquitos
objtv: The objective is to develop a proposed energy transition roadmap for the city of Iquitos that identifies the main activities to become a zero carbon city by 2050, and thus contribute to meeting Peru's greenhouse gas reduction goals.

oper_nm: Strengthening the capacities of the Centers for Productive Innovation and Technology Transfer (CITE) of the Peruvian rainforest for the articulation of Amazonian bioeconomy value chains
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation (TC) is to support the ITP in strengthening the capacities of the network of Innovation and Technology Transfer Centers (CITE) located in the Peruvian Amazon to articulate and enhance the value chains of the Amazonian bioeconomy.

oper_nm: Support for the cultural heritage management in historic centers
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Ministry of Culture (MINCUL) and the subnational governments involved in the revitalization of the Historic Centers (CH) in Peru, through the preparation of technical and operational inputs that allow them to develop strategies to achieve a greater impact with their interventions. Specifically, the TC will strengthen the cultural heritage management capacities of MINCUL and the Municipalities of Rímac (Lima) and Huamanga (Ayacucho) in operational, social and knowledge management issues, as well as in the definition of new administrative procedures that will speed up the execution of works considering the recent regulatory changes for the Historic Center of Lima.

oper_nm: Strengthening the management of health investments.
objtv: The Technical Cooperation (TC) seeks to support the implementation of the investment loan operation Program to Create Integrated Health Networks (4726/OC-PE), through the strengthening of the process of execution of investments in health with a focus on integrated networks.

oper_nm: Supporting the implementation of the Sustainable Infrastructure National Plan for Competitiveness (PNISC) and Institutional Strengthening to the implementation and execution of Sustainable Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) in Peru
objtv: Strengthen the planning and management capacities at the national and sub national level to accelerate and optimize the execution of infrastructure projects and to promote low carbon and climate resilient infrastructure.

oper_nm: Critical minerals for the energy transition: integrated development in mining regions of Peru
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: Supporting the Ministry of Energy and Mines and primarily the Regional Government of Cajamarca in the sustainable development of critical minerals for energy transition through reducing territorial development gaps, strengthening participatory processes for strategic planning, and implementing prioritized infrastructure projects with a focus on strategic water resource management.

oper_nm: Support for the improvement of transversal public management systems: procurement, planning, digital services and rule of law
objtv: The main objective of the technical cooperation is the improvement and development of good public management in Peru through the strengthening of institutional capacities of key state agencies for the functioning of the state apparatus such as the Strategic Planning Center of the Presidency of the Council of Ministers (PCM), the Ministry of Finance (MEF) and other public entities in the management of supply systems, planning, digital services, and others. Likewise, this TC intends to reinforce the different initiatives that are in a germinal state and that will be essential for the modernization of the State and the strengthening of the Rule of Law.

oper_nm: Blockchain Integration for Custody of Nature by Rural Residents of Peru
objtv: The proposed project aims to provide digital identity to rural custodians of biodiversity and implement a system of selective incentives to improve their quality of life and preserve nature.

oper_nm: Participatory and Climate-Informed Decision Support Systems: Enhancing Water Resource Planning and Climate Action in Peru
objtv: The TC aims to support Peru's long-term climate resilience and low-carbon development by implementing adaptation and mitigation (A&M) pilots in the water, energy, and transportation sector stipulated in the sectoral TPs and the NDC. Likewise, the project will support the achievement of the NDC's enabling conditions by generating information about climate vulnerability, current and future water conditions of priority basins, providing technical training, and piloting financing mechanisms. The project will directly influence the implementation of national and regional policies to increase the adoption of A&M measures while working within the parameters of the NAP and NDC mandates to direct public and private funding streams toward the sustainable implementation of A&M measures in vulnerable basins. The project aims to showcase a science-based, climate-informed methodology to design, evaluate and implement A&M measures that will enable key stakeholders to replicate this methodology and implement further A&M measures in the future.

oper_nm: Humanitarian Assistance for population affected by Cyclone Yaku in Peru
objtv: The objective of the operation is to support Peru in the execution of humanitarian assistance actions to partially alleviate the emergency situation currently facing the affected districts in the departments declared in a state of emergency due to the heavy rains triggered by cyclone Yaku in the central and northern zone of the country.
envmntl_clssfctn_nm: Likely to cause minimal or no negative environmental and associated social impacts

oper_nm: Measuring the effectiveness of a low-cost post-secondary non-formal education program on advanced digital skills
objtv: The objective of this non-reimbursable technical cooperation (TC) project is to generate knowledge for the region about the effectiveness of non-formal post-secondary education programs in advanced digital skills, generally known as "coding bootcamps". Specifically, it will seek to measure the impact of a bootcamp with a high potential to be scalable given its low cost.

oper_nm: SOCIAL IMPACT BONDS, PHASE II: Scaling Up Results Based Finance Interventions in Peru and Colombia
objtv: The objective is to aim at fostering and mainstreaming outcome-based finance in mainly in Peru, and Colombia, with potential interventions in other IDB borrowing countries.

oper_nm: Sustainable Infrastructure for Water and Sanitation Services
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute with the implementation of measures for adaptation and mitigation of the impacts of climate change in infrastructure projects of water and sanitation sector in Perú, particularly desalination plants (DP) and wastewater treatment plants (WWTP).

oper_nm: Modernization of Services to users of the Pension Normalization Office (ONP) for the improvement of the pension system
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the Peruvian Government's efforts to improve the services provided to users of the Oficina de Normalizacion Previsional (ONP) in order to offer its mission services through accessible channels and with adequate quality standards.

oper_nm: Building the State capability to support the scaling up of small rural entrepreneurs in Peru
objtv: The objective of the TC is to strengthen government capabilities to provide effective enterprise support services in existing government programs to help rural entrepreneurs in Peru achieve sustainability and scale up.

oper_nm: Support for the Bus Operation System Initiative in Huancayo, through PROMOVILIDAD Program
subsector_nm: DEMAND MANAGEMENT AND CONTROL OF URBAN TRANSPORT SYSTEMS
objtv: The objective of this TC is to design a Bus Management System (BMS) and enhance the governance of public transportation in the metropolitan area of Huancayo (AMH) to make public transportation more competitive and attractive and to reduce social cost associated with inefficient car mobility.

oper_nm: Support for the strengthening of Peru's Digital Infrastructure
objtv: The main objective of this technical cooperation is to support the strengthening of Peru's digital infrastructure, with the aim of improving the governance and availability of the IT infrastructure (Data Center) necessary to improve the administration, storage, availability and sovereignty (security) of the State's data, which guarantees the innovation of the State's public services to citizens and the use of information exchange systems between public institutions.

oper_nm: Support in strengthening the capacities of Provias Descentralizado
objtv: The objective of the TC is to support the strengthening of Provías Descentralizado (PVD) capacities for improving the management and execution of projects carried out by the entity, through training in technical, procurement, and socio-environmental aspects.

oper_nm: Modernization of the immigration services of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
objtv: Support the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in strengthening its capacity to provide migration services and processes, by improving its processes through the structuring of an interoperable technological system, called the Single Migration Management System of Peru.

oper_nm: Support for developing innovative financial instruments for biodiversity and climate change mitigation and adaptation through tourism
objtv: Support the design of innovative financial and institutional instruments for the tourism sector, in order to optimize tourism's contribution to the biodiversity conservation goals established by Peru in its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs).

oper_nm: Design of a pilot program for payment by results in Employment for vulnerable people
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Government of Peru (PE) to improve job placement opportunities for vulnerable people, with emphasis on young people, women and People with Disabilities (PwD). The specific objectives are (i) to design the conceptual and operational model of a results-based financing pilot for the Ministry of Labor and Employment Promotion (MTPE); and (ii) ensure that the key legal and financial elements for the proper implementation of the pilot are considered during its design.

oper_nm: Support for the development and consolidation of an adaptive social protection approach to multi-hazard shocks
objtv: The objective of this operation is to support the development and consolidation of an adaptive social protection approach in Peru, through the support to the implementation of a guiding framework for Emergency Social Protection (PSAE), led by the Ministery of Development and Social Inclusion (MIDIS), and the development of analytical tools for disaster risk management to promote adaptive social protection, in coordination with National Center for Estimation, Prevention and Disaster Risk Reduction (CENEPRED).

oper_nm: Support to improve the quality and delivery of medical support services
objtv: The objective of the TC is to support MINSA in the implementation of prioritized Medical Support Services (SMA) with quality and efficiency. Specifically, the project aims to: (i) design instruments to ensure the provision of SMA with quality; and (ii) generate local evidence and knowledge for the implementation of centralized SMAs. Additionally, this TC will support the development of some products planned in the roadmap for the implementation of the SMA Central.

oper_nm: Support improving the quality of early childhood care services in Peru
objtv: Contribute to improve the quality of early childhood care services in Peru. Specifically, the project seeks to: (i) inform decision-making for the expansion of early childhood care services; and (ii) improve the skills of those responsible for early childhood care services.

oper_nm: Support for the Deepening of Fiscal Reforms
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Support the continuous strengthening of public finance management in Peru through the development and implementation of tools and reform proposals to improve efficiency in budget management, public investment, and the tax system. In this sense, the specific objectives include: (a) designing mechanisms to ensure a budget with credible limits, aligned with strategic priorities and results-oriented; (b) designing tools to improve efficiency in revenue management for financing public expenditure; and (c) developing a long-term vision, with efficient programming and execution of public investment.

oper_nm: Promote the mobilization of funds for conservation and sustainable forest management in the Peruvian Amazon through a REDD+ system
objtv: The objective of the CT is to support the Ministry of Environment (MINAM) in implementing the nested approach in Peru for Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation (REDD) projects and to enable the conditions for financing public and private projects for sustainable forest management and conservation in the Peruvian Amazon.

oper_nm: Peruvian Amazon investment plan and development challenges
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (CT) is to support the development of the Peruvian Amazon Region through regional investment plans. Specifically, it will involve identifying public investment priorities with a territorial focus in at least one region of the Peruvian Amazon and proposing governance arrangements to implement these investments. This aims to enhance sustainable and inclusive development opportunities for the region and address current threats such as deforestation and illegal crops.

oper_nm: Strengthening of the innovation ecosystem in Peru
objtv: The objective of technical cooperation is to support the strengthening of the agents and services linked to the quality infrastructure of the innovation ecosystem through the implementation of courses on R&D&I (management and economics) and the carrying out of studies on the quality infrastructure services implemented by the National Program for Technological Development and Innovation (PROINNOVATE).

oper_nm: Strengthening the Network of Science and Technology Clubs in Peru
objtv: The objective of technical cooperation is to support the National Council of Science, Technology, and Technological Innovation (CONCYTEC) in strengthening the national network of Science and Technology Clubs (CCyT) in Peru, in order to promote scientific vocation and STEM (as known in English) competencies among regular basic education students (EBR), with the aim of developing qualified human capital in the fields of science, technology, and innovation in the future.

oper_nm: Carry out PPP Americas 2025
objtv: The objective of this TC is to organize the PPP Americas 2025 event. The event aims to promote private sector participation in the provision of quality infrastructure services, serving as a platform to foster collaboration between key actors from the public and private sectors in the planning, financing, and execution of projects. Direct interaction facilitates the exchange of ideas, knowledge, and opportunities for the development of public-private partnerships.

oper_nm: Cultivating Prosperity: Harnessing AI for Resilient Farming Communities
objtv: The project's objective is to improve the productivity of Peruvian smallholders and promote the adoption of climate-smart practices through an innovative soil analysis solution, piloting a sustainable and scalable business model.

oper_nm: Master Plan for the Development of the Peruvian Railway to 2050
objtv: The objective of this TC is to elaborate Master Plan for the Development of the Peruvian Railway to 2050 with a sustainability approach.

oper_nm: Support for the Program to Promote Social Housing in Peru
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the implementation of the Social Housing Promotion Program (PE-L1293) in order to facilitate access to adequate, formal, and sustainable housing for low-income households.

oper_nm: Supporting the Digital and Sustainable Transformation of Banco de la Nacion
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacity of Banco de la Nación (BN) in Peru to accelerate its digital transformation. The specific objectives include: (i) strengthening the BN's institutional capacities through knowledge sharing and the identification of good practices from other Public Development Banks (PDBs) in digital transformation processes; (ii) technically supporting the execution of Operation 5965/OC-PE, which includes the development and implementation of a methodology to monitor and evaluate the digital transformation process; (iii) developing a decarbonization plan, optimizing the reduction of Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions associated with the BN's digital transformation, in line with global sustainability goals; (iv) promoting sustainable economic growth by strengthening the digital capacities of the public financial sector, enabling a more efficient and secure provision of financial services for citizens and businesses; (v) reducing inequality and promoting financial inclusion by improving access to formal banking services for vulnerable populations through the digitalization and modernization of BN operations; and (vi) disseminate the main findings and lessons learned during the execution of the CT and the loan operation, strengthening continuous learning and process improvement in future interventions.

oper_nm: Support the Sustainable and Productive Rural Electrification Program in the Peruvian Amazon
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to support the preparation of the Sustainable and Productive Rural Electrification Program in the Peruvian Amazon (PE-L1298), through the development of the necessary technical and socio-environmental studies. The specific objectives are: (i) to finance the technical analyses for the program's feasibility; and (ii) to finance engineering and complementary studies required to define the program's investment portfolio.

oper_nm: Support for the identification and structuring of public-private synergies for environmental assets in the Peruvian Amazon
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the identification of public-private synergies for the sustainable management of natural parks in the Peruvian territory of the Amazon Basin and to support the structuring and implementation of Public-Private Partnership (PPP) projects in these sectors. The technical cooperation will focus on these objectives by supporting the following activity: (i) support for the structuring of private participation projects in natural parks and conservation units with services related to public use and visits.

oper_nm: Tackling Corruption with Artificial Intelligence. Lessons from Peru
objtv: The objective of this TC is to provide evidence on how AI can be integrated into complex government organizations to enhance effectiveness in controlling corruption.

oper_nm: Integral and Sustainable Alternative Livelihoods: Transition to Diversified Agricultural Production in the Province of Mariscal Ramón Castilla, Department of Loreto
objtv: Implement community development nodes, focused on the bi-national border integration and the management of productive landscapes, to improve food security, generate economic surpluses, restore degraded ecosystems, adopt sustainable environmental practices and integrate social dynamics that are oriented towards healthy lifestyles.

oper_nm: Knowledge Exchange on Financing Mechansims for Social Housing
objtv: The objective of this TC/INTRA is to facilitate the exchange of knowledge between Peru's MIVIVIENDA Fund (FMV) with the Ministry of Housing, City and Territory (Minvivienda) and the National Housing Fund (FONVIVIENDA), on policies, financing mechanisms and large-scale social housing projects. Specifically, this technical cooperation will support the FMV's visit to Colombia to deepen knowledge about the operation of FONVIVIENDA and the social housing policies being implemented in the country

oper_nm: Support for the intelligent transport systems implementation on subnational roads
objtv: The objective of this TC is to improve the sustainability of the maintenance activities of the Feeder Road Corridors (CVA) executed by Provías Descentralizado (PVD) and to support the future transfer of these corridors to the Regional Governments (GORE).

oper_nm: Support for the design and implementation of the Program for the Sustainability of the River Transport Model in the Amazon (PE-L1294)
objtv: The Technical Cooperation (TC) has the main objective of supporting the design and implementation of the loan operation PE-L1294: Program to Support the Sustainability of the River Transport Model in the Amazon, which is currently under preparation. This support will finance complementary environmental and social impact studies, studies to improve and optimize the program's interventions in logistics, accessibility, and the provision of essential services, designs for river docks, and studies on cross-cutting issues that will be incorporated into the program, such as gender, diversity, and digitalization.

oper_nm: Support for the identification and structuring of public-private partnerships in the Peruvian Amazon
objtv: To support the identification of public-private synergies for the promotion of strategic water and sanitation infrastructure projects in the Amazonian region.

oper_nm: Supporting the capacity building of the leaders of users of the Project Expansion and Improvement of Drinking Water and Sewerage Services of the City of Juliaca - Puno
objtv: The objectives of this Technical Cooperation are: i) to strengthen the communication and social participation programs of the Provincial Municipality of San Román (PMSR), the District Municipality of San Miguel (DMSM), the Ministry of Housing, Water and Sanitation (MHWS) and the Sanitation Services Provider Company (SSP) Sedajuliaca and, ii) improve government strategies and citizen co-responsibility associated with water and waste management, recycling and participation and good coexistence among residents in the city of Juliaca.

oper_nm: Support for the design and piloting of a multisectoral intervention proposal for the Amazon region.
objtv: The objective of the CT is to design and pilot the multisectoral intervention proposal for the Amazon region through the adaptation, innovation, and coordination of health services, social protection, early childhood development, education, and productivity in the territory. It seeks to create synergies among the government, civil society, and the private sector. This includes both the design and evaluation of the intervention, with an emphasis on the necessary governance at the national, regional, and local levels to ensure its sustainability.

oper_nm: Support for the Comprehensive Improvement Project for Reintegration Services of the Peruvian National Penitentiary System
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the process of transformation and modernization of social reintegration services in Peru, through the strengthening of the institutional capacities of MINSJUSDH and INPE, specialized technical assistance, transfer of knowledge and best practices from regional and international experiences, to improve the offer of social reintegration services of Persons Deprived of Liberty (PPL) into society.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation and implementation of the program to expand coverage and improve the quality of early childhood services
objtv: Strengthen the preparation of the loan for the expansion of coverage and improvement of the quality of early childhood services in Peru (PE-L1297) through studies and technical assistance.

oper_nm: Support for the design and implementation of the Modernization and Strengthening of Primary Health Care in ESSALUD Program (PE-L1296)
objtv: Strengthen the preparation of the loan operation 'Program for the Modernization and Strengthening of Primary Care in EsSalud' (PE-L1296). Specifically, the Technical Cooperation will support the execution of pre-investment and diagnostic studies necessary to advance the preparation of the operation under the Invierte.PE regulations.

oper_nm: Support for the repositioning of strategic, sustainable and impactful agricultural public services in Peru
objtv: This project aims to reposition Peru's main agricultural and livestock services. To promote sustainable agricultural development, partnerships will be encouraged with the private sector as well as with regional and municipal authorities. Additionally, the project will promote institutional coordination through public-private collaboration mechanisms and with subnational governments, strengthening the cooperative model. As a complement, the project seeks to enhance the capacities and skills of key officials.

oper_nm: Support for the Peruvian energy transition process based on the strengthening of electric grids and user empowerment
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support public electric distribution companies in addressing the challenges of energy transition and digitalization, focusing on companies in the Amazon.

oper_nm: Support for the design of strategies to improve the effectiveness of fiscal management in Peru
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to contribute to strengthen institutional capacities to enhance the effectiveness of fiscal interventions in Peru through technical support and training aimed at the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF).

oper_nm: Support to promote Peru's productive internationalization
subsector_nm: TRADE AND INVESTMENT AGREEMENTS AND REGULATIONS
objtv: The overall objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to support the Government of Peru in implementing a reform agenda aimed at fostering a more competitive internationalization of the country. This objective will be achieved by providing technical assistance to: (i) promote the design, coordination, and execution of policy measures, programs, and strategies aimed at strengthening the productive internationalization of the Peruvian economy, including the National Multisectoral Foreign Trade Policy (PNMCE), the National Competitiveness and Productivity Plan (PNCP), among others; and (ii) support the strengthening of technical capacities within the sectors involved in the implementation of public policies for productive internationalization.

oper_nm: Strengthening technical skills of students from full-day secondary schools (JEC)

oper_nm: Support to improve employment services
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the Ministry of Labor and Labor Development (MITRADEL) with the strengthening of the employment programs and services that it offers and to facilitate the formal labor insertion of people, in particular those in a situation of vulnerability. The specific objectives are to contribute to: (i) improving the design of the services and programs offered by MITRADEL; and (ii) identify good international practices on the role of public employment services to increase employability and respond to the talent needs of companies.

oper_nm: Improvement of Sanitary Sewer Systems and Wastewater Treatment in Reverted Areas – Corregimiento de Ancón
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to carry out the diagnosis, studies and conceptual design for the Sanitation Project of the Reverted Areas of the Panama Canal Zone.

oper_nm: Support for the execution of water and sanitation operations in Panama
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to provide specialized technical assistance to IDAAN for the improvement and increase of access and quality of water and sanitation services. This technical assistance supports the execution of the IDAAN Operational Management Improvement Program in the Metropolitan Area of Panama 4434/OC-PN.

oper_nm: Support for technical transformation to promote the energy transition in Panama
subsector_nm: ENERGY INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING AND CAPACITY BUILDING
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the transformation of technical training in Panama, through a training program in clean energy, in particular electric mobility (ME) and distributed generation (DG), to be implemented through an itinerant mobile classroom, to promote the country's energy transition with the participation of the private sector. The program will be focused on testing re-training mechanisms in new capacities on ME and DG in people who work in traditional areas of the energy sector, and who, if their skills are not reconverted, could be displaced by the introduction of new technologies related to the energy transition.

oper_nm: Support to the implementation of social inclusion programs for persons with disabilities in Panama
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation is to support the implementation of social programs aimed at the inclusion of persons with disabilities developed by the Program to Support the Social Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities in Panama.

oper_nm: GO-ON Boss: Towards a Dignified, Diverse, and Green Last-Mile Delivery Sector
objtv: The objective of the project is to launch GO-ON Boss, a model with environmental, economic and social impact for the economy of platforms and SMEs in Panama that will promote innovation in the last-mile delivery services sector with electromobility, WorkerTech strategies, promotion of diversity and use of data.

oper_nm: Blockchain and Precision: Innovating with farmers in the rice chain in Panama
objtv: The objective of the project is to pilot together with 100 producers a "precision" production system based on science, technology, innovation, and the application of good official rice practices (Nationally Appropriate Mitigation Actions - NAMA) that will: i) increase producer profitability ii) reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 40% and capture between 13,200 tCO2 equivalent that can be transformed into carbon credits as additional income for producers.

oper_nm: Support for labor inclusion through the strengthening of skills
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation (TC) is to support the Instituto Técnico Superior Especializado (ITSE) to improve its knowledge about the barriers to the labor inclusion of youth and women, such as skills and training gaps, and policies management of human talent in companies that are not compatible with inclusion and gender equity.

oper_nm: Support to the establishment of a national care system in Panama
objtv: The technical cooperation supports the development of a care system in Panama with a gender approach, through the following activities: (i) support for the design of the institutionality of a care system in Panama that recognizes, reduces and redistributes the task of care between women and men, in the areas of early childhood care, personal assistance to people with disabilities, long-term care for the elderly in a situation of dependency; (ii) analysis of population aging and of the existing services for dependent care for the elderly, including a gender perspective in both the analysis of demand and supply; (iii) support for the impact evaluation of a pilot of care services for the elderly with dependency and its effects on female labor participation (implemented in the context of operation PN-L1177).

oper_nm: Support for labor formalization and strengthening of the pension system in Panama
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support and contribute to the formalization of the labor market and strengthen the pension system institutions in Panama by providing technical support to the improvement of the operational and strategic management of the Social Security Fund (CSS). This TC will finance actions that support the CSS to: (i) improve the operational management capacity of the pension system, particularly the individual accounts component, with a digital transformation approach, (ii) implement the new functional and operational structure of the Specialized Technical Investment Unit of the CSS, (iii) draft a diagnosis and recommendation of a new functional and operational structure of the CSS Loan Center.

oper_nm: Support the development and strengthening of foundational skills in programs PN-L1143 and PN- J0001
objtv: Support the Ministry of Education (MEDUCA) of Panama in strengthening the technical aspects for the execution of components 2 and 3 of the Program for Improving the Efficiency and Quality of the Educational Sector (PN-L1143) and the Program for the Improvement of Efficiency, Quality and Inclusion of the Educational Sector of Panama (PN-J0001). The specific objectives are: i) to promote the development of foundational skills from primary to secondary school through the efficient use of resources from Components 2 and 3 of the operations, as well as carrying out the follow-up and support required by MEDUCA and the Education Division; ii) support operations PN-L1143 and PN-J0001 to achieve the desired objectives defined in Components 2 and 3; and iii) contribute to the preparation of technical notes that support the government in identifying priority areas for future interventions.

oper_nm: Support to promote solar renewable electricity generation in Panama
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to promote the sustainability of the Panamanian electricity sector, through the development of solar renewable electricity generation in Panama. The specific objectives are: (i) demonstrate the feasibility of promoting distributed solar generation through a subsidy redirection program; (ii) the development of a national solar microgrid program, integrated into the national universal access plan.

oper_nm: Digital solutions for transparent information management and agile processes in the agricultural sector
objtv: The general objective of the proposed TC is to contribute to increasing the economic, social, environmental and climatic sustainability of Panamanian agriculture, through a more efficient and transparent management of information and processes in the sector.

oper_nm: Support for Prioritized Water and Sanitation programs in The Panama Canal Basin
objtv: The objective of the TC is to support the Panama Canal Authority (ACP) in designing, executing, and implementing the water and sanitation projects prioritized in the Indicative Land Management Plan (PIOTA) for the Canal basin.

oper_nm: Support for development of financing models for public infrastructure and transport logistics and for public transport decarbonization in Panama
subsector_nm: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (BUS / TRAIN / CABLE). INFRASTRUCTURE AND EQUIPMENT
objtv: The objectives of this TC are: (i) the development of business models that enable the combination of public and private resources for the financing of public and logistics infrastructure that Panama requires to boost its economic reactivation; (ii) design comprehensive mobility projects that include the replacement of public transport fleets by electric vehicles, as well as increasing the transport infrastructure resilience.

oper_nm: Panama's Climate Risk Atlas Interactive Platform
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to provide technical assistance to the government of Panama to advance the climate change and environmental sustainability agenda. To achieve this objective, the TC will identify gaps in information systems related to mitigation and adaptation to climate change and critical actions to operationalize the commitments established in Nationally determined contributions (NDCs) that contribute to complying with the Paris Agreement.

oper_nm: Support for the empowerment and access of diverse populations to differentiated service models
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Government of Panama in advancing the closing of gender gaps and diverse populations. This will be done by strengthening the Ministry of Social Development (MIDES) and the Social Cabinet in their capacities to (i) capture and analyze data from a gender and diversity perspective and (ii) mainstream a differentiated approach in services and regulations aimed at diverse beneficiary populations, giving particular emphasis to women, indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, people with disabilities and LGBTIQ+ people for equity in the provision of public services to said diverse populations.

oper_nm: Supporting the digital transformation of the National Migration Service of Panama
objtv: Contribute to the technological transformation of the National Migration Service of Panama, in order to support the processes of registration and data management of migrants, and strengthen consular services for the attention of the population in conditions of human mobility.

oper_nm: Strengthening of the agricultural sector of Panama (II)
objtv: The general objective is to contribute to the economic, social and environmental sustainability of the Panamanian agriculture. oper_nm: Operational support to the Customs Logistics Integration Program
objtv: Strengthen the management and execution capacity of the Customs Logistics Integration Program to (i) facilitate the adoption of inter-institutional and binational processes that guarantee operational efficiency at border crossings; (ii) strengthen institutional capacities to address equitable border requirements that allow the promotion of best international practices and in accordance with the Bank's policies, and (iii) accompany sustainable and orderly management in the communities surrounding the border crossings.

oper_nm: Support to the digital transformation of Panama public administration and services
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the development of the institutional framework and capacities of the AIG and the OJ to contribute to strengthening the Government of Panama in the digital transformation of its administration and public services.

oper_nm: Support to the Government of Panama to Design a Fiscal Consolidation Program

objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to the fiscal sustainability of Panama. oper_nm: Support to the Comprehensive Project for Electromobility and Increasing the Resilience of the Public Transport Infrastructure of Panama City

The specific objectives are: (i) support for the institutional restructuring of urban mobility in the MAPC; (ii) strengthening the management of transportation demand and optimizing the public bus transportation system; and (iii) improving institutional management capacities regarding mitigation and adaptation measures for the effects of Climate Change (CC), gender equity, and diversity.

oper_nm: Support for the development of mass transportation projects in Panama City - Extension of the Panama Metro Lines and San Miguelito Aerial Cable
subsector_nm: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (BUS / TRAIN / CABLE). INFRASTRUCTURE AND EQUIPMENT
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the planning process of the master network of the Panama metro, updating in the first phase the socioeconomic and mobility database for the Metropolitan Area of Panama (Districts of Capira, Chorrera and Arraiján, in the province of Panamá Oeste, and the districts of Panamá, San Miguelito and Chepo, in the province of Panama), by carrying out a Mobility Survey that incorporates a new tool into conventional methodologies that uses data on the geographical position of mobile phone users.

oper_nm: Support for the consolidation of the National Logistics Strategy in Panama
subsector_nm: LOGISTIC PLANNING, MULTIMODAL TRANSPORT AND LOGISTIC PLATFORMS
objtv: The general objective is to contribute to Panama's competitiveness through improvements in logistics that allow activity diversification to strengthen its position as a world's interoceanic logistics Hub. The specific objectives are: (i) to promote improvements in transport logistics to generate more favorable competitive conditions for the main export value chains, integrating local economies in these chains; and (ii) to generate logistics capabilities of the institutions that are responsible for the main export value chains.

oper_nm: Support for the modernization of the management of the Comptroller General of the Republic (CGR) through the use of ICT
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the institutional transformation of the Office of the Comptroller General of the Republic of Panama (CGR). In this regard, it will contribute to strengthening CGR's management through the use of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) to enhance efficiency and transparency in the performance of its functions. Specifically, it seeks to: (i) strengthen CGR's digital management capabilities to optimize its institutional performance; and (ii) support the creation and financing of the necessary conditions and key inputs for the implementation of the Comptroller's digital transformation agenda.

oper_nm: Support for the development and strengthening of foundational skills of the Programs PN-L1143 and PN- J0001
objtv: This TC aims to support the Ministry of Education of Panama by strengthening its foundational skills intervention and developing technology-based solutions to enhance the monitoring and evaluation plans for the programs "Improving the Efficiency and Quality of the Educational Sector" (PN-L1143) and "Improvement of Efficiency, Quality, and Inclusion of the Educational Sector of Panama" (PN-J0001). The specific objectives are: (i) support Aprendamos todos a leer (ATAL's) pedagogical implementation in Panamá and identify scalability challenges to share lessons regionally; (ii) adapt and implement fluency and monitoring technology-based solutions for early literacy skills assessment in Spanish; and (iii) evaluate the implementation of ATAL in Panama to be replicated in other countries.

oper_nm: Support for the strengthening of Panama's social protection system and community-based ECD programs in Panama
objtv: The objective of the technical cooperation is to support the strengthening of Panama's social protection system' through improved targeting capabilities, and improvement in early childhood development services through the design, cultural adaptation, implementation and evaluation of "Cuidarte", a community-based early childhood development program. The TC supports the execution of the "Social Inclusion and Development Program Fase II" (PN-L1177).

oper_nm: Support for the development of sustainable and resilient storm drainage infrastructure in Panama City
objtv: Support the MOP in updating hydraulic models, technical studies, and environmental assessments necessary for the tendering of prioritized drainage works related to the Urban Resilient Basin Program (4434/OC-PN; PN-L1150), as well as in conceptualizing an early warning system and analyzing critical flooding points in the AMP.

oper_nm: Knowledge exchange to support the Semiconductor Value Chains in Panama and Costa Rica

oper_nm: Empowering Youth through Music and Culture

oper_nm: Strengthening the Panama's institutional capacity in preparing and supervise PPP contracts
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the Government of Panama (GoP) in preparing and supervising PPP contracts. oper_nm: Support for the Competitiveness and Sustainability Program for the Resilience of the Tourism Sector in Panama - Phase II
objtv: This operation will continue providing technical support to the Government of Panama to achieve the policy measures identified in the potential second program of the PN-L1175 programmatic series (PN-L1187), an operation supported by this technical-cooperation operation. This TC will allow a technical in-depth study of the laws, regulations, action plans and strategies that are expected to be promoted with the second loan operation in order to contribute to improving the competitiveness of the Panamanian tourism sector.

oper_nm: AI-Tutoring Is All You Need: An RCT on the Educational Promises of Large Language Models
objtv: The objective of this TC is to validate the hypothesis that Artificial Intelligence (AI) tutoring positively impacts Panamanian students' reading skills and Panamanian teachers' Aprendamos Todos a Leer (ATAL) adoption and AI tools.

oper_nm: Support for the integration and improvement of health services in Panama
objtv: Support the Ministry of Health of Panama (MINSA) and the Social Security Fund (CSS) in the functional integration of health services to improve their coverage, quality, and efficiency. oper_nm: Preparation of the prefeasibility studies of the Integral Solid Waste Management Project of the Panama District and San Miguelito
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is (i) to support the Government of Panama (GoP) in preparing the pre-feasibility studies of the Integral Solid Waste Management Project of the Panama District and San Miguelito and (ii) present the Initial Technical Report to the PPP Governing body for approval.

oper_nm: Mainstreaming Climate Change into Territorial and Sectoral Planning in Panama
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to provide technical assistance to the Government of Panama (GoP) to integrate climate change considerations into territorial and sectoral planning, through the harmonization and strengthening of existing regulations, as well as the development of capacities at the sectoral and territorial levels. This technical cooperation aims to integrate land management with climate change adaptation and natural resource management, aligning public policies and fostering inter-institutional synergies. At the sectoral level, it seeks to support the design and construction of resilient infrastructure that can withstand extreme climate events.

oper_nm: Strengthening the management and efficiency of the postal system in Panama
objtv: Strengthen the design capabilities of modernization actions for the Panamanian postal system to improve the conditions that enable the promotion of e-commerce in Panama.

oper_nm: Strengthening applied innovation management at the Institute for Scientific Research and High Technology Services
objtv: Strengthen INDICASAT's institutional capacity to improve the commercialization of its scientific and technological services, optimize its infrastructure and equipment, and consolidate its financial sustainability. oper_nm: Strengthening competitiveness management and the business environment to boost the semiconductor industry in Panama

oper_nm: Strengthening of the Guarantee Fund of Panama

oper_nm: Improving opportunities for organic sugarcane farmers in Paraguay
objtv:
The Opportunities for the Majority window approved a Loan of up to US$3 million to the Cooperativa de Producción Agroindustrial Manduvirá Limitada (¿Manduvirá¿, ¿CM,¿ or ¿the Cooperative¿), a producer and credit cooperative in Paraguay focused mainly on the production and marketing of organic cane sugar. The Cooperative has approximately 1,700 members, the vast majority of whom are at the base of the socioeconomic pyramid. It is located in Arroyos y Esteros District (67 km from Asunción), a rural area with approximately 22,000 inhabitants. Of these, 6,000 live in the town and 16,000 in small villages in the surrounding area.
CM's primary mission is to support its members in the production and marketing of their crops and to offer a number of other support services, such as financial and technical assistance, agricultural training, and medical and education programs. CM has more than 15 years of experience with organic agriculture, and exports certified organic and Fairtrade sugar to more than 17 countries (mostly in Europe but also to the United States, Canada, New Zealand, and South Korea).
The main objective of this project is to enhance the competitiveness and boost the revenues of CM and its members through support for the construction and start-up of the Cooperative¿s own organic sugar-processing plant.
Increasing consumption of organic products in recent years has led to growth in demand for CM's highly valued organic sugar. However, the Cooperative has been unable to fully meet this demand as it operates from a rented plant with limited capacity. This has not only prevented it from tapping into existing demand, but member competitiveness has also been affected by high transport costs resulting from the considerable distance between the plant and crop areas.
The new plant, which will be situated close to the crop areas, is expected to solve the problems that have curtailed profits, hindered growth, and prevented the Cooperative from meeting existing levels of demand. In addition to its direct impact on Cooperative members, the project is also expected to benefit more than 800 families that participate in harvesting, post-harvesting, and logistics activities related to the new plant.

oper_nm: Support to the Strengthening of Public Enterprises Oversight and Transparency
objtv:
The objective of this technical cooperation is to strengthen the supervision and accountability of the PAs of Paraguay, in order to promote transparency and efficiency in the management of PEs.

Public Enterprises (PEs) play a key role in the world economy, with 10% of the world's largest companies, in terms of market capitalization, being state-owned. In OECD countries there are over 2,000 EP and employ more than 6 million workers. One of the challenges for governments is how to monitor these public assets so that they are managed efficiently and transparently. In the specialized literature it is indicated that centralized models of supervision, concentrated in a ministry, agency or state holding, would promote the generation of better information and greater transparency in the management of PEs.

In Latin America, PEs have a presence in economic sectors such as water, sanitation, electricity, oil, mining, finance, telecommunications, ports and airports. Its economic relevance in some of these countries reaches about 10% to 15% of GDP. As regards the supervision of the management of its PE, Brazil, Chile and Peru are examples of countries with centralized models of supervision. Thus, the Department of Coordination and Governance of Brazil (DEST), the Public Business System of Chile (SEP) and the Financing Fund of the State of Peru (FONAFE), with different types of institutional design and tools of Supervision, have worked over the last decade to improve the financial performance of PEs subject to their supervision.

At present AL is experiencing a period of mediocre growth with fiscal deficits and increasing indebtedness. Due to their economic relevance, poorly managed PE can contribute to increasing these deficits and constitute a significant fiscal risk through the accumulation of contingent liabilities. Also, in many cases, EPs provide key basic services to citizens that may be damaged by inefficiency and lack of transparency in management.

The specific objectives are: (i) to support the implementation of the new Integrity, Transparency, and Anti-Corruption Regime; (ii) to strengthen the capacities of the CGR's communications area and the design of innovative strategies for disseminating oversight results; and (iii) to consolidate the CGR's performance auditing through the training of its high-performing team and the strengthening of its internal structure for the application of this audit modality.

oper_nm: Support ANDE in the Preparation and Execution of Operations of Clean Energy II
objtv: The overall objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support ANDE in the preparation and execution of clean energy investment operations. The specific objectives are: (i) to improve project management by strengthening the technical, fiduciary, financial, environmental, and social capacities of ANDE staff; (ii) to support the development of technical and regulatory studies that optimize national electricity system planning; and (iii) to promote knowledge and experience exchange through participation in strategic events related to digitalization, innovation, inclusion, gender, and job creation in the energy sector.

oper_nm: Support for the Enhancement of Paraguay's National Innovation System
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation is to support CONACYT by ensuring the continuity of the initiatives and efforts implemented by PROINNOVA aimed at strengthening the innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem through: (i) strengthening human capital and technological adoption to drive sustainable innovations led by Paraguayan micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs); (ii) promoting open collaboration and institutional strengthening to support innovation projects led by entrepreneurs, companies, and the scientific community.

oper_nm: Enhancing the Competitiveness of Paraguay's Metallurgical Industry
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the Ministry of Industry and Commerce (MIC) of Paraguay in strengthening its capacity to improve the competitiveness of the national metallurgical industry. The specific objectives are: (i) to assess the Paraguayan metallurgical industry to identify gaps and best practices; (ii) to develop strategies and an action plan to promote the competitiveness of the industry; and (iii) to manage and disseminate the knowledge acquired to facilitate its promotion and future adoption.

oper_nm: Support for the Sustainable Finance Alliance of Paraguay
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacities of the Government of Paraguay to promote the development of green and sustainable finance, with a focus on creating synergies between the public and private sectors. This activity also creates additional income opportunities for the agents, who often come from lower socio-economic class themselves. IDB Lab's contribution of up to US$600,000 will consist of a bridge financing, structured as a senior loan with an option to convert into Pago46's equity stock, at a future capitalization round. IDB Lab´s financing will be used by Pago46's as working capital to fund its operations and to generate improvements in the company software, applications and technology related to its payment products and services in its current countries of operation and to expand services to Ecuador. As a result, this project is expected to benefit consumers and users of Pago46 payment services in Argentina, Chile, Mexico and, potentially, Ecuador to gain access to the digital economy and small businesses and gig economy workers to benefit from additional income opportunities, as Pago46 agents.

oper_nm: Remittances and Savings Regional Facility
objtv: Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) is the second region in the world to receive the largest amount of remittances after Asia (including East Asia and the Pacific and South Asia). In 2011, an estimated LAC reached around USD 61,000 billion in international remittances, which were paid in the region by remittance paying companies, commercial banks, microfinance institutions, and credit unions, among others. These payments are processed on a regular basis every month. Of the total remittances received in the region, only a small portion is channeled to savings, and it is estimated that only 20% of recipients have a savings account at a financial institution, prevailing receiving and handling cash in most countries in the region. This is attributed, on the supply side, to the lack of savings products tailored to the needs and preferences of the receiver and the sender as well as to the access and availability of distribution channels. On the demand side there is a lack of financial skills, savings habits and recognition of the benefits generated by the save. The MIF will accompany financial institutions in the region in designing and implementing business strategies that promote the development of savings products tailored to the preferences of people that transfer and adopt alternative distribution channels such as mobile phones and cards, providing savings options close and tailored to the people that send and receive transfers.

objtv: The general objective of this Facility is to support the design and implementation of policies for the extension of the school day in LAC, targeting the following areas: (i) enhance and diversify learning opportunities; (ii) data-informed decision making; and (iii) innovative teaching strategies, while promoting gender equality.

oper_nm: Achieving Net-Zero Value Chains Through Inclusive and Circular Solutions
objtv: The general objective is to establish a facility to support the reduction of GHG emissions (particularly Scope 3) and contribute to net-zero value chains in the Amazon region and other geographical areas of the Bank's beneficiaries countries. oper_nm: LAC E-Coop: Piloting Innovative Green Finance to Promote Productive Community-Based Clean Energy Solutions
objtv: The objective is to promote access to clean energy under innovative models that involve climate change mitigation and decarbonization of production chains in rural areas. This will have an impact on increasing the resilience of the rural population and the agricultural sector in the region.

oper_nm: Latin America and the Caribbean Facility for Greening Public Development Banks and the Financial Sector
objtv: The general objective of this facility is to foster the greening of the public financial sector and the alignment of it to the PA and NDCs. The facility will have three specific objectives that complement and leverage each other: (i) support and advise PDBs and their network of LFIs to align their strategy and business model to the goals of the PA and create a public policy environment conducive for greening the public financial sector; (ii) implement an innovative Performance-Based Payments (PBP) mechanism, that incentivizes PDBs financially to: (a) maintain and implement institutional enhancements; (b) achieve ambitious GHG reductions at the institutional and beneficiary level; and (c) the increasing PA-aligned share of the PDBs portfolio; and (iii) support in-depth feasibility analysis, structuring and piloting of innovative financial structures aimed at enhancing PDB's lending capacity and the mobilization of private sector capital for ambitious climate investments.

oper_nm: Biodiversity and Natural Capital Facility for the America's Partnership for Prosperity
objtv: The general objective of the Facility is to support, through the IDB Group (IDB, IDB Invest, and IDB Lab), beneficiary countries in the Americas Partnership in developing and implementing innovative financing mechanisms to mobilize investments in natural capital and biodiversity that advance climate change objectives. This Facility will aim to complement other operations that generate innovative financing solutions for nature-positive investments with climate-co-benefits, including the development of financial products that are also in line with BID Clima, debt for nature conversions, biodiversity assets, and Paris alignment objectives.

oper_nm: MIG-INTEGRATION: Facility on Socio Economic Integration of Refugees, Migrants, Returnees, and Host Community Members in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The general objective of this Facility is to support the socioeconomic integration of refugees, migrants, returnees, and host community members, including a gender and diversity approach, in eligible countries across Latin America and the Caribbean. Each project under this Facility should aim to enhance the capacity of national and/or local governments and service providers. These projects will focus on developing mechanisms to ensure inclusive and gender-responsive protection, access to essential social services, and opportunities for economic advancement.

oper_nm: Sargassum Innovation Facility

oper_nm: SIRWASH – Sustainable and Innovative Rural Water, Sanitation and Hygiene – Phase II

oper_nm: Central American Renewable Energy and Cleaner Production (CAREC) Facility
objtv: The general objective of the project is to promote the use of renewable energy technologies for power generation and to improve the use of energy and other inputs for companies' operations in Central America. oper_nm: Supporting the Establishment of a Caribbean Credit Rating Service
objtv: The objectives are: i) facilitate access of private sector firms to domestic and cross border issuance of notes and bonds and lower their cost of funds; ii) provide investors with high quality information to compare debt instruments in the Caribbean region; iii) enable the capital markets in the region to become deeper and more liquid as more debt instruments are issued; iv) address many of the priorities listed in the New Framework of Cooperation within the Caribbean Community such as greater regional integration of capital markets and more intra-regional investment.

oper_nm: Investment Fund and Technical Assistance for Competitive SMEs - EMERGE FUND
objtv:

oper_nm: Investment Fund for Competitive SME's CASEIF II
objtv: The main objetive is to further the development of the venture capital industry in C.A. by providing examples of how the financing of small companies through VC produce an impact of growth and organization of these companies. oper_nm: Equity investment in Global Partnerships Microfinance Fund 2006
objtv: The main objetive of the project is to promote the growth of sustainable MFI's and increase their outreach and support to the micro, small and medium enterprises in Latin America.

oper_nm: DevCap 2007
objtv: Fifteen million dollar fund targeting SME's in the Caribbean Region in the tourist, agro-industry services, energy and manufacturing sectors.

oper_nm: Microfinance Growth Facility (MiGroF)
objtv: The main objective of this Facility is intended to facilitate sustained growth of micro and small enterprises in light of the contraction of international financing sources due to the global financial crisis. This facility seeks to partially compensate for the shortfall from the reduction of domestic and external sources of funding that MFIs are facing in the LAC region. The Facility will suply eligible MFIs and MIVs with medium and long term senior and subordinated loans, which in turn will be on-lent to thousands of micro and small enterprises.

oper_nm: MicroCarbon Development Fund

The Fund will invest in demand-side energy efficiency programs that deliver verifiable benefits to smaller firms and low-income communities and administer technical assistance grants to support training for local firms. The Fund is expected to have a total capitalization of US$50 million, and the MIF will commit up to US$ 10 million in capital, and US$ 2 million in non-reimbusable grants.

oper_nm: Eco Enterprise Fund II
objtv: EcoE II will focus on innovative small- to medium-sized businesses that focused on the sustainable use of natural resources. The Fund will provide mezzanine financing to growth-stage companies in the Meso-America Region, the Northern Andes and the Amazon Basin in Latin America. In addition, the Fund will administer non-reimbursable resources to provide targeted technical assistance to develop the pipeline of deals and strengthen portfolio companies.

oper_nm: Próspero Microfinanzas Fund

oper_nm: CoreCo Central America I Investment Fund

oper_nm: Scaling up Integrated Microfinance Services

In these countries there is an important asymmetry between capital and information. Entrepreneurs with know-how lack capital to develop their investments. The projects financed by VICTUS will be developed alongside the ¿partner-entrepreneur¿; an entrepreneur who has the know-how but lack necessary capital. The idea for this Fund is to replicate in Latin America, the model implemented via the two former Funds that Sembrador managed in Chile. To make this possible VICTUS needs to be a USD 100 million fund. The fund¿s sustainability will be reached with the target capitalization of USD 100 MM that will allow funding projects in the Region until they become successful on their own.

oper_nm: Promotora Early Growth II

oper_nm: S4: De-risking Agricultural Production Via Data Analytics and Satellite Imagery

Through an equity investment, the project will support S4, an early stage company that is leading the innovation in this field in the Region to consolidate its operations in Argentina and expand regionally, starting with Brazil. S4 has an innovative, technology-based platform that uses remote sensing satellite data, deep learning techniques, and proprietary algorithms, to construct Enhanced Vegetation Indexes (EVI) that recognize and classify different crops and phonological periods, which correlate their growth with yields, as well as indexes that account for excess water in production areas. With project support, S4 will design and refine EVI-based climate-risk hedging products that aim to provide crop risk protection from systemic weather events (i.e. yield loss due to droughts or floods). The hedging products will be commercialized through different channels, including over the counter futures markets and aggregators (such as input supplier companies), with the backing of insurance and reinsurance companies.

oper_nm: Pago46: Revolutionazing Payments for Vulnerable Populations in Times of COVID-19
objtv: The project objective is to improve the ability of the region's consumers to access products and services available through digital platforms, by supporting the consolidation of an innovative payments solution –advanced by Pago46– that brings together cash and digital transactions and also generates additional income opportunities in the gig economy. To achieve this, the project will provide crisis response financing to Pago46 under the Emergency Financing Line for Startups and Scaleups (LIFESS) Line of Activity, to help this startup cope with the effects of COVID-19 and carry on its business, while it completes its capital raising efforts. Pago46 is a regional startup offering an innovative on-demand cash-to-digital payments solution that delivers payment services to last mile clients. Pago46's solution is innovative in two ways: (i) it allows unbanked or underbanked consumers to pay with cash for goods and services being offered digitally, right from the place where the consumers are located and with minimized contact with the payment collection agent or the merchant; (ii) it takes advantage of LAC's growing gig economy market to mobilize a massive network of Pago46 mobile "agents" to facilitate the transactions. This activity also creates additional income opportunities for the agents, who often come from lower socio-economic class themselves.
