oper_nm: Strengthening Fiduciary Country Systems: Promoting their Use in IDB-Financed Loan Operations
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to sustainably booster borrowing member countries in enhancing their public procurement and financial management systems. The overarching goal is to empower national institutions, augment service delivery, and enhance policy implementation. This is achieved through two key approaches: 1) Facilitating the adoption and integration of international standards or narrowing the gaps with best practices; 2) Fostering knowledge transfer and facilitating government-to-government collaboration within the region. This exchange mechanism enables the sharing of successful practices and insights gleaned from experiences in other countries.

oper_nm: Building capacity to mainstream climate change into fiscal policies and management
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The objective of this TC is to implement capacity-building-centered initiatives designed to address technical capacity gaps in the LAC region to improve climate change actions through fiscal policy and management. To achieve this overarching goal, specific objectives include: (i) develop and support capacity-building activities and peer-to-peer exchanges for ministries of finance, economy, and planning in LAC; (ii) support the development of an offer of professional program(s) on climate (and green) fiscal policy, designed to benefit the MoF in the LAC region, and to enable the establishment of a stronger base of professionals who can support them; and (iii) carry out initiatives to mainstream the subject of green fiscal policies in LAC´s research institutions and foster the creation of an academic network around such subject.

oper_nm: Phase I (Take-Off): A Regional Prototype for Accelerating the Deployment of Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDC’s) for Inclusion in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: This technical cooperation (TC) is aimed to enable a Latin America and the Caribbean regional test-network enabling issuance of CBDCs and tokenization of financial assets focusing on cross-region interoperability among central banks and financial institutions.

oper_nm: Maximizing the Impact of IDBG Operations
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to the economic growth of the region by providing tools to the public sector that enable countries to assess the impact of their interventions more effectively and improve its delivery. To this end, the TC seeks to: (i) measure the impact of IDB portfolios by expanding the Huella initiative to other LAC countries; (ii) enhance the impact knowledge generated from IDB operations; and (iii) improve the efficiency of public service delivery in the Andean Region.

oper_nm: Fostering private sector growth in an evolving landscape
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to the region's economic growth by enhancing the effectiveness of public policies that drive sustainable economic growth, with a focus on the private sector. To achieve this, the TC aims to generate evidence-based policies to unlock productivity gains for private sector growth in Latin America and the Caribbean.

oper_nm: Inclusive economic growth amid vulnerable and insecure contexts
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to contribute to economic growth in the region by supporting government innovation by equipping policymakers with more robust analytical tools to assess possible shocks related to the factors highlighted above and elaborate evidence-based responses.

oper_nm: Innovative solutions for sustainable green development
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to promote economic growth in LAC by (i) identifying strategies to enhance the production and export potential of clean energy-intensive industries, and (ii) identifying opportunities for green financial investments in the region.

oper_nm: Diverse Ecosystem: Boosting the Ecosystem of Entrepreneurs with Disabilities in LAC
objtv: The objective of the project is to promote an inclusive entrepreneurship ecosystem in LAC by supporting founders with disabilities and neurodiverse, as well as non-disabled and neurotypical entrepreneurs with startups focused on populations with disabilities, strengthening their skills, as well as incubating and accelerating their businesses.

oper_nm: Strengthening LAC's Competitiveness in Strategic Global Value Chains
objtv: This TC seeks to capitalize on the evolving landscape of GVCs by supporting LAC countries in addressing critical challenges, leveraging regional strengths, and ensuring adherence to international labor standards. By providing detailed competitiveness studies, regional analyses, and targeted policy recommendations, this TC aims to drive economic growth, attract foreign investments, ensure sustainable development, and promote fair labor practices across the region.

oper_nm: Strengthening of tax policy and administration in Latin America and the Caribbean
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to strengthen the tax systems of Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) in order to increase the sufficiency, efficiency, and equity of fiscal revenue collection, both at the national and subnational levels. The specific objectives are: (i) to improve tax policy through the building and strengthening of knowledge and capabilities for developing tax reform proposals; and (ii) to strengthen the efficiency and effectiveness of revenue collection by fostering collaborative relationships between taxpayers and Tax Administrations, implementing initiatives related to international taxation, and consolidating digital transformation processes.

oper_nm: Strengthening Sectoral Cybersecurity in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC)
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen cybersecurity capabilities in Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries to protect their critical sectors by: (i) increasing regional collaborative and intersectoral work; (ii) improving the capacities of professionals through training and knowledge development; and (iii) implementing pilot projects.

oper_nm: From Korea to LAC: Promoting sustainable Digital Transformation in Education
objtv: This project aims to support the ministries of education of Peru, and Honduras and the region indirectly in accelerating the digital transformation of their education systems with quality and equity. By leveraging Korea's expertise and technical support in this area, the project will develop a comprehensive Digital Transformation of Education (DTE) set of tools tailored to the unique needs of each country. The specific objectives are: (i) to develop and deploy a digital transformation diagnostic toolkit for education systems; (ii) to establish a DTE roadmap with a mapping of potential Korean solutions from the public and private sectors; and (iii) to organize a high-level dialogue in Korea with multi-stakeholders to showcase opportunities.

oper_nm: Knowledge Dissemination, programming and monitoring and evaluation support for the Compete Caribbean + Trust Fund: Partnering for a Competitive, Equitable and Climate-Smart Region (CC+)
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the execution of the Compete Caribbean + Trust Fund (CC+): Partnering for a Competitive, Equitable and Climate-Smart region (GN-2851-2) during 2024-2026, and specifically to support the Fund's achievement of its ultimate objective: to improve gender-responsive sustainable growth and climate resilience of Caribbean countries' private sector, and its intermediate objectives: (i) improving competitiveness, climate action, and inclusiveness of the Caribbean private sector; (ii) enhancing government capabilities to support climate-smart and gender-responsive businesses; and (iii) reinforcing research institutions and surrounding ecosystems to produce knowledge that supports climate-smart and gender-responsive public and private sectors. Specifically, the TC will support the capacity of the Fund Coordination Unit (FCU) to: (i) build networks to capture and disseminate best practices, knowledge and lessons learned; (ii) carry out dialogue with key stakeholders across the region for identification of catalytic projects; and (iii) carry out monitoring of the projects and design project evaluations in all 3 pillars of CC+: Pillar 1: "Promoting competitiveness, climate action and inclusiveness of Caribbean private sector", Pillar 2 "Enhancing government capabilities to support climate-smart and gender-responsive businesses", and Pillar 3: "Promoting scientific R&D for climate innovation in the public and private sectors". In addition, the TC will support the completion of the mid-term evaluation of CC+.

oper_nm: Rethinking LAC cities: innovating to address common urban challenges in the region
objtv: This technical cooperation's (TC) objective is to creatively re-think challenges in Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) cities to co-create a more sustainable urban future in the region. Specifically, this TC aims to leverage IDB Cities Lab's experience in digital tools, participatory methods, and agile innovation techniques to (i) generate valuable insight on current trends and expectations on urban living; (ii) foster meaningful conversations to develop new agreements; (iii) test innovative solutions and assess their scalability and replicability into IDB operations; and (iv) generate and disseminate knowledge.

oper_nm: Developing new instruments for regulatory innovation
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to support and strengthen the implementation of policies for regulatory improvement in LAC, aiming to generate regulatory environments that promote greater productivity and better public services. Consolidating better regulation initiatives in LAC requires concerted efforts to address institutional gaps, promote impact-oriented initiatives, and embrace innovative regulatory tools. By drawing inspiration from successful experiences, particularly that of the Republic of Korea, and prioritizing technical cooperation initiatives, LAC countries can pave the way for a more dynamic and effective regulatory environment conducive to sustainable development and economic growth.

oper_nm: Carbon Markets for the Amazon Region: Assessment and Support for Institutional and Regulatory Development to support net-zero investments
objtv: The general objective of this non-reimbursable Technical Cooperation (TC) is to generate knowledge and assess opportunities of regulated carbon markets in the seven member countries of the Inter-American Development bank (IDB) that share the Amazon region to support their efforts to reduce green-house gas emissions. This TC will assess constraints, challenges, and opportunities to implement policies, regulatory frameworks and market infrastructure for regulated domestic and international carbon markets. These activities are expected to complement other solutions to foster transformative changes for reducing emissions and contribute to sustainable development in these countries. To reduce the effects of climate change, the world needs to achieve net-zero carbon emissions by mid-century, implying a transformational shift towards new, clean technologies, including sustainable land-use related practices and systemic changes ahead. Therefore, it is crucial to ensure that actions today align with such long-term required goals by mid-century.

oper_nm: Emergency Assistance due to Hurricane Beryl in OECS
objtv: The purpose of the emergency assistance is to support St. Vincent and the Grenadines, as well as Grenada, through the Caribbean Development Bank, in the implementation of humanitarian assistance actions to provide the required relief to the affected populations as a result of the passage of Hurricane Beryl.

oper_nm: Eatable Adventures: accelerating the ecosystem agrifoodtech in the South Cone
objtv: The objective of the project is to accelerate the development of the agrifoodtech ecosystem in 4 countries in the region, strengthening companies in early stages, with a focus on those oriented to solve the problems of food insecurity and malnutrition of the vulnerable population.

oper_nm: ONE Caribbean Data and Research for Impact Phase 1
objtv: To improve the availability of data and conduct analysis on that data in order to improve the design of policies and programs supported by ONE Caribbean, with specific emphasis on the four priority and two cross cutting areas. It also aims to generate data that can improve the monitoring and evaluation of ONE Caribbean impacts.

oper_nm: AgroHub: Agrifood Innovation and Entrepreneurship
objtv: The objective of the project is to promote innovation and entrepreneurship in the agri-food systems of Honduras, El Salvador and Guatemala with an emphasis on small farmers. The specific objective is to launch and implement the "AgroHub" within Zamorano, as a space dedicated to knowledge generation and entrepreneurship AgriFood Tech solutions, serving as a platform to connect and create synergies between the actors in the synergies among actors in the agri-food sector. In addition, it will be an engine for the development of ventures that seek to have a positive impact on society, promoting collaborative work and facilitating the transfer of knowledge and technologies to the community.

oper_nm: One Safe Caribbean against Organized Crime
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance the capacity of member states within the Caribbean to effectively combat transnational organized crime. The specific objectives of this TC are to: (i) improve data generation mechanisms on transnational organized crime; (ii) strengthen the regional intelligence-sharing and analysis architecture; (iii) develop specialized investigative and prosecutorial capabilities to combat transnational organized crime; and (iv) bolster civil society engagement against transnational organized crime.

oper_nm: Support to gender equality, empowerment of women and girls, and diversity inclusion through the strengthening of the mainstreaming process
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the existing efforts of the IDB towards achieving gender equality, empowerment of women and girls, and diversity inclusion by strengthening its mainstreaming process. Its goal is to generate and strengthen analytical and operational knowledge and the institutional capacities for designing and implementing programs and policies to contribute to gender equality, empowerment of women and girls, and diversity inclusion in the region, specifically in the sectors where it has been most difficult.

oper_nm: Transmission for the energy transition in LAC
objtv: The general objective of the CT is to evaluate mechanisms to encourage private investment in electrical transmission, in order to support the energy transition process in the region. The specific objectives are to: (i) identify which factors are affecting private investment in transmission in the region; (ii) evaluate the region in terms of investment needs and capabilities and identify a set of at least 2 countries where private investment can be incentivized, (iii) propose specific policy regulatory and sector measures that can be implemented to attract private investment.

oper_nm: Executive Round Tables for Policy Reform in the Caribbean
objtv: The objective of this TC is to strengthen the capacities of the governments in public-private dialogue at the sectoral level by developing a pilot of executive round table for addressing legal, regulatory, and institutional bottlenecks for sustainable private sector development growth in the Caribbean in strategic sectors in three countries in the region, Jamaica and Suriname. The specific objectives are to: (i) increase coordination measures between public and private sectors for promoting strategic sectors; (ii) develop a methodology to map areas of intervention and/or reform in strategic sectors under a sustainability framework; and (iii) to create and implement executive roundtables for strategic sectors with high growth potential.

oper_nm: Enhancing Impact through the Client Portal: Evaluation of the Digital Semiannual Report on Client Ownership and Quality of Operational Knowledge
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to enhance our understanding of Project Executing Units (PEUs), addressing gaps in knowledge about their internal processes, management practices, and incentives. The specific objectives are: (i) to evaluate the impact of gaining access to digitally generate the project's comprehensive semi-annual report on short-term project performance and PEUs' perception of IDB support, and (ii) to measure whether PEUs are actively incorporating high-quality lessons learned during and after project execution, providing an estimate of their responsiveness to unforeseen obstacles. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to evaluate the impact of simplifying the communication between a PEU and its main stakeholder over project performance.

oper_nm: Uncovering the impacts of access to credit on small and medium enterprises
objtv: This TC's objective is to produce rigorous evidence on the impact of access to finance on small and medium enterprises (SMEs) in the LAC region.

oper_nm: Improving evaluability during execution through continuous evaluation with administrative data
objtv: The main objective of this Technical Cooperation project is to strengthen the evaluation capacities of beneficiary agencies' productive programs using administrative data. The specific objectives are to: (i) Facilitate the design and implementation of impact evaluations of two productive development public programs in Chile. It is expected that one of these programs had been advanced by Servicio de Cooperación Técnica (SERCOTEC) and the other one by Corporación de Fomento (CORFO). The evaluations will incorporate merged data from these programs and the administrative records from Chile's national tax authority, Servicio de Impuestos Internos (SII). (ii) Facilitate the design and implementation of impact evaluations of at least two productive development public programs in Peru. It is expected that one of these programs had been advanced by Pro Innóvate and the other one by Consejo Nacional de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (CONCYTEC) . The evaluations will utilize combined data from these programs and the administrative records of payroll, firms' performance, trade, and debt collected by various Peruvian regulatory agencies. (iii) Support the establishment of a permanent interagency cooperation agreement between Peru's Ministry of Economy and Finance and public agencies involved in productive development programs, as previously mentioned, to facilitate the sharing of administrative records concerning payroll, firms' performance, trade, and debt.(iv) Build capacities within the agencies participating in the impact evaluations referred in paragraphs (i) and (ii), for them to exploit shared administrative records for the permanent evaluation of some of their productive development programs.

oper_nm: Evidence on digital health interventions to tackle non-communicable diseases
objtv: The objective of this TC is to generate rigorous regional evidence on the effectiveness of digital interventions for the detection, prevention and treatment of NCDs in LAC. The specific objectives include: 1) evaluate whether digital tools for risk estimation and population management could increase the uptake and optimize the use of screening services for NCDs; (2) generate evidence on whether digital interventions for patients can help them reduce risk factors and early onset of NCDs; and (3) assess the quality and cost of telehealth visits for patients with NCDs. The TC will conduct three separate evaluations to achieve these specific objectives.

oper_nm: Evaluating AI interventions to reduce bias
objtv: The objective of the TC is to evaluate the impact of the AI algorithms used by Quipu and Jobecam on women and Afro-descendants, and specifically measure the differential effects of these AI algorithms in the decisions about credit approval and hiring-related decisions.

oper_nm: Maximizing the development effectiveness of generative AI in the public sector
objtv: The objective of this TC is to improve the development impact of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GAI) in the public sector through the generation of knowledge about the impact of GAI on public sector decision-making and how best to encourage its responsible use.

oper_nm: Regional Platform of Finance Secretaries of Cities on Climate Change in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to establish the "LAC Regional Climate Change Platform for City Finance Secretaries" to support city finance secretaries in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) to mobilize climate financing, share knowledge, foster dialogue, and implement scalable solutions to address climate change (CC).

oper_nm: Hydrological and Hydrodynamic Monitoring and Forecasting System for River Floods in the Andean-Amazon Region of Peru, Ecuador, and Bolivia
objtv: The objective of the CT is to develop an integrated hydrological and hydrodynamic modeling at the regional scale for Bolivia, Ecuador, and Peru, which allows the spatial-temporal analysis of hydrological time series in real-time, contributing to strengthening forecasts and early warning systems in this region.

oper_nm: Strengthening Response Capacities Against Food Insecurity of the country members of the SICA Region: Guatemala, Honduras, and the Dominican Republic
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to strengthen the technical and operational capacities of the SAN institutions of the participating countries (Honduras, Guatemala and the Dominican Republic) through a mechanism for the integration and systematization of information and indicators of Food and Nutritional Insecurity. This will allow the governing bodies of National Food Security in the beneficiary countries to program and prioritize interventions. The specific objectives are: (i) implement a regional system of indicators and updated data collection that allows SICA countries to have access to updated, relevant food security indicators, with adequate representation and with a gender and diversity focus; (ii) strengthen the analysis capabilities of the SAN technical teams in the SICA countries, to generate relevant information that allows monitoring and evaluating the interventions stipulated in the SAN Plan CELAC, POLSAN and the associated national chapters.

oper_nm: Green Coalition of Public Development Banks
objtv: The objective of this TC is to strengthen the Coalition PDBs' institutional capacities to promote sustainable development in the Amazon region.

oper_nm: Building a Statistical Framework to Measure Vulnerability in the Caribbean Community (CARICOM)
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation is the development of institutional capacity across the participating countries by supporting the development of a statistical framework to measure poverty and other vulnerability dimensions through collaborative work. The specific objectives are to develop: (i) A harmonized data collection instrument for measuring vulnerability in CARICOM in the economic, social and environmental dimensions of sustainable development; (ii) Regional knowledge products and methodological guidelines for administering the harmonized instrument; and (iii) Training modules for administering multipurpose surveys for measuring vulnerability.

oper_nm: Strengthening Fiscal Institutions for Consistent Fiscal Policy and Sustainable, Transparent, and Inclusive Economies
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Transform and extend the scope of fiscal rules and the Medium-Term Fiscal Framework in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) to address current challenges, such as climate change and inclusive and sustainable growth.

oper_nm: A Safe and Sustainable Amazon: A Regional Model for the Prevention, Monitoring, and Investigation of Illegal Mining and Other Environmental Crimes
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacities of five countries in the Amazon region to monitor, prevent, and combat environmental crimes, particularly illegal gold mining and illegal logging.

oper_nm: Transforming Transportation in the Amazon (TTA): Evidence-Based Policies and Investments to Promote Inclusive and Sustainable Mobility in the Amazon Region
subsector_nm: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (BUS / TRAIN / CABLE). INFRASTRUCTURE AND EQUIPMENT
objtv: To build a harmonized framework of policies and guidelines for transportation investments in the Amazon region. This project aims to improve the role of transportation in sustainable economic inclusion and to accelerate the adoption of climate agendas in mitigation and adaptation/resilience.

oper_nm: Toolkit for Climate-Resilient Strategies for Sustainable Water and Sanitation Management in the Caribbean
objtv: To enhance the resilience and sustainability of water and sanitation services in the Caribbean by developing and disseminating a comprehensive toolkit that enables water utilities to implement concrete actions to mitigate the impacts of climate change.

oper_nm: Towards the Electrical Interconnection of the American Continent
objtv: The purpose of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to facilitate the electrical interconnection process of the countries participating in the Andean Electrical Interconnection System (SINEA), by evaluating the conditions for the coordinated operation of the electrical grids of Colombia, Ecuador and Peru.

oper_nm: Energy Resilience for Sustainable Development in the Caribbean
subsector_nm: ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND RENEWABLE ENERGY IN END USE
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support The Bahamas, Barbados, Guyana, Jamaica, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago, and Belize to adopt climate resiliency measures in the energy sector. Specifically, the TC aims to: (i) ensure that climate resiliency is addressed in planning and design of new energy infrastructure as well as in existing systems, (ii) strengthen energy sector response strategies and action plans in the aftermath of natural disaster, and (iii) promote the development and adoption of harmonized energy standards.

oper_nm: Toolkit for the Deep Integration of the Northern Triangle of Central America
subsector_nm: TRADE FACILITATION, TRADE LOGISTICS AND CUSTOMS
objtv: The objective of this TC is to contribute to the strengthening of the Deep Integration process of the countries of Guatemala, Honduras, and El Salvador, through the development and provision of updated tools to facilitate trade flows, including the ability to trace and control processes (intelligent corridor) in aspects related to operational processes and the technological systems that provide support.

oper_nm: Development of recommendations to improve statistical production on diverse population groups
objtv: The institutional strengthening of National Statistical Offices (NSOs) to improve the statistical production process regarding Indigenous Peoples, Afro-descendants, and LGBTQ+ individuals.

oper_nm: Regional Training Platform for Caregivers for Older Persons
objtv: Contribute to improving the competencies for the care of elderly people in situations of dependency through the training and certification of caregivers, based on the Person-Centered Care approach.

oper_nm: Regional Promotion of Public Policies and Public-Private Partnerships for Closing Gender Economic Gaps through the America in the Center (AEEC) Initiative
objtv: Through this project, the IPG methodology will be strengthened to consolidate public-private partnerships that accelerate policies, programs, and knowledge exchange among the Central America, Panama, and the Dominican Republic (CAPRD) subregion, aimed at closing gender economic gaps in priority economic sectors.

oper_nm: Evidence-based delivery
objtv: Producing an Operational Guidelines for the implementation of the novel evidence-based delivery methodology, which is a key element of the comprehensive results-based management model promoted under the new Impact+ Strategy. This methodology includes evaluating the key performance indicators / factors that influence the health of the active portfolio, such as complexity, disbursement, physical and financial progress, delays, cancellations, weaknesses in planning and project management, poor social and environmental performance, sector and country context, among other.

oper_nm: Hurricane Beryl Emergency Assistance to St. Vincent & The Grenadines
objtv: The purpose of the emergency assistance is to support St. Vincent and the Grenadines, through the Caribbean Development Bank, in the implementation of humanitarian assistance actions to provide the required relief to the affected populations as a result of the passage of Hurricane Beryl.

oper_nm: Strengthening Financial Intermediary Operations for Development Impact
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the development effectiveness of financial intermediary operations led by the Connectivity, Markets, and Finance Division (IFD/CMF). This aims to leverage existing knowledge on the effectiveness of programs and policies supporting multi-sectoral development in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) through Public Development Banks. The TC seeks to deliver more effective financial solutions that result in measurable development impacts and improved access to credit for MSMEs, enhancing financial inclusion, productivity, and socio-economic development.

oper_nm: Hurricane Beryl Emergency Assistance to Grenada
objtv: The purpose of the emergency assistance is to support Grenada, through the Caribbean Development Bank, in the implementation of humanitarian assistance actions to provide the required relief to the affected populations as a result of the passage of Hurricane Beryl.

oper_nm: Resiliency of Power Infrastructure and Response Preparedness for Energy Service Restoration
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support The Bahamas, Barbados, Guyana, Jamaica, Suriname, Trinidad and Tobago, and Belize to adopt climate resiliency measures in the energy sector. Specifically, the TC aims to: (i) ensure that climate resiliency is addressed in planning and design of new power infrastructure, (ii) strengthen energy sector response strategies and action plans in the aftermath of natural disaster, and (iii) promote the development and adoption of harmonized energy standards.

oper_nm: Knowledge Generation and IDB Group Synergies for Bioeconomy in the Amazon region
objtv: Based on the activities financed with the GCF Amazon Bioeconomy Fund, the objective of this TC is to generate and disseminate knowledge from bioeconomy operations and evaluations in Amazonia, to facilitate synergies within the IDB Group and other relevant stakeholders.

oper_nm: Support for the process of physical and commercial integration between Guatemala and Belize
objtv: The objective is to support the process of physical and commercial integration between Guatemala and Belize through the development of technical studies with climate change resilience criteria necessary to: (i) enable a road connection from southern Belize to the Pacific Corridor, in the adjacency zone between the countries; (ii) install an adjacency control center at the border crossing and; (iii) develop complementary studies to advance with the consolidation of the integration process by evaluating integration schemes, coordinated border management and financing for the development and maintenance of infrastructure through public-private collaboration models.

oper_nm: Support for the strengthening of regional networks in Amazonia in preparation for COP30
objtv: The purpose of this TC is to support the strengthening of the regional integration among Amazonian countries to deliver effectively for COP30. The specific objectives are: (i) strategic support for technical and political dialogue on issues of common interest among Amazonian countries and support for the establishment of regional knowledge sharing agendas; (ii) strategic support to the strengthening and continued operationalization of regional collaboration networks; (iii) mobilization of effective and coordinated actions for the effective and coordinated mobilization of climate finance opportunities for COP30.

oper_nm: Model to increase the effectiveness and impact of Institutional Capacity operations
objtv: The objective is to contribute to the generation of knowledge about what works and what does not work in response to the Institutional Capacity problems that Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) countries are going through by improving tools and models to increase the effectiveness and impact of Institutional Capacity interventions.

oper_nm: Summit of the Security, Justice and Development Alliance for Latin America and the Caribbean: analysis of organized and financial crime in LAC
objtv: Facilitate the dialogue platform of Latin American and Caribbean countries for the constitution of the Alliance for Security, Justice and Development. This platform will serve as a high-level forum and technical dialogue to identify the priorities of LAC countries in terms of interventions and policies at the regional, subregional and national levels to address organized crime in the region in the short and medium term.

oper_nm: AquaData: how to improve operational efficiency with the use of Artificial Intelligence
objtv: The general objective of the TC is to improve the overall quality of water services (and, ultimately, the quality of life of users), by increasing operational efficiency and minimizing commercial losses of operators through the application of Machine Learning.

oper_nm: Framework for Artificial Intelligence use in tax administrations
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The initiative aims to develop an advanced AI-powered framework that enhances tax administrations' capabilities to detect and prevent tax evasion and fraud, optimizing compliance and revenue collection.

oper_nm: Leveraging AI Interactive Agents to Enhance Vaccination Uptake in Suriname and Argentina
objtv: The Latin America and Caribbean region face significant challenges in terms of vaccinations, including disparities in access to vaccines, logistical issues in distribution, and public hesitancy. These challenges have led to lower coverage in certain geographical areas, making it difficult to achieve widespread immunity and control preventable diseases. Addressing these barriers is crucial for improving public health outcomes across the region. Suriname and Argentina are not exceptions to these challenges. In Suriname, national vaccination coverage rates for key childhood vaccinations such as Pentavalent-3, Polio-3, and MMR-1 have not met the 95% target needed to prevent outbreaks, with notable disparities at the subnational level. Districts like Saramacca, Coronie, and Sipaliwini report alarmingly low coverage rates, endangering not only individual children but entire communities. These setbacks have led to a resurgence of diseases once thought controlled, such as diphtheria, measles, and polio. In Argentina, efforts to promote child vaccination are being intensified through a collaborative initiative with the Ministry of Health under the AR-L1409 project. This initiative targets children aged 0 to 24 months, emphasizing the timely completion of vaccinations to prevent diseases like tuberculosis, hepatitis B, measles, mumps, rubella, and polio. The strategy involves linking vaccination compliance to the Asignación Universal por Hijo (AUH), a monthly payment made for each child under 18 years of age when their parents are unemployed, work in informal jobs, or are domestic workers. The receipt of the AUH benefit would be contingent upon meeting vaccination requirements. Additionally, within the framework of the project AR-L1358, there is a strong focus on improving HPV vaccination rates, especially addressing the gender gap and the pivotal role pediatricians play in vaccination uptake. Regarding vaccine communication, chatbots are an effective tool, offering a seamless and natural interface to deliver credible and personalized information in real-time. This gives users easy access to accurate information, enhancing their understanding of vaccines and potentially improving their willingness to vaccinate (Passanante, A., et al, 2023). Hong, Y. J., et al (2021) implemented a real-time consultation messenger chatbot to send reminders and motivation boosters to increase children's vaccination rates. The chatbot effectively improved vaccination knowledge, motivation, adherence of parents to their children's vaccination schedules, and parental intention to proactively manage their child's vaccination schedule. Even in contexts of high vaccine hesitancy, such as France, Altay, S. et al (2023) demonstrated the effectiveness of a chatbot designed to answer people's questions about COVID-19 vaccines. Interacting with the chatbot enhanced individuals' intentions to receive the vaccine and positively shaped their attitudes toward vaccination.

oper_nm: Fislac AI Insights: Where Fiscal Clarity Meets Strategic Action
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: Develop an AI-powered virtual assistant that provides timely macro-fiscal intelligence to enhance the success of fiscal consolidations, mitigate macroeconomic risk, and contribute to economic recovery in LAC.

oper_nm: Lucha: Catalyzing the Social and Environmental Impact of Impact Founders
objtv: The objective of the project is to increase the impact of Latin American startups intervened by Lucha to (i) close the gaps in access to products and/or services for economically and socially vulnerable populations; and (ii) mitigate the effects of climate change and protect biodiversity.

oper_nm: Closing the gap in measuring AI adoption in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance the effectiveness of Artificial Intelligence (AI) policies in promoting economic growth and productivity by improving the measurement of AI adoption across firms in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). The specific objectives are to: (i) develop and validate methodologies for measuring AI adoption that can be applied across various sectors; (ii) explore the relationship between AI adoption and economic performance, focusing on the impacts in different industries; and (iii) integrate AI adoption data into national AI policy frameworks in at least three countries by the end of the project.

oper_nm: Optimization of information search on the websites of the National Statistics Offices (NSO) with AI
objtv: Improve access to official statistical information produced by the national statistical offices (NSE) of Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), through the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools that facilitate user interaction with websites of the ONE.

oper_nm: Supporting the Transition to a Vulnerability-Based Concessionality Model to Strengthen Resilience to External Shocks and Address Shared Challenges in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The objective of the TC is to strengthen the resilience of borrowing member countries in Latin America and the Caribbean to external shocks as well as to increase their contribution to regional and global public goods. This will be achieved by reformulating the current eligibility for concessional resources using vulnerability-anchored criteria and by designing a system of incentives to help countries prioritize projects that contribute to regional and public goods.

oper_nm: Amazon Bioeconomy Marketplace
objtv: The objective of this TC is to improve socioeconomic conditions, fight climate change, and help restore ecosystems in the Amazon regions of Peru, Guyana, and Suriname by supporting the implementation and growth of export-oriented sustainable bio-businesses. To that end, the planned activities aim to support the development of an online Amazon Bioeconomy Marketplace (ABM) to help the bio-business ecosystem in the Amazon region increase and diversify their exports and attract investment. The project will support small and medium sized businesses (SMEs), cooperatives, and producers associations. It will leverage the Inter-American Development Bank's (IDB) ConnectAmericas.com (CA) platform and its network of local partners in Amazon countries.

oper_nm: AquaConnect: Catalyzing Collaborative Innovation in Water Solutions through LAC-Korea Startup Alliances
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to generate knowledge about how to foster collaborative initiatives among startup enterprises in the water sector from Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) and Korea. The project aims to facilitate knowledge exchange, technology transfer, and innovation in water management and sanitation, encouraging sustainable solutions through transcontinental partnerships between the two regions.

oper_nm: Improving the effectiveness in Institutional Capacity Strengthening Interventions
objtv: Generate and disseminate knowledge to strengthen the design and implementation of institutional strengthening interventions.

oper_nm: Results based financing for Rural Water and Sanitation Sustainable Services Program
objtv: This technical cooperation (TC) seeks to enhance sustainable access to water and sanitation (W&S) services in rural communities across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). The specific objectives of the TC are: (i) improve water supply and sanitation infrastructure, quality, continuity and performance measurement in rural communities; (ii) develop innovative models to strengthen the community boards' capacities, and pilot innovative instruments to improve the financial and operational management and appropriation of the systems, such as results-based operational contracts; and (iii) strengthening the W&S governance for the rural sector by developing frameworks, tools, policy and regulatory proposals, enabling the adoption of innovative schemes to incentivize and measure the quality of services provided by rural operators, fostering the integration of these interventions into national and subnational rural programs.

oper_nm: Support for virtual community: data sharing and pool procurement among water utilities in the Caribbean
objtv: The general objective is to support building resilience for water utilities in the Caribbean through a virtual community by data sharing and pool procurement. The specific objectives are (i) to allow for the participating utilities to remain connected into the virtual community while the platform is expanded to other Caribbean utilities; and (ii) to enable and pilot pool procurement with the participating utilities.

oper_nm: Integration of productive systems as a strategy for climate change mitigation and adaptation
objtv: To contribute to the resilience and mitigation capacity of livestock systems in LAC.

oper_nm: Integration of sorghum cultivation in the productive systems of the Central American Dry Corridor
objtv: Sustainably intensify the agricultural systems of the Dry Corridor of Central America by incorporating sorghum genotypes and other forage cereals adapted to each environment in order to increase the productivity, sustainability, and resilience of the production systems.

oper_nm: New Horizons in AgTech: Scaling Innovation in Pastoral Systems of Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: Improve the efficiency in the management of grass and the sustainability of dairy and livestock pastoral systems in Latin America and the Caribbean by enhancing the capabilities of the AgTech tool '3RWeb'.

oper_nm: Reduction of greenhouse gas emissions in potato-grass systems in Ecuador and Peru
objtv: Reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions through the use of conservation agriculture (CA) practices in the potato-grass production systems of Ecuador and Peru.

oper_nm: Climate-resilient wheat
objtv: Increase the resilience of wheat in Latin America to the effects of drought and thermal stress resulting from climate change.

oper_nm: Strengthening the Management of the Punta Morada Potato Complex in the Andean Region
objtv: Strengthen the knowledge of the diagnosis and management of CPMP in the topics of seed tuber quality and pest management in producers.

oper_nm: Development and use of bioinputs for sustainable agriculture in Latin America
objtv: Increase the availability of bio-input-based technologies that improve the sustainability of agricultural production systems in LAC.

oper_nm: Resilient native potatoes: Safeguarding food in the face of climate change
objtv: Increase the agricultural yield of native potatoes through the revaluation of ancestral knowledge and the use of genomic technology to adapt to climate change.

oper_nm: Development of a Regional Network for Genetic Improvement in Latin America and the Caribbean to Promote Resilient and Nutritious Agriculture
objtv: Promote the resilience and sustainability of interconnected productive horticultural systems in Latin America and the Caribbean through the establishment of a regional genetic improvement network.

oper_nm: Fighting Poverty at Continental Scale: Develop AI models to Map Informal Settlements across LAC
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to develop a standardized Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based methodology and evaluate its efficacy as a tool for mapping all informal settlements across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), assess their climate vulnerability, and guide remediation efforts. By automating the identification of informal settlements using satellite imagery and neural networks, the project will improve public service delivery and environmental safety, which is crucial to spurring economic growth by improving health, productivity, and overall quality of life in underserved communities. The methodology will be open and standardized, designed to be scaled globally by leveraging advanced AI technologies and insights from similar global initiatives - such as the European Space Agency-funded IDE Atlas project and the United Nations Innovation Technology Accelerator for Cities (UNITAC).

oper_nm: Seed potato use, production, and trade in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: Contribute to food security in LAC by improving ware potato production through increased use and production of certified seed potatoes.

oper_nm: Boosting Development Effectiveness through IDBImpact+
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to enhance a culture of impact and results among IDB clients.

oper_nm: Building Capacity for Human Resources Management Advanced Functions in LAC from the Korean Experience
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation (TC) project is to contribute to improve LAC countries' policy implementation and service delivery to citizens by strengthening their civil service through implementation of HRM advanced functions. To do so, the specific objectives of the project are to: (i) strengthen select LAC countries' civil service management and performance through HRM advanced functions such as HR planning and salary management, HR performance management and government policy priorities, senior civil servants' management system, and talent management; and (ii) exchange knowledge on best practices in HRM advanced functions.

oper_nm: Development Effectiveness of Education Policies and Interventions
objtv: The objective is to strengthen the evidence base for the IDB's education portfolio in priority thematic areas. The specific objectives are to: (i) conduct systematic evidence mapping and desk-study reviews of global and regional education policies and interventions in five thematic areas, including interventions that involve digital education technologies, education infrastructure, literacy, continuous educational trajectories, and Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET); and (ii) develop an Economic Analysis Toolkit to address identified deficiencies in efficiency analyses at project closure by providing standardized methodologies and guidance to assess the cost-effectiveness of educational interventions.

oper_nm: CARIBEquity: Accelerating Business to Business (B2B) Agribusiness Startups in the Caribbean
objtv: The objective of this project is to create and operationalize a regional agribusiness entrepreneurship hub to boost the acceleration of Business to Business (B2B) agribusiness startups in the Caribbean.

oper_nm: CARIBEquity: Accelerating Technology Adoption in Saint Lucia
objtv: The objective of this project is to create and operationalize a Tech Innovation Hub in Saint Lucia to incubate tech-startups and support founders that foster innovation and technology adoption.

oper_nm: Education, Climate Change and School Feeding
objtv: This TC aims to generate knowledge to strengthen the climate resilience of educational systems in LAC, ensuring that students can learn and complete their educational paths despite the growing threats posed by climate change.

oper_nm: Solutions to promote comprehensive care systems in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to explore low-cost, high-impact solutions to promote comprehensive care systems in the region, helping to define new lines of work for the IDB in the care economy.

oper_nm: Mainstreaming Climate Action in Private Sector Development Projects in the Caribbean
objtv: Support eligible countries and partners with the timely preparation of project proposals that satisfy the goal of Compete Caribbean + Trust Fund (CC+) to mainstream climate action in the private sector. This TC will provide project preparation support across all three (3) pillars of CC+: 1) Pillar 1 – Promoting competitiveness, climate action and inclusiveness of Caribbean private sector, 2) Pillar 2- Enhancing government capabilities to support climate-smart and gender-responsive businesses, 3) Pillar 3 – Promoting scientific R&D for climate innovation in the public and private sectors.

oper_nm: Supporting the expansion of financing for bioeconomy projects in Amazonia
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance the technical capacities of financial cooperatives, enabling them to expand financing for bioeconomy projects and activities in the Amazon region. Additionally, it aims to strengthen their connection with public financial institutions—key capital providers—by fostering knowledge exchange and implementing financial tools and innovations that would increase capital raising and deployment in the region. By leveraging the extensive reach of financial cooperatives in remote regions, this initiative will facilitate greater financial inclusion and ensure that resources effectively reach bioeconomy related activities and bio-businesses deep within the Amazon territories.

oper_nm: Energy transition frictions
objtv: The energy transition presents a unique set of challenges that extend beyond the large-scale adoption of low-carbon technologies. These challenges encompass economic, social, and institutional frictions, among others. This TC aims to develop cutting-edge knowledge products to identify, quantify, and address these frictions, with a focus on market transformations, fiscal constraints, regulatory bottlenecks, social acceptance, and the political economy of interest groups. By providing actionable insights, this project aims to help policymakers and stakeholders across Latin America and the Caribbean in designing strategies that overcome these frictions and ensure an inclusive and equitable path to sustainable growth.

oper_nm: Mineral Value Chains for Sustained Growth
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: ﻿﻿The objective of this technical cooperation is to produce a set of analyses on mining sector value chains aimed at providing policy makers in Latin America and the Caribbean evidence-based conclusions upon which to make targeted and well-designed public policy decisions.

oper_nm: Strengthening Utilities and Regulation for a Sustainable Energy Transition
subsector_nm: ENERGY INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING AND CAPACITY BUILDING
objtv: The TC will support the modernization of the regulatory framework of the energy sector in selected countries as well as the strengthening of electricity utilities, focusing on critical pillars of the energy transition in the LAC region.

oper_nm: MIG-INTEGRATION: Promoting Positive Narratives and Social Cohesion for Migrant Integration
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the Migration Unit's operational and analytical agenda on social cohesion. The activities and interventions conducted under this TC will promote social cohesion between migrant and local communities, building an ongoing agenda that produce rigorous evidence on how to fight xenophobia and prejudices.

oper_nm: Promoting Gender Equality and Addressing Gender-Based Violence in the Caribbean
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to generate analytical and technical products to strengthen the institutional and technical capacity of Caribbean governments and relevant stakeholders to address gender inequality and gender-based violence (GBV), while promoting regional knowledge exchange and dissemination.

oper_nm: Promoting Knowledge and Capacity Building through the Regional Policy Dialogue
objtv: The objective of this operation is to finance the activities of the Regional Policy Dialogue (RPD) in 2025 and 2026. In 2000, the Bank's Board of Executive Directors approved the creation of the RPD (GN-2096-2). The general objective of the RPD is to promote a high-level policy dialogue between Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries and Bank officials to identify innovative practices, strengthen institutional capacity, share experiences, both from the LAC region and other regions in the world, improve the quality of reform strategies, and promote evidence-based discussions in the region. At the same time, the RPD provides the opportunity for the Bank to receive direct feedback about countries' public policy priorities, which subsequently informs Bank's future operational program.

oper_nm: The Amazonian Nut: Restoring its gigantic potential for forest and biodiversity conservation and income generation in the Amazon Region
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support the initial development phase of a strategic, coordinated plan between Brazil, Perú and Bolivia to promote the Amazonian nut as a staple of forest standing and socio-economic productivity and well-being, repositioning it in the international and local markets. The Amazonian nut production consists of a wild harvest, currently involving a territory of approximately 58 million hectares, and engaging over 90 thousand people. Due to its biological characteristics, the commercial success of the Amazonian nut directly translates and contributes to biodiversity conservation, to other related sustainable forest value chains and to the livelihoods of the communities that depend on them. This proposal corresponds to a start-up phase for a regional governance plan to identify more targeted interventions within each of the participating countries in a second phase.

oper_nm: Tools for Development with Identity of Indigenous Peoples in Amazonia
objtv: The overall objective of this project is to generate studies and tools related to the inclusive and sustainable economic, social, and environmental development of Indigenous peoples in the Amazon region of Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Peru, and Suriname. The knowledge produced will help these countries identify sustainable development solutions aligned with the needs and expectations of diverse indigenous groups, as well as assess whether their progress is culturally relevant. Specifically, the project will generate relevant knowledge products on: a) conservation and development indicators that align with indigenous realities, b) the systematization of traditional indigenous knowledge as a foundation for designing indigenous-led project proposals, c) the implementation of an intercultural dialogue mechanism among development stakeholders to address bottlenecks identified in projects involving indigenous peoples; and, d) the dissemination of the knowledge generated. The main beneficiaries of this TC will be several national-level indigenous organizations and their represented communities across the seven participating countries, as well as national governments, which will receive new knowledge and tools to support their work with Amazonian Indigenous Peoples.

oper_nm: Strengthening of Country Systems for Environmental and Social Management
objtv: To strengthen the technical capacity of the Borrower's institutions, executing agencies, and financial intermediaries to plan, design, and implement environmental and social requirements in projects financed by the IDB, in accordance with the Environmental and Social Policy Framework (ESPF).

oper_nm: Promoting a collaborative and resilient bioeconomy in the Amazon with Indigenous women
objtv: The overall objective of this technical cooperation is to promote the leadership of indigenous women of the Amazonia by supporting their innovations in conservation, natural resource use and the application of traditional knowledge. Specifically, the project will fund a) the participation of indigenous women in national and international decision-making meetings and forums such as the Pan-Amazonian Bioeconomy Network; and b) Fellowships with training and capacity-building opportunities for indigenous women to advance their bioeconomy initiatives.

oper_nm: Enhancing enabling conditions for Bioeconomy in Amazonia through sectoral nexus
objtv: Based on the progress of Amazonia Forever, the objective of this TC is to generate, capitalize and disseminate knowledge from Amazonia Forever to advance enabling conditions to foster bioeconomy in the region through a sectoral-nexus approach. The specific objectives are: (1) develop knowledge stocktaking products that allow to demonstrate results and impacts of the Amazonia Forever Program and its Bioeconomy pillar, as well as support regional dialogue and networks to strengthen south-south knowledge transfer, coordination and coherence; (2) strategic support for high-level dialogue for the generation of public policies on issues of common interest in Amazonia, with a focus on Bioeconomy and cross-sectorial interventions and integration of natural capital in decision-making both at the national and sub-national level; and (3) facilitation of actions for the coordinated mobilization of climate, biodiversity, bioeconomy and innovative finance opportunities for supporting means of implementation in Amazonian countries (i.e. activities that close the finance-impact gap).

oper_nm: Cybersecurity and Digital Transformation in the Energy Sector
subsector_nm: ENERGY INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING AND CAPACITY BUILDING
objtv: Contribute to enhancing the energy sector's capacity in the region to advance its digital transformation. The specific objectives are: (i) increase cybersecurity capacity through the use of a cybersecurity self-assessment tool, cybersecurity audits, and providing cybersecurity training to managers, regulators, technicians, and operators; (ii) improve the efficient use of digital tools in the sector; and (iii) create opportunities for the exchange of international experiences and knowledge through visits.

oper_nm: Impact Enhancement Program (IEP)
objtv: The general objective of the IEP is to maximize the social, environmental, and economic impact of IDB Lab's investments in LAC. By addressing critical gaps in capacity and resources, the IEP will provide targeted support to IDB Lab clients (early-stage companies and VC funds), focusing on five strategic pillars: Climate and Nature, Gender Equality, Diversity, Poverty and Vulnerability; and (v) Digitalization and responsible use of technology.

oper_nm: ZIF COL-PE. Border Sounds - Phase 2
objtv: Contribute to the consolidation of intercultural spaces for transformation and protection, promoting social inclusion, border integration, and biodiversity conservation.

oper_nm: Enhancing Project Management for executions in Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Belize, Honduras
objtv: The main objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen, support, and accelerate the execution of active loan operations in the transportation sectors of Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Belize, and Honduras. The TC is framed as an operational support tool for these operations, addressing common implementation challenges that affect the efficiency, sustainability, and effectiveness of projects financed by the Bank.

oper_nm: Regional Impact Program – Disaster Risk Management and Disaster Resilience
objtv: The general objective of this project is to achieve greater impact on sustainable development and climate change in the Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) region through the implementation and promotion of priority knowledge activities necessary for the implementation of effective disaster risk management public policies in the borrowing member countries. There are three specific objectives to achieve the general objective: (i) to improve the availability and quality of risk data/information for use in development planning to enhance resilience; (ii) to develop a regional coordination mechanism for multi-country participation to ensure rapid response in the event of a disaster; and (iii) to support the expansion of post-disaster financing programs for rehabilitation and reconstruction. In addition, there is a cross-cutting objective in this program that is necessary to achieve these three specific objectives: "Improving the knowledge and skills needed to achieve resilience".

oper_nm: Supporting the deployment and expansion of the IDB CLIMA Pilot Program
objtv: The Objective of this regional research and dissemination technical cooperation is to support the ongoing development and deployment of the IDB CLIMA Pilot Program. Specifically, resources from this TC will be employed to: (i) generate the needed knowledge to review and bolster the IDB CLIMA Pilot Program's vertical logic and intervention scope; (ii) develop and deploy a Program-level and a Project-level Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) approach; (iii) carry out the needed research and dissemination activities to support the incorporation of lessons learned as the IDB CLIMA Pilot Program is being implemented; (iv) carry out the needed research activities to constitute the case for a potential expansion of the Pilot Program, including a potential donor-focused outreach; and (v) conduct needed corporate-level capacity building efforts and the development of needed support knowledge products to assist the deployment of the IDB CLIMA Pilot.

oper_nm: Improving Digital ID and Civil Registries in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC)
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to develop a methodology to assess the maturity of civil registry systems in the beneficiary countries as part of a comprehensive identification maturity model for Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). By doing so, the TC will enable countries to create detailed roadmaps to enhance their identification and civil registration systems with actionable recommendations, enhancing their capabilities and improving service delivery to their citizens.

oper_nm: Improving the regulatory, institutional, and planning PPP frameworks in LAC
objtv: The objective of this TC is to continue ﻿the improvement of the Latin America and the Caribbean enabling environment for the implementation of PPP﻿, thus contributing to regional economic growth and competitiveness through the development ﻿of efficient infrastructure.﻿

oper_nm: WorkerTech LAC: Consolidating the Entrepreneurial Ecosystem to Improve Working Conditions and Productivity for Informal and Independent Workers
objtv: The objective of this project is to improve the working conditions and increase the productivity of informal and independent workers in Latin America and the Caribbean by creating and consolidating a WorkerTech entrepreneurial ecosystem.

oper_nm: Support to Water Resources and Environmental Management through remote sensing and digital twins technology
objtv: The objective of this TC is to support water resources and environmental management and planning through the application of innovative services based on remote sensing and digital twins with the purpose of improving institutional capacities for climate adaptation, management, preparedness, and mitigation of IDB borrowing countries and to generate information to support IDB operational departments in technical activities that ensure water security and to guarantee that projects and investments meet their operational, financial and economic goals.

oper_nm: Fontagro Annual Operating Plan 2025-2028
objtv: Enhance FONTAGRO's action on the agri-food system of Latin America and the Caribbean through a clear definition of its thematic strategies, an effective communication plan, the growth of technical capacities of researchers, and the establishment of strategic alliances.

oper_nm: Enhancing Territorial Development and urban governance in Latin America and the Caribbean through Digital Technology
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the digital transformation of urban planning and governance in Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries by strengthening the institutional capacities of national and subnational governments. By applying technologies such as geospatial data systems, digital twins, and big data analytics, the TC will enhance evidence-based policymaking and integrated urban strategies, fostering more transparent, participatory, and coordinated governance. Drawing on Korea's experience in digital innovation for urban areas, the initiative will address persistent challenges, including limited access to basic services, precarious housing, and restricted economic opportunities. It will also respond to emerging pressures from population aging, shifting household structures, and climate change. Thus, this TC seeks to enable LAC governments to develop inclusive, resilient, and sustainable cities by institutionalizing digital technologies as drivers of improved urban governance and more equitable, efficient delivery of urban infrastructure and services.

oper_nm: VerdeXcelerate: AGTech for Impact
objtv: VerdeXcelerate aims to accelerate the AgrifoodTech ecosystem in Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, and Panama through a range of services for startups, including acceleration, networking, and access to financing, ensuring that women-led startups benefit.

oper_nm: Enhancing knowledge dissemination on Water Security in preparation for COP30
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to share knowledge products developed through the implementation of the Water Security Strategy and the Transboundary Program of INE/WSA at the COP 30 and events pre-COP. This includes promoting the recently approved program funded by GCF and IDB, "Improving Climate Resilience by Increasing Water Security in the Amazon Basin". While this TC focuses on the Amazon basin, it will also incorporate technical expertise and lessons learned from TCs executed in other regions of LAC. The aim is to provide reference knowledge products from these regions on water resilience, that can serve as replicable case studies for the Amazon, particularly in the context of COP30 in Belém, Brazil. The specific objectives of this TC are: (1) support the development and dissemination of knowledge products and communication materials on water resilience and the implementation of Nature-based Solutions (NbS) in the water and sanitation sector, (2) facilitate technical and political dialogues related to these knowledge products in preparation for the COP30, and (3) promote the dissemination of the GCF Water Security Program in the Amazon.

oper_nm: ZIF COL-PE Cross-border Integration for Cultural Strengthening through Community Tourism, Artisanal Production, and Circular Economy with a Regenerative Approach in the Peruvian-Colombian Amazon
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation is to promote sustainable tourism development in the Peru-Colombia Border Integration Zone (BIZ), fostering binational integration and local socioeconomic well-being while preserving cultural heritage. The specific objectives are: (i) to implement cross-border strategies for sustainable tourism with a regenerative approach; (ii) to diversify and strengthen the supply of community-based tourism and artisanal products; (iii) to establish a tourism operation model based on circular economy principles; and (iv) to create governance mechanisms that guarantee the long-term sustainability of these initiatives.

oper_nm: Local Business Support Organizations Engagement and Capacity Building in Bio-businesses in the Amazon Region of Guyana, Peru, and Suriname
objtv: This TC, part of the Amazon Bioeconomy Marketplace (ABM), aims to strengthen the bio-business ecosystem in Guyana, Peru, and Suriname by increasing exports, increasing access to credit, and attracting investment. The activities in this CT will enhance the skills of 30 Local Business Support Organizations (LBSOs) to provide technical assistance to bio-businesses on these matters. Also, with support from this CT, the Bank will organize two in-person and two virtual business matchmaking events, engaging at least 200 participants, including producers (bio-businesses), buyers, investors, international organizations, and local financial institutions. At least 30% of participating producers will be women, youth, or indigenous populations.

oper_nm: Local Business Support Organizations Engagement and Capacity Building in Bio-businesses in the Amazon Region of Colombia and Ecuador
objtv: This TC, part of the Amazon Bioeconomy Marketplace (ABM), aims to strengthen the bio-business ecosystem in Colombia and Ecuador by increasing exports and attracting investment. The activities in this CT will enhance the skills of 20 local business support organizations to provide technical assistance, helping bio-businesses on these matters. Also, with support from this CT, the Bank will organize two in-person and two virtual matchmaking events, engaging at least 200 participants, including producers (bio-businesses), buyers, investors, international organizations, and local financial institutions. At least 30% of participating producers will be women, youth, or indigenous populations.

oper_nm: Supporting Latin American and Caribbean Countries OECD Engagement Processes
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) seeks to support Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries in their OECD accession or other engagement processes, as applicable, by combining technical assistance, knowledge generation, and regional dialogue. The TC will place emphasis on Peru, Panama, and Uruguay, while also contributing to broader regional engagement and shared learning. The overall objective is to help countries meet OECD accession and partnership requirements or deeper engagement with OECD and leverage the process as a catalyst for institutional reform, transparency, and competitiveness. Specifically, the TC will: (i) provide tailored technical assistance and policy advisory services; (ii) strengthen institutional capacity through capacity building and peer-learning; (iii) generate evidence and comparative studies on OECD-aligned disciplines; (iv) facilitate regional dialogue and experience sharing; and (v) support targeted reforms in Peru, Panama, and Uruguay to advance their OECD engagement agendas.

oper_nm: Accelerating the Climate Transition of Transport and Logistics in LAC within the framework of COP30
subsector_nm: EQUIPMENT FOR LAND FREIGHT TRANSPORT, FUEL AND SUPPLIES THAT PROMOTE ENERGY EFFICIENCY IN ROAD TRANSPORT AND LOGISTIC SERVICE TEAMS
objtv: The overall objective of this technical cooperation is to support Latin American and Caribbean countries in accelerating the decarbonization of transport services and improving the resilience of infrastructure, advancing the new frontier of the sector's climate transition, aligned with climate commitments and the COP30 framework. The specific objectives are to support: (i) the definition of public policies and climate strategies for the transport sector aligned with the NDCs and COP30, (ii) the development of effective regulations for decarbonization and resilience in transport (road, air, river and maritime), and (iii) the structuring of a portfolio of climate investments in transport, including innovative financing models to scale up the sector's transition.

oper_nm: Strengthening crime prevention and response and developing human talent in Latin America
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is, within the framework of the Alliance for Security, Justice and Development, to support the strengthening of the crime response and prevention mechanisms of the countries of Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) to respond to and prevent the challenges associated with Citizen Security, especially in their transnational fight against Organized Crime by promoting knowledge-sharing initiatives and implementing international best practices to tailor solutions in the three pillars that the Alliance has defined to combat crime.

oper_nm: Promoting the development and use of satellite Earth observation technologies for disaster risk reduction
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to promote and facilitate the use of satellite Earth observation technologies for disaster risk reduction in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), by strengthening the technical and institutional capacities of the actors involved in the satellite economy and disaster risk management in the region's countries. The specific objectives are:(i) to disseminate knowledge and strengthen institutional and technical capacities in satellite technologies;(ii) to promote applied research and the generation of new technical knowledge through the design, development, and demonstration of satellite applications aimed at disaster risk reduction in priority territories of beneficiary countries selected for their high vulnerability; and(iii) to strengthen a network for collaboration, knowledge exchange, and support for innovation in the development of satellite applications in LAC.

oper_nm: Promoting Transformation in Latin-America and the Caribbean at COP 30
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to foster dialogue on shared policy challenges in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) within the framework of international climate negotiations and the Multilateral Development Banks (MDB) agenda. By facilitating regional coordination this TC will support collective action efforts. It will also fund the IDB's participation at COP30 to highlight its strategic topics like resilience, amazonia, financial innovations, climate action, and Belem alignment. Through this engagement, the IDB will: (i) strengthen its role as the leading partner in policy transformation across Latin America and the Caribbean, while positioning the region as a vital part of the global solution (ii) showcase its projects, policies, and partnerships that advance investments within and beyond LAC; (iii) position the region as a leader in addressing environmental challenges on a global scale; and (iv) foster collaboration and dialogue with clients and partners.

oper_nm: ONE Caribbean Digital Health Solutions
objtv: The general objective of this non-reimbursable Technical Cooperation (TC) is to improve the health information exchange capacity of seven Caribbean countries' (the Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Guyana, Jamaica, Suriname and Trinidad & Tobago) and increase their collective progress through better regional collaboration.

oper_nm: Alliance for Security, Justice & Development
objtv: The overall objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the generation and dissemination of knowledge by the Alliance, so that member countries can develop and implement coordinated responses to organized crime, with a focus on strategic selection and results-oriented approaches.

oper_nm: Institutional strengthening to understand and respond to the challenges of crime and violence in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The overall objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacity of security and justice sector institutions in Latin America and the Caribbean to understand and address crime and violence, as well as to improve their response capacity to the challenges associated with this issue.

oper_nm: Skills and Labor Mobility in Central America
objtv: ﻿The general objective is to identify and close skills gaps of young people to improve their labor outcomes in CAPDR. 1. Support strategic sector skills for employability by creating industry skills strategies that identify sector skills needs & available training offer. 2. To identify digital skill gaps with the deployment of digital skills surveys. 3. Train young people to close the digital skills gaps (training).

oper_nm: Supporting SME Green Transition in LAC: Policy Assessment and Global Benchmarks
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance the capacities of policymakers in Brazil and Colombia to design and implement strategies that promote the green transition and climate resilience of SMEs, through the assessment of current practices, international benchmarking, and targeted policy recommendations in areas such as green innovation, skills, technologies, energy efficiency, and entrepreneurship.

oper_nm: Evidence Generation and Strengthening Capacities for Indigenous and Afro-Descendants Populations' Inclusion
objtv: To increase knowledge about the socioeconomic conditions, structural challenges and dynamics of exclusion faced by indigenous and Afro-descendant populations in Latin America and the Caribbean, by generating evidence, disseminating research, and strengthening institutional capacities that contribute to the formulation of inclusive and scalable public policies.

oper_nm: Operational and strategic knowledge for improving investment in social infrastructure
objtv: Strengthen operational and strategic knowledge for the development of social infrastructure projects, and strengthen capacities to ensure the incorporation of best practices, innovation, sustainability, and resilience, as well as generate support for sectoral strategic dialogue.

oper_nm: Strengthening Public Sector Management, Institutional Capacity and the Rule of Law in LAC
objtv: The objective of this TC is to strengthen the institutional capacity and the rule of law (State Effectiveness) of the public administrations in the region to enhance results and development effectiveness.
