To achieve this, the TC will collaborate with selected public agencies in the region to: (i) conduct analytical work to identify the most significant State Effectiveness gaps that hinder the delivery of their functions and services; and (ii) design, implement, and iteratively adapt interventions to improve State Effectiveness by addressing the identified gaps in public agencies of beneficiary countries.

oper_nm: Strengthening the OLAS Community of Practice and generating data and research in water and sanitation
objtv: Support the development and strengthening of the OLAS collaboration network in order to promote the efficient management of water and sanitation data in the region. This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to generate practical knowledge and useful tools to improve decision-making and public policies in the sector, fostering sustainability and sectoral innovation through the availability of data.

oper_nm: Climate and Green Finance Tracking & Paris Alignment – Audit Action Plan
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to deliver on the Audit Action Plan (AAP) and to further enhance the process of Climate Finance, Green Finance, and Paris Alignment. It would bring the necessary resources and expertise to be able to deliver on these actions, so that climate considerations in operations are better prepared and addressed, both from the IDB and the Borrower's perspective. This would result in more agile processes and in clearer expectations so that IDB staff and clients can better integrate these climate aspects from the earliest stages of project preparation.

oper_nm: Strengthening the strategic use of data in education
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to improve the quality, coverage, accessibility, and usability of geospatial and higher education data in Latin America and the Caribbean. The specific goal is to integrate geospatial data and higher education data into the Bank's educational data platform, CIMA. This integration will enable the adoption of an educational pathways perspective and enhance the use of data to inform decision-making.

oper_nm: Strengthening Competition Authorities in LAC
objtv: Strengthen the capacity of competition authorities in LAC to implement competition laws and policies and address illegal anticompetitive practices in a more efficient and collaborative manner, based on international best practices. The specific objectives are (i) to support efforts to conduct Peer Reviews of LAC countries with technical support from the OECD; (ii) to support the holding of the Latin American and Caribbean Competition Forum; (iii) to conduct reviews and proposals for the modernization of legal and regulatory frameworks, including manuals and guides; and (iv) to support the development of training for the implementation of competition laws.

oper_nm: Regulation for innovative market infrastructures development in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The objective of this TC is to generate knowledge to inform an enabling policy environment for advancing innovative financial markets as pivotal pathways to financial stability, financial inclusion, and the protection of investors and consumers. This project will: i) identify and disseminate best practices for regulatory interventions in emerging financial technology sectors such as cryptoassets and tokenization, with a particular focus on the specific challenges and opportunities within Latin America and the Caribbean; and ii) strengthen the knowledge of regional regulators to analyze these markets and their regulation.

oper_nm: Turning Climate into Sector Policy Reforms and Investments
objtv: This Regional Technical Cooperation (TC) seeks to support Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries in translating their climate commitments and planning instruments—such as Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC), Long-Term Strategies (LTS), National Adaptation Plans (NAP), and sectoral climate plans—into concrete, actionable economy-wide and sectoral policies and investment strategies as catalysts for achieving national socioeconomic objectives. Specifically, the TC will support climate action design and implementation by assisting sectors—such as finance and treasury, energy, transport, industry, and agriculture, among others—in designing and executing policies and investments aligned with national climate objectives, ensuring that each sector's leading institutions drive implementation.

oper_nm: Sustainable Tourism: Research and dissemination to improve competitiveness in LAC
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to the strengthening of the tourism sector in Latin America and the Caribbean through the generation, systematization, and dissemination of relevant knowledge, as well as the improvement of the capacities of public policy makers and other key stakeholders. This approach aims to address information gaps by generating and providing access to data, as well as creating empirical evidence to support public policy decisions based on reliable information.

oper_nm: Support to dissemination of new knowledge in the Early Childhood Development agenda
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the design, development, and dissemination of critical knowledge products in the Early Childhood Development (ECD) agenda, including the update of the existing Massive Open Online Course (MOOC), using new technologies that will be added to edX and Coursera; the dissemination of ongoing knowledge products on emerging ECD topics (such as migration, emergency response, and mental health); and the organization of the 2025 Regional Policy Dialogue (RPD) of the Social Protection and Labor Markets Division of the Social Sector (SPL/SCL), which will include the closing event of the ECD Innovation Fund.

oper_nm: Urban Climate Resilience through Neighborhood-level Experimentation and Design
objtv: The primary aim of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance resiliency and biodiversity in Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) cities by integrating green solutions into urban design. The specific objectives of this TC are to (i) build a comprehensive knowledge base on climate vulnerability and resilience in urban areas across LAC, identifying gaps and opportunities for transformative climate resilience interventions; (ii) develop innovative solutions that enhance urban climate resiliency on a neighborhood level through pilot projects and urban experimentation; and (iii) increase the visibility of nature-based solutions, strengthen capacities and fill knowledge gaps on how to integrate climate resilience and biodiversity in the urban design process.

oper_nm: Improving technology for transparency, data-driven decisions, and smart public services
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional and technological capacities of Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) governments to increase transparency, prevent and control corruption, strengthen financial integrity, and improve the delivery of public services, both at the national and subnational levels. This will be achieved through the adoption of instruments and solutions that are part of the MapaInversiones1 and Knowledge for Results (K4R)2 initiatives, which serve as foundational pillars to promote strategic reforms in transparency, accountability, and efficiency in the delivery of public services. The specific objectives are: (i) to integrate, manage, and use public data in a transparent and traceable manner, through digital solutions based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) and data visualization tools; (ii) to improve monitoring, evaluation, and financial integrity systems to support evidence-based decision-making and strengthen accountability; and (iii) to promote institutional innovation through the design and validation of scalable operating models focused on concrete results in the delivery of public services.

oper_nm: Concessional Finance in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The primary objective is to strengthen the capacities of countries to: (i) prioritize and develop a strategic pipeline of climate-related projects that align with their national climate plans and international commitments; and (ii) prepare high-quality, bankable project and program proposals that meet the investment criteria of major climate concessional funds. This TC will build on previous efforts to support LAC countries in accessing diverse sources of concessional finance from multilateral and bilateral funding mechanisms.

oper_nm: Support for improving the effectiveness of social protection and employment policies
objtv: To enhance the operational effectiveness and development outcomes of social protection and employment policies by strengthening the design, monitoring, and evaluation frameworks through evidence-based tools, systematic indicators and learning, and the integration of evaluability principles.

oper_nm: Adaptive Social Protection: Towards More Shock-Responsive Social Programs
objtv: The objective of the TC is to develop country-specific proposals to identify the main pro-poor programs in the region and, if warranted, to make them more adaptable, ensuring they can effectively protect vulnerable populations from systemic or idiosyncratic shocks.

oper_nm: Regional Support for Labor Market and Social Protection Policies for Resilience
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the capacity of labor market and social protection policies to prepare for and respond to extreme weather events, environmental degradation, and biodiversity loss in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). The specific objectives are to: (i) estimate the effect of extreme weather events, environmental degradation and biodiversity loss on labor markets and poor and vulnerable households, using geospatial data, and provide actionable insights to align these policies to national mitigation and adaptation commitments (ii); strengthen the adaptation capacity of labor market and social protection programs and services by developing and evaluating interventions in selected countries and, (iii) disseminate and exchange good practices and experiences between LAC countries.

oper_nm: Promote and support the implementation of the Coordinated Border Management Model in Central America
subsector_nm: TRADE FACILITATION, TRADE LOGISTICS AND CUSTOMS
objtv: The general objective is to support the implementation of actions outlined in the Central American Strategy for Trade Facilitation and Competitiveness (ECF CC-2023) with regard to the Coordinated Border Management (CBM) model, in order to improve controls, the clearance of goods, and the movement of people. Specifically, this Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support three areas directly related to the CBM model: (i) contribute to the approval and implementation of the regional CBM model as a strategic instrument for the region; (ii) strengthen the technical capacities of the countries in implementing the ECF CC-2023; and (iii) create spaces to maintain and strengthen support for their trade facilitation and competitiveness agenda within the process of economic integration in Central America.

oper_nm: Climate resilience and pertinence of Education in the Amazon: implementing the Belém Declaration
objtv: The general objective of the TC is to establish a ministerial network to coordinate and define the action plan for implementing the pillars outlined in the Belém Declaration. To achieve this, the TC will support strategic activities and products, including: (i) the establishment, consolidation, and capacity building of the ministerial education network; (ii) the generation of knowledge regarding the maturity level of policies associated with the different pillars of the Declaration and best practices for their implementation; and (iii) the development of action plans to implement the objectives of the Belem Declaration.

oper_nm: LAPEF: An innovative solution for advancing equity
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The general objective of this proposal is to analyze the equity of various fiscal country specific interventions and provide technical and practical advice to Latin American and Caribbean governments to improve fiscal policies and effectively reduce poverty and inequality. The specific objectives are to (i) integrate equity into fiscal policy design to ensure that fiscal policies balance equity with efficiency, sustainability, and economic growth while minimizing unintended negative consequences; (ii) enhance policy design with the use of rigorous quantitative and qualitative analysis to assess the distributional impacts of fiscal policies and improve resource allocation; and (iii) support policymakers with evidence-based Insights to provide governments with analytical tools to design, compare, and implement effective and equitable fiscal policies across the region.

oper_nm: Analysis of Agricultural Policies and Environmental Performance in LAC
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance agricultural productivity and innovation, strengthen climate change resilience, and promote food security by supporting the governments of the Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) region through the following specific objectives: (i) improving the efficiency and effectiveness of agricultural policies and identifying innovative opportunities to mitigate the environmental impact of agricultural practices; (ii) implementing and monitoring agricultural policies and programs; and (iii) designing policies that recognize and quantify the value of ecosystem services within agricultural systems.﻿

oper_nm: Strengthening agrifood supply chains compliance with international deforestation-free trade standard
objtv: Strengthen the capacity of member countries in the LAC region to implement effective policy strategies to comply with international deforestation-free trade standards, including the EU Deforestation-free Trade Regulation (EUDR). Specific objectives include: (i) increasing countries' capacity to benchmark deforestation risks; (ii) strengthening country readiness to comply with EUDR requirements, including traceability and legality of production as well as due diligence; and (iii) strengthening private-public partnerships aiming at overcoming information asymmetry and widening the participation of small and medium-sized farms and intermediary firms in supply chains.

oper_nm: Support to the ratification, early implementation and leverage of the MERCOSUR-European Union Agreement
subsector_nm: TRADE AND INVESTMENT AGREEMENTS AND REGULATIONS
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to strengthen the technical and institutional capacity of the MERCOSUR full member countries in the early stages of signing, ratifying, and implementing the bi-regional trade agreement with the European Union (EU). The specific objectives are: (i) to assess the economic and regulatory impacts, as well as the legal and institutional reforms needed to fully leverage the agreement; (ii) to provide technical support to national authorities during the signing, legislative ratification, and design of implementation plans; and (iii) to identify priority areas for intra-regional intervention to prevent the erosion of trade preferences, the obsolescence of the regional regulatory framework, and to jointly seize new market access opportunities.

oper_nm: Transforming Construction in Latin America and the Caribbean: Digitalization and Innovation as keys to Sustainability
objtv: Strengthen the capacities of public agencies responsible for public works management and innovation to foster productivity and sustainability in the construction sector.

oper_nm: Productive Development and Innovation: Driving Green Productive Transformation in Latin America
objtv: Support the region's Innovation Agencies in fostering transformative innovation required for competitive productive development, aligned with global pathways for the green transition.

oper_nm: Strengthening financial management and emergency response to disasters in LAC
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the institutional capacity of Latin American and Caribbean countries for financial risk management and response to emergencies caused by disasters. The specific objectives are: (i) to strengthen institutional capacity for disaster emergency preparedness and response; (ii) to strengthen institutional capacity to build financial resilience to climate and disaster risk; and (iii) to strengthen institutional capacity to integrate a differentiated approach for vulnerable groups in emergency response.

oper_nm: Support for Integrity Policies and the control of money laundering and financial flows
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to design and implement transparency, integrity, and oversight policies in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). The specific objectives are: (i) to strengthen institutional capacities for the prevention and combating of money laundering and asset recovery; (ii) to support digital solutions for public integrity and auditing that strengthen accountability; and (iii) to promote greater knowledge on transparency, integrity, and oversight through the development of studies and the exchange of experiences.

oper_nm: Modern Agricultural Knowledge & Innovation Systems to boost Climate-Smart & Nature-Positive Agrifood Systems
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation is to contribute to the modernization of agricultural knowledge and innovation systems in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC), to enhance their capacity to efficiently and inclusively support (particularly considering small farmers, women, and indigenous peoples) the scaling up of climate-smart and nature-positive productive practices.

oper_nm: Regional Innovation and Entrepreneurship Ecosystems: articulation, capacities and policies
objtv: The objective of this TC is to contribute to the strengthening of local institutional capacities for the collaborative design, implementation and monitoring of innovation and productive development strategies with a territorial approach, favoring the articulation and dynamization of Regional Innovation and Entrepreneurship Ecosystems (RIEE) in Latin America.

oper_nm: Private Finance Mobilization and Capital Markets Innovation
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to strengthen the government's capacities to mobilize private capital into sustainable investments. The specific objectives are: (i) to enhance regulatory frameworks and institutional capacity to strengthen domestic capital markets; and (ii) to support the design and implementation of innovative financial mechanisms.

oper_nm: Supporting Institutional Capacity and Innovation in Public Development Banks
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation is to strengthen the institutional capacity of Public Development Banks (PDBs) to enhance their operational and innovation capacity to measure and improve effectiveness and impact. The specific objectives are to support PBDs in: (i) the quantification of the mobilization effect of their lending ; (ii) improving their environmental and social (E&S) risk management strategies and processes; and (iii) capacity building through dissemination forums and exchange of lessons learned among the development financial institutions in the region.

oper_nm: Impact of Fiscal Policy in LAC
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: This Technical Cooperation aims to strengthen the evidence base on fiscal policy effectiveness across the Latin American region, with an initial emphasis on addressing tax compliance challenges.

oper_nm: Strengthening Health Systems Quality to Achieve Better Outcomes in LAC
objtv: This general objective of this proposal is to support the design, implementation, and operation of high-quality health systems and foster cross-country learning. The specific objectives are (1) develop an up-to-date blueprint to guide HNP's analytical and operational agenda on how to design and implement high quality health systems (2) build on the 2025 flagship and DRP on high-quality health systems by creating a community of practice and (3) generate operational knowledge by supporting a demonstrative project in one country in the region, leveraging existing operations.

oper_nm: Social protection, environmental conservation, and development of sustainable livelihoods in Amazon
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to support the evaluation of social protection programs that simultaneously aim at environmental conservation and the development of sustainable livelihoods in Amazonia. Then, the specific objectives are: i) generate rigorous evidence on cash‐transfer programs with integrated environmental and social objectives and ii) Promote sustained knowledge exchange among Amazonian countries.

oper_nm: Support to Pan-American Highway for Digital Health (PH4H)
objtv: Support the development and implementation of tools and support services for the design, implementation, and evaluation of country operations with digital components and provide implementation support to the IDB's digital health portfolio.

oper_nm: Rethinking youth services: integrated prevention and care for adolescent pregnancy and violence
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to the reduction of teenage pregnancy and the prevalence of sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV) among adolescents.

oper_nm: Strengthening Urban Leadership and Capacity
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to equip local and national urban counterparts to effectively address regional challenges related to resilience and urban productivity through capacity-building activities and knowledge-sharing in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) cities. The specific objectives are: (i) to enhance resilience and productivity capacities by providing city leaders and officials with the tools to design and implement urban policies and projects that strengthen adaptive capacity and enhance city conditions for productivity; and (ii) to foster networking and peer learning among cities to identify common challenges and opportunities in building resilient and productive urban environments, share best practices, and develop innovative solutions to urban issues.

oper_nm: Supporting the Advancement of AI in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: Improve the capacity of Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries to harness the benefits of Artificial Intelligence (AI) by promoting the three pillars that make up an enabling ecosystem for their development: governance, data and infrastructure, and human capital.

oper_nm: Analysis of the Economic Impact of the Capricorn Integration Route
objtv: The specific objectives include a) the analysis of key gaps (infrastructure, policy, and ﬁnancing) and risks for effective and impactful interventions, b) the identification of complementary projects, policies, and institutions that promote regional integration and corridor development, and c) a cost-benefit analysis of the Capricorn Integration Route project. The resulting deliverables will include knowledge products that will contribute to installing agenda, policy dialogue, coordination across countries, and the design of effective interventions.

oper_nm: Amazon Cities Forum in the framework of COP30
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) will strengthen the work plan of the Forum of Amazonian Cities, considering the opportunity to highlight urban issues in the Amazon through the United Nations Climate Change Conference, Conference of the Parties (COP30), in Belém, Brazil, in November 2025. The specific objectives of this TC are: (i) to build a common agenda for Amazonian governments for sustainable urban development in the lead-up to COP30, to be highlighted at global, regional, and national levels; (ii) to consolidate the institutional framework of the Forum and complete its incorporation process into the Amazon Cooperation Treaty Organization (ACTO), contributing to the improvement of its governance, the recording of its achievements and internal processes, as well as its engagement with members and the external public; and (iii) to enhance the resource mobilization capacities for climate resilience projects of the member cities of the Forum of Amazonian Cities.

oper_nm: Knowledge and Multilevel Cooperation for Sustainable Urban Development in Amazonia
objtv: To collect and disseminate data and experiences on urban areas in the Amazon region, in order to promote the use of evidence in the formulation of policies, programs and projects, and investment priorities for sustainable urban development in the Amazon region. The specific objectives of this TC are: (i) Disseminate the main findings of the knowledge products of the TC "Intelligence and knowledge sharing for Amazonian cities" (RG-T4435), with special emphasis on their relevance for the pre-, during and post-COP30 contexts; (ii) Strengthen the dialogue with and among academia on sustainable urbanization in the Amazon, and between academia and practitioners, promoting the generation and transfer of knowledge that contributes to the formulation of public policies and sustainable local practices; and (iii) Promote the establishment of a Strategic Framework for Sustainable Urban Development for the Amazon through regional multilevel cooperation and its articulation with Amazonian national governments.

oper_nm: Efficient logistics corridors to improve connectivity in South America
objtv: The objective of this TC is to contribute to strengthening regional transport connectivity to bolster competitiveness and promote sustainable growth in South America. To achieve this, this TC will analyze transport infrastructure gaps and bottlenecks; evaluate transport and logistics requirements for relevant supply chains (both at the regional and national levels), assess transport services regulatory frameworks with a view to their improvement and efficiency.

oper_nm: Supporting the implementation of America en el Centro in CAPDR countries
objtv: The general objective of this proposal is to support América en el Centro achieve its development objectives in beneficiary countries facilitating the implementation of crucial activities for the success of the program. The specific objectives are to: (i) enable the generation and dissemination of knowledge to cover information gaps in the program's priority areas and promote knowledge sharing and the exchange of best practices; (ii) implement tools to enhance transparency, accountability and monitor development impacts; and (iii) support a comprehensive communication strategy to strengthen the buy-in of the program with relevant stakeholders.

oper_nm: AI Generated Synthetic Data (AIGSD) for better Productive Development Programs (PDP)
objtv: To strengthen the institutional capacities of national counterparts by enhancing the design, selection, and evaluation of Productive Development Programs (PDP) (especially, programs to promote technical-extension and creation/adoption of innovation in firms) through the application of Artificial Intelligence Generated Synthetic Data (AIGSD) and Machine Learning (ML) methodologies.

oper_nm: Improving health resilience and pandemic preparednes in LAC through primary care and OneHealth
objtv: Contribute to preparedness against health emergencies and pandemics in the region through guidelines for quantifying vulnerabilities, the development of costed investment plans, the strengthening of primary health care, and the promotion of the OneHealth approach.

oper_nm: Strategic support for investment facilitation in Latin America and the Caribbean
subsector_nm: TRADE AND INVESTMENT AGREEMENTS AND REGULATIONS
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to provide strategic support to Suriname, Belize and Honduras in the implementation of the Investment Facilitation for Development (IFD) Agreement of the World Trade Organization (WTO). This support aims to enhance the countries' capacity to attract and retain high-quality foreign direct investment (FDI) by aligning national policies and practices with the provisions of the IFD Agreement. The TC has two specific objectives: (i) to assist LAC countries in conducting their IFD Agreement self-assessment; and (ii) to generate knowledge exchange and dissemination of best practices in the implementation of investment facilitation measures.

oper_nm: Empowering IDB & LAC: Mainstreaming Biodiversity & Natural Capital for Sustainable Growth
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the systematic integration of biodiversity and natural capital into development frameworks across Latin America and the Caribbean through evidence-based knowledge generation, standardized nature finance metrics, and enhanced institutional capacity for biodiversity mainstreaming. By providing decision-makers with robust analytical tools, practical guidance, and proven methodologies, this TC expect to help to transform how the region values and manages its natural capital in alignment with the IDB Group Natural Capital and Biodiversity Mainstreaming Action Plan (2024-2025).

oper_nm: Productive and logistical integration of the Bolivian and Peruvian Amazon
subsector_nm: TRADE FACILITATION, TRADE LOGISTICS AND CUSTOMS
objtv: The overall objective of this TC is to support the productive and logistical integration of the non-timber forest products (NTFP) chain in the Amazon region of Bolivia and Peru and to identify opportunities for the development of cross-border productive chains that will increase the participation of local communities in sustainable economic activities based on the use of forest products and their biodiversity, thereby promoting and supporting their long-term conservation.

oper_nm: Saving Lives: Strengthening Regional Action for Safer Mobility
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance road safety and promote sustainable, inclusive, and accessible mobility systems in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) through the Bank's safe mobility strategy. This initiative aims to save lives by strengthening governance, enhancing urban spaces and road infrastructure, and empowering communities through knowledge and research, with a focus on vulnerable populations such as children, adolescents, elderly, women and People with Disabilities (PwD).

oper_nm: Cities for All: Housing and Urban Services Supporting Women, People with Disabilities, and Elders
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support research and dissemination efforts that reduce the negative impacts of natural disasters on people with disabilities, older adults, and female-headed households in urban areas of Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC).

oper_nm: Pathways to Decarbonize Maritime Transport and Adapt Port Infrastructure to Climate Change in LAC
objtv: To examine viable pathways for the decarbonization of maritime transport in Latin American and the Caribbean (LAC), evaluate the ramifications of the International Maritime Organization (IMO) strategy, and propose policy recommendations for regional stakeholders to facilitate a transition towards sustainable maritime operations.

oper_nm: Designing Sustainable Development Corridors in South America
objtv: The objective of this TC is to implement the South Connection Program in three strategic priorities: enhancing physical and digital infrastructure for regional connectivity; optimizing logistics and trade facilitation to streamline processes, reduce costs, and strengthening supply chains; enhancing regulatory frameworks and institutional capacities to foster better policies, promote investment, and ensure efficient governance. Hence, this TC will carry out studies and research to advance the agenda of South Connection Program in the 11 countries.

oper_nm: Strengthening and Expansion of CWUIC to Enhance Resiliency in the Water and Sanitation Sector in the Caribbean
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to strengthen and expand Caribbean Water Utilities Insurance Collective (CWUIC) to enhance resiliency in the water and sanitation (W&S) sector in the Caribbean. The specific objectives are: (i) evaluate the performance of CWUIC's three programs: (a) Parametric Insurance Program (regional risk pooling), (b) Response Program (assistance in disaster preparedness and response), and (c) Resilience Program (assistance to strengthen the capacity to withstand hazard impacts through targeted investments), as well as its organizational and governance structure; (ii) strengthen the Response Program; (iii) explore new areas for the Parametric Insurance Program; (iv) enhance the Resilience Program; and (v) implement dissemination and stakeholder engagement activities.

oper_nm: Support for the implementation of the Disaster Risk Management Action Plan (DRM-AP)
objtv: The general objective of this Regional TC is to expand and improve the quality of the Bank's operational and analytic work to foster more proactive disaster risk management (DRM) for IDB member countries., Particularly, the TC will focus on improving the quality of operational and analytic work related to a comprehensive approach that pays special attention to actions aimed at strengthening resilience before a hazard turns into a disaster. The specific objective of this TC is to realize high-quality implementation of several priority activities set out in the IDB Group Disaster Risk Management Action Plan (DRM-AP) 2024-2025, aiming at achieving the aforementioned general objective.

oper_nm: Promotion the Supply of Social Housing for Vulnerable Populations in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: Provide financing solutions and policies that encourage the supply of social housing through the production of well-located land and alternatives to address the quantitative and qualitative housing deficit of vulnerable populations. This includes improving, repairing, expanding, self-producing, or acquiring new or used housing, or lots with services.

oper_nm: Platform for a Sustainable Cattle Production in the Amazon Region
objtv: To facilitate the transition from conventional cattle ranching practices to sustainable cattle management models that integrate biodiversity protection and ecosystem restoration, while achieving higher levels of economic, social, and environmental benefits within the Amazon biome.

oper_nm: The institutional implications of population decline in LAC
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to generate and disseminate knowledge on the institutional implications of demographic change in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). By producing rigorous analysis and effectively communicating insights across the region, the TC seeks to deepen understanding, inform public discourse, and strengthen the capacity of policymakers to design and implement reforms that address the demographic challenge.

oper_nm: Supporting the Pacific Alliance in Deepening Trade Integration and Advancing the Digital Economy
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to provide technical assistance and funding to the member countries of the Pacific Alliance (PA)—Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru—in deepening their trade and economic integration, including leveraging opportunities in regional value chains, strengthening the participation of SMEs, and advancing the implementation of the Regional Digital Market (RDM).

oper_nm: ConnectAmericas Women: Productive, Financial, and Digital Transformation for Entrepreneurs
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to strengthen the technical, productive, and export capacities of women-led or women-owned small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Latin America and the Caribbean, promoting their sustainable inclusion in local, regional, and global value chains. This effort seeks to address the systemic challenges these companies face that hinder their growth, competitiveness, and internationalization, such as limited access to financing, low participation in supply chains, limited access to digital transformation tools, and narrow networks.

oper_nm: Mapping illegal gold mining and its consequences in the Andean Region
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to map the current and potential areas of illegal gold mining and estimate the impacts of this sector. This TC seeks to close existing evidence and knowledge gaps related to the illegal gold mining sector in CAN countries, supporting policymakers in these countries. Specifically, this TC will seek to: (i) Identify the potential extent of these illegal mining activities in the CAN region; (ii) measure the impact of illegal gold mining on key socioeconomic and environmental factors in countries in the region; (iii) generate a toolbox for policymakers to identify potential areas of illegal gold mining and collateral illicit activities, as well as their socioeconomic impacts.

oper_nm: Improving Subnational Fiscal Sustainability in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the improvement of subnational fiscal sustainability in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). This objective will be achieved through the institutional strengthening of intergovernmental fiscal arrangements, the enhancement of the capacities of the governing bodies of decentralization to carry out more effective fiscal monitoring, and the strengthening of the financial condition and creditworthiness of intermediate and local levels of government in the region.

oper_nm: Support for data generation and information exploitation for government effectiveness
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) seeks to help close this knowledge gap by assessing the institutional capacities of governments at both national and subnational levels. The focus will be on evaluating the efficiency and effectiveness of public expenditure and public sector management considering both the formal legal and regulatory frameworks (de jure) and their actual implementation (de facto).

oper_nm: Support for Northern Central America (NCA) for Initial Assistance and Reintegration of Returnees
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to strengthen the institutional capacity of governments in initial care services and reintegration of returnees in order to generate sustainable public policies.﻿﻿i) To support the design, development, and implementation of policies, protocols, and procedures for the reception of returnees. ii) The design and implementation of reintegration programs that include interinstitutional strategies for the provision of services to facilitate the sustainable inclusion of returned individuals in their communities of origin; iii) To promote institutional and regional coordination to improve the quality of the management of reintegration programs.

oper_nm: Support to the CARICOM Regional Migration Policy
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support the development, implementation, and country-level adoption of the CARICOM Regional Migration Policy Framework and the Regional Labour Migration Policy Framework, as well as the broad dissemination of both. The overarching objective is to build regional capacity to advance human mobility and labor inclusion across CARICOM member states.

oper_nm: Support for the preparation and implementation of the GCF-IDB Program “Improving Climate Resilience"
objtv: The general objective of the TC is to structure a pipeline of projects aligned with the eligibility criteria of the IDB-GCF Program for Climate Resilience and Water Security in the Amazon and provide technical support to the beneficiary countries in its preparation and implementation.

oper_nm: Promoting resilience and decarbonization in the water, sanitation and waste sectors in LAC
objtv: This Technical Cooperation aims to strengthen climate resilience and promote the transition toward a low-carbon water, sanitation, and waste sector in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). To this end, the TC will facilitate the generation of technical knowledge, capacity building, and the structuring of projects aligned with the region's environmental and climate commitments, in line with the IDB's new institutional strategy (Impact+).

oper_nm: Strengthening Fiscal Governance through Comparative Data and Policy Insights in Latin American and Caribbean (LAC)
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: The general objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance the capacities of public and fiscal management policymakers in Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries by developing and applying a set of indicators that enable the comparative assessment of relative performance across countries and against member states of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), contributing to the strengthen of public institutions.

oper_nm: Integration of Mining Value Chains for Energy
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: The general objective of this TC is to understand the policy challenges for the development of productive corridors related to extractive industries in Andean countries and to provide policy recommendations. The TC will finance relevant studies and assessments that will inform policymakers. Specifically, this TC will finance assessments to: (i) identify the productive potential for development of value chains related to extractive industries; (ii) identify potential productive corridors in Andean countries and analyze the potential externalities of these corridors related to the sectors identified in point (i); (iii) analyze 2–4 value chains related to extractive industries linked to the productive corridors identified in point (i); (iv) strengthen existing economic and econometric models to better estimate the economic impact of promoting the value chains outlined in point (i); and (v) understand the subnational institutional framework and how it can be supported to effectively promote and reap the greatest benefits from reinforced productive corridors.

oper_nm: Strengthening ACTO for the Development of a Regional Strategy for Sustainable Amazonian Bioeconomy
objtv: To contribute to the development and validation of a Bioeconomy Strategy for the Amazon region, strengthening coordination among ACTO member countries, generating specialized technical studies, and promoting comprehensive positioning (local, regional, and international) to advance towards a sustainable development model that integrates biodiversity conservation, valuation of ecosystem services, and the wellbeing of local communities.

oper_nm: Defining the factors that drive water consumption and access in Latin America and the Caribbean
objtv: The objective of this technical cooperation is to strengthen public policy design in urban contexts by studying the factors that determine differences in water consumption. This approach focuses on: (i) specific household characteristics (size, gender composition, race, sexual identity, presence of people with disabilities, etc.) to develop policies that close access gaps; (ii) management elements for operators, such as tariffs, campaigns to minimize consumption, and support for the exchange of residential amenities; and (iii) the environment surrounding households (urban context, density, infrastructure availability, etc.) to identify the connections between land use and water security from a regulatory perspective in four pilot cities in Brazil, Ecuador, and Mexico.

oper_nm: GovTech Connect: Boosting Public-Private Collaboration Ecosystems through Emerging Technologies and Open Source Solutions
objtv: GovTech Connect seeks to strengthen and connect actors in the GovTech ecosystem in Latin America to promote the adoption of GovTech solutions in local governments.

oper_nm: Global Entrepreneurship and Technology (GET) Forum
objtv: The objective of this project is to contribute to thedissemination of knowledge and best practices in MSMEs andthe innovation and entrepreneurship ecosystem in LatinAmerica and the Caribbean, through the organization of the"Global Entrepreneurship and Technology (GET) Forum",formerly called "IDB Lab Forum", and the preparation ofrelated knowledge products to serve as a platform ofdissemination and dialogue with partners and stakeholders.

oper_nm: Strengthen execution feasibility in Social Protection and Labor Markets thorough process improvement
objtv: Enhance project execution of projects in the areas of social protection and employment. Specific objectives: (i) enhance the monitoring, execution feasibility, and adaptive management of SPL projects by developing standardized management tools that integrate both qualitative and quantitative approaches. These tools will strengthen decision-making processes, link outputs to outcomes, and improve operational tracking mechanisms to ensure a focus on achieving results through effective implementation strategies; (ii) strengthen the skills of project teams and executing agencies to monitor and execute projects.

oper_nm: Best Operational Practices and Lessons for improving implementation and effectiveness in health
objtv: The specific objectives of the TC are: (I) To analyze the composition, functioning, and performance of the implementation models used in health infrastructure projects to identify best practices; and (II) To assess performance of the implementation of integrated health networks and systematize the experiences

oper_nm: 7th K-LAC Business Summit
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to significantly deepen the economic and strategic partnership between Korea and the Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) region, marking the 20th anniversary of Korea's membership in the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB). The TC aims to: (1) Facilitate inclusive and sustainable economic partnerships; (2) Promote co-innovation and joint investment between Korea and LAC economies; (3) Share Korea's development experiences and technologies in priority sectors; (4) Build institutional and private sector capacity through focused knowledge exchange and business networking platforms.

oper_nm: From Dollars to Impact. Measuring the Effectiveness of IDB Climate Finance
objtv: (1) Track effectiveness and portfolio-level results of climate finance of the IDB portfolio primarily relying on existing project-cycle IDB data systems; (2) Strengthen institutional processes, capacity, accountability, and transparency of the development effectiveness of climate finance.

oper_nm: Enhancing the Effectiveness of Gender and Diversity (G&D) Interventions Mainstreamed in IDB Loans
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance the effectiveness of gender and diversity (G&D) interventions mainstreamed in IDB loans by strengthening their design, execution, and monitoring processes. The specific objectives are: i) analyze information on how G&D interventions and their indicators perform in operations, ii) assess the effectiveness of monitoring and evaluation mechanisms for G&D interventions, and iii) provide actionable recommendations to project teams to improve the design, execution and monitoring of G&D interventions mainstreamed in operations.

oper_nm: Strengthening the Innovation and Investment Ecosystem in the Caribbean
objtv: The objective of this TC is to strengthen the institutional capabilities of key stakeholders by addressing the main gaps in productivity, innovation, and investment ecosystem in the Caribbean. The specific objectives are to: (i) address financing and investment gaps in firms and Startups in the Caribbean; (ii) engage in capacity building activities for stake holders in the innovation and investment ecosystems; and (iii) to generate and disseminate knowledge related objectives.

oper_nm: Strengthening the enabling environment for the development of efficient PPPs in Latin America and the Caribbean. Learning from the Korean experience
objtv: The ultimate goal of this Technical Cooperation is to leverage the Korean experience to enhance PPP public policy in LAC mature economies, while also understanding the dynamics of the PPP market and identifying opportunities for new players. Firstly, the TC will support LAC countries in creating a more conducive environment for developing strong and effective PPPs. This will involve improving the regulatory and institutional frameworks for PPP planning, selection, and prioritization within the region (Component 1). Additionally, the TC will focus on enhancing the processes for PPP project preparation, structuring, and financing in two LAC countries (Component 2). These technical assistance efforts will be informed by comprehensive analyses and best practices from around the world, particularly drawing from Korea's experiences. Secondly, the initiative will conduct a diagnosis of international actors who have the potential for increased engagement in Latin America and the Caribbean. This will include analyzing challenges and opportunities for their active participation by sector, subsector, region, and country, while leveraging South Korea's expertise in PPP (Component 3). By aligning regulatory reforms with market insights, this TC will help attract new stakeholders, enhance competition in PPPs, and contribute to the development of high-quality infrastructure in the LAC region.

oper_nm: Project Performance in FCCV settings
objtv: The general objective of this technical cooperation is to generate evidence-based knowledge and practical recommendations that enhance operational performance and effectiveness in contexts affected by Fragility, Conflict, and Criminal Violence (FCCV). The specific objectives are i) to identify the effects of FCCV on the performance and effectiveness of Bank-financed operations, and ii) to identify good practices in the design, implementation, supervision, and evaluation of projects in FCCV contexts

oper_nm: Assistance to the Public Sector for the structuring of efficient, resilient and affordable Public Private Partnerships
objtv: The objective of this TC is to improve the preparation of PPP projects in beneficiary countries to increase effectiveness of their infrastructure programs.

oper_nm: From Monitoring Execution to Impact: A Midterm Evaluation Model for Institutional Capacity Projects
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to increase the number, quality, and usefulness of Mid-term Evaluations (MTEs) in operations. The specific objectives are: (i) close implementation gaps in MTEs for active ICS projects; and (ii) reduce heterogeneity in MTEs quality by promoting shared standards and best practices.

oper_nm: Operations Day
objtv: Operations Day is designed to support portfolio results by engraining a culture of impact orientation and continuous learning among Executing Agencies of projects financed by the IDB. It will drive improvements by generating knowledge products, promoting cross-project learning, and reinforcing a results-driven mindset. This initiative has 2 main objectives: 1) Strengthen a Culture of Effectiveness: Promote an impact-forward approach that ensures projects are designed, executed, and evaluated with a robust impact orientation and 2) Facilitate Cross-Project Learning: Establish a systematic process to capture, analyze, and share operational insights, lessons learned (or lessons not learned), and best practices. This objective builds a consolidated knowledge base that enables continuous operational progress and reinforces good practices in project execution.

oper_nm: From Selection to Delivery: Enhancing Effectiveness in Innovation and Entrepreneurship Projects
objtv: To strengthen portfolio effectiveness by improving firm selection and output delivery practices in innovation and entrepreneurship projects in the Latin America and Caribbean (LAC) region. The specific objectives are: (i) to document and disseminate good practices in firm selection, building on international and regional evidence; (ii) to develop practical tools and offer expert support to executing agencies to improve their selection mechanisms; (iii) to map operational best practices in output delivery and identify common challenges; (iv) to produce guidance materials and learning events to build agency capacity in project implementation.

oper_nm: Building Information Modeling (BIM) Strategy Implementation in Costa Rica, Panamá, Perú and Colombia.
objtv: The Technical Cooperation (TC) has the objective of supporting the implementation of Building Information Modeling (BIM) in Costa Rica, Panamá, Perú and Colombia. BIM is a set of methodologies, technologies, processes, and strategies that enable the various actors to collaboratively plan, design, build, operate, and maintain a project (building or infrastructure) in a virtual space.

oper_nm: Deep dive into change theory and effectiveness
objtv: The overall objective of the TC is to improve the effectiveness performance of the Bank's Water and Sanitation Division (INE/WSA) portfolio. The specific objectives are: (i) to increase the knowledge of change theory and effectiveness among INE/WSA specialists; and (ii) to increase the knowledge of change theory and effectiveness among counterpart specialists.

oper_nm: Building Health Legos for Effectiveness
objtv: The objective of the Technical Cooperation (TC) is to contribute to improved development effectiveness of health projects in all stages of project lifecycle through: (i) Enhanced quality of health projects during preparation; (ii) strengthening monitoring and evaluation during execution; (iii) and supporting project closure activities to enhance project effectiveness of health operations.

oper_nm: Support for improving the effectiveness of transport projects through results-based management and knowledge dissemination
objtv:
The general objective is to improve the effectiveness of loan operations in the transport division financed by the IDB in Latin America and the Caribbean through results-based management and knowledge-informed decision-making.
Specific objectives are: (i) improving project performance and achievement of results by implementing portfolio management mechanisms at key stages—start, execution, and closure—for 100% of the active portfolio; (ii) enhancing the timely achievement of results through the standardization and implementation of a mechanism to process modifications, transfers, and cancellations; (iii) strengthening operational knowledge management through the systematization of lessons learned and the updating of data and information from completed operations; and (iv) strengthening institutional capacity through targeted workshops and interactive knowledge exchange sessions with executing agencies and project teams.

oper_nm: Sustainability and Innovation for Rural Water and Sanitation Services in Latin-American and the Caribbean
objtv: To contribute to the sustainable and resilient improvement of rural water and sanitation services in Latin America and the Caribbean through the development, piloting, and systematization of differentiated approaches, operational tools, and institutional strengthening processes that support countries in consolidating a solid sectoral ecosystem, articulating effective public policies, regulatory frameworks, and management instruments adapted to the rural context and focusing on vulnerable populations.

oper_nm: EXPLEARN Facility: Extension of the School Day - Exchange Visit Brazil
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to facilitate knowledge exchange and collaboration among government representatives, IDB specialists, and implementing partners from countries with Technical Cooperation (TC) projects funded by the EXPLEARN Facility, as well as other education systems interested in Extended School Day (ESD) policies.

oper_nm: Efficiency and Macro-Fiscal Impact Analysis for Strengthening Government Expenditure Framework
subsector_nm: FISCAL POLICY FOR SUSTAINABILITY AND GROWTH
objtv: LAC countries face persistent challenges in budget execution, resource allocation, and expenditure oversight, which result in inefficiencies that undermine economic growth and fiscal discipline. The primary objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to equip LAC governments with a structured framework for enhancing government expenditure efficiency and assessing its macroeconomic impacts.

oper_nm: Strengthening Conservation Trust Funds (CTF) in Latin America and Caribbean (LAC), and Amazonia, to support conservation financial mechanisms.
objtv: Strengthen the institutional capacity of new and existing RedLAC members –with particular activities in support of Amazonian Conservation Trust Fund (CTF) – in order to ensure an adequate governance structure for the use of the conservation resource by: (1) strengthening RedLAC's institutional capacity by supporting the Executive Secretariat in the management of the network; (2) assessing RedLAC members' capacity against the Practice Standards for CTFs ; and supporting the implementation of the recommendations for improvement derived from the assessments; as well as (3) providing capacity building activities for RedLAC members to meet international standard practices that allows them to implement innovative finance mechanisms.

oper_nm: Energizing Impact: Driving Results in LAC's Energy Sector through Enhancing the Development Effectiveness of ENE's Portfolio
subsector_nm: ENERGY INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING AND CAPACITY BUILDING
objtv: The general objective is to enhance the development effectiveness of ENE's portfolio by improving the evaluability of results and optimizing the execution of operations throughout their lifecycle. The specific objectives are: (i) improve evaluability of operations during design; (ii) develop and implement timely diagnostic mechanisms for effectiveness to improve the achievement of development results; (iii) promote the dissemination of knowledge and enhance the skills and knowledge of those involved in the operations life cycle.

oper_nm: Measuring the Impact of the Social Infrastructure Group on IDB-Financed Projects
objtv: The Technical Cooperation (TC) seeks to: (i) identify and quantify the added value that the Social Infrastructure Group (GIS) brings to the execution and quality of social infrastructure projects financed by the Inter-American Development Bank (IDB); and (ii) identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness of investment in social infrastructure.

oper_nm: Too Good to Waste II: Transforming wastewater into a low methane and circular economy opportunity in LAC
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to support the beneficiary countries in the transformation of wastewater sludge and waste management practices by circular economy adoption, enhanced climate resilience and methane emissions.

oper_nm: Assessments and diagnostics for leveraging National Fiduciary Systems effectively
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to support borrowing member countries in enhancing the effectiveness, efficiency, and transparency of public resource management by leveraging national fiduciary systems. This objective will be pursued through: 1) Conducting assessments and diagnostics to evaluate the development and performance of national fiduciary systems, ensuring the availability of updated and relevant information. 2) Identifying international and regional best practices through technical studies, research, and performance analysis; and 3) Supporting the development of strategic action plans that enable countries to plan, prioritize, and build technical capacity for sustained improvements in fiduciary management.

oper_nm: Enhancing the Use of Fiduciary Country Systems through International Standards and Best Practices
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) aims to improve the effectiveness, reliability, and sustainability of national fiduciary systems in order to enable and optimize their use in IDB-financed operations, by aligning them with international standards and best practices. This will be achieved through: 1) Support the adoption and integration of international standards, as well as the progressive reduction of gaps with respect to recognized best practices. 2) Promoting knowledge exchange and collaboration among governments in the region, enabling countries to share successful experiences and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement in fiduciary governance and public resource management.

oper_nm: Cost variation in Water and Sanitation Division (INE/WSA) projects and their impact on effectiveness.
objtv: The overall objective of this technical cooperation (TC) is to improve the portfolio effectiveness performance of the Bank's Water and Sanitation Division (INE/WSA) by identifying the causes of project cost overruns and their impact on operational results, and by developing knowledge to inform the design and implementation of new projects in the Division. The specific objectives are: (i) to increase knowledge of the causes of cost overruns in water, sanitation, urban drainage, and solid waste infrastructure projects; (ii) to systematize lessons learned and good practices; (iii) to identify practical solutions (for design and execution) by type of instrument, subsector, and subregion that can improve the portfolio effectiveness performance.

oper_nm: Sustainable data to assess the effectiveness of IDB operations in the health sector
objtv: The objective of this TC is to build sustainable data products to inform, monitor and evaluate IDB operations in the health sector by leveraging, harmonizing and generating a better understanding of existing administrative health data. It has three specific objectives. First, expand prior methodological and analytical work on health systems performance measures using administrative data on hospital discharges and vital registries to develop regional data with harmonized indicators. Second, develop a systematic approach to create a set of high-frequency intermediate indicators along the causal chain to influence health on persons with chronic conditions to better monitor, evaluate and adapt projects related to NCDs in countries with the most extensive sets of administrative records. Third, develop and conduct a medical record review of hospital discharges to provide a more comprehensive understanding of key metrics based on hospital data such as intra-hospital mortality or preventable hospitalizations for conditions sensitive to primary health care.

oper_nm: Sustainable Artisanal Fisheries and Bio-businesses for Food Security and Market Access in the Peru-Colombia Border Integration Zone
objtv: To strengthen fisheries management, the local economy, and food security in communities of the Putumayo River Basin. The specific objectives are as follows: (1) to reinforce governance and sustainable management of artisanal fisheries; (2) to promote nature-positive enterprises across the fisheries value chain; and (3) to advance initiatives that improve food security.

oper_nm: Housing and Urban Development (HUD) Impact Toolkit
objtv: Enhance the performance and effectiveness of HUD operations to increase the Bank's development impact in housing and urban development in Latin America and the Caribbean.

oper_nm: Enhancing development effectiveness of citizen security projects
objtv: Generate and disseminate knowledge that contributes to strengthening causal logic and evaluation frameworks in public safety projects.

oper_nm: Silver Ventures: Catalyzing the Ecosystem of the Silver Economy in LAC
objtv: The project's objective is to contribute to the strengthening of startups that offer innovative solutions for and by older adults, and to the development of the silver economy ecosystem in LAC.

oper_nm: Civil Society Participation and Inclusion in the Sustainable Development of Amazonia
objtv: The objective of this CT is to identify solutions for the conservation, bioeconomy, and sustainable development of Amazonia based on the knowledge of indigenous peoples, Afro-descendants, traditional communities, and other key civil society stakeholders, and aligned with the Amazon Bioeconomy Fund and the Amazonia Forever Program. The specific objectives are the participatory co-creation of effective solutions for conservation, bioeconomy, and sustainable development; and the strategic dissemination of this knowledge in international decision-making forums such as COP30 or similar.

oper_nm: Skills Strategy for the Caribbean
objtv: Develop and disseminate, jointly with the OCDE, a comprehensive regional skills strategy that offers a clear path to higher productivity, broader social inclusion, and sustainable growth for the Caribbean countries. This strategy will help governments and stakeholders develop a common, data-driven diagnosis of their skills challenges, identify priority reforms, and design collaborative mechanisms that support inclusive recovery, digital and green transitions, and long-term resilience.

oper_nm: Maximizing Impact: Using AI for Evaluating Development Effectiveness of IDB Operations and Designing
objtv: The objective of this project is to build an internal capacity that will support IDB staff in designing and interpreting synthetic RCTs and allowing operational and knowledge teams to use synthetic RCTs to refine surveys instruments, test hypotheses, and prioritize interventions for full-scale evaluation.

oper_nm: Sustainable and Innovative Rural Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (SIRWASH) phase II. Knowledge dissemination and coordination
objtv: To strengthen knowledge management and strategic communication for the rural WASH sector in Latin America and the Caribbean, by generating, organizing, and disseminating lessons learnt and tools from the SIRWASH initiative, while ensuring effective program coordination and sustained dialogue with participating countries and partners. The TC will support the development of communication strategies, knowledge products, and regional recommendations, as well as the operational implementation and alignment of activities through a dedicated coordination mechanism.

oper_nm: Sustainable and Innovative Rural Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (SIRWASH) phase II. Sustainability and enhancement of rural wash governance and south south cooperation in LAC
objtv: The objective of the present TC is to consolidate and strengthen rural water and sanitation governance and service sustainability at the regional level, with a particular focus on SIRWASH countries, by enhancing institutional capacities, fostering knowledge exchange, and supporting the adoption of normative instruments, monitoring systems, and planning tools tailored to rural contexts. The operation will promote collaboration among sector stakeholders regionally and globally, and advance regulatory frameworks and sustainability strategies with a focus on gender, resilience, and South-South cooperation.

oper_nm: Project STAR - STAR Economic Accelerator (SEA)
objtv: The project's theory of change posits that by equipping unattached youth with targeted readiness support, business training, and digital skills transfer, we can facilitate economic inclusion and integration of this segment of the labor force into the productive economy.

oper_nm: Leo Leo from Wumbox – impact of an Edtech technology in initial literacy
objtv: The objective of the TC is to evaluate the impact of the Leo Leo platform and the Leo Test on the development of literacy skills in early childhood students (5 to 7 years old) in the state of Nuevo León (MX) and Chile.

oper_nm: Support for Improving Transport Project Effectiveness through Strategic Insights from Procurement and Execution
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation is to contribute to improving the effectiveness of the IDB's transportation operations by systematizing and analyzing existing operational knowledge on public works bidding and contract execution processes. To this end, this proposal focuses on: (i) the organization and analysis of relevant information to strengthen the quality, traceability, and utilization of data on bids and contracts; and (ii) strengthening technical capacities within the Bank and among its national counterparts to implement best practices and promote continuous improvement in contract management.

oper_nm: Overcoming Data Barriers and Building Impact Evaluation Capacity in Public Development Banks
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to provide client support to strengthen the capacities of Public Development Banks (PDBs) in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) to systematically collect, manage, and analyze high-quality data on their lending portfolios and final beneficiaries. Strengthening these data and monitoring capabilities will allow PDBs to track loan performance, measure development outcomes, and design operations based on evidence. The specific objectives of the TC are: (i) diagnose data collection barriers among PDBs, (ii) identify best replicable practices in credit program monitoring and evaluation (M&E) data collection, (iii) implement a pilot to address data barriers based on best practices, (iv) assess counterpart data readiness, and (v) support PDBs in building skills for impact evaluation (IE) design.

oper_nm: Strategic Data on Returned Migrants in Central America
objtv: This Technical Cooperation (TC) will generate strategic data to advance the understanding of the socioeconomic reintegration of returned migrants. The TC will: i) Design of a multi-topic questionnaire covering employment, use and quality of public services, access to education and training, health status (Ii) Implement a longitudinal panel survey of returned migrants and their households, conducted over time to understand the reintegration trajectories. (ii) Data analysis: generate a peer-reviewed working paper presenting key findings and recommendations and a policy brief summarizing the key implications for reintegration of migrants.

oper_nm: The Impact of IDB's Policy-Based Loans on Energy Sector Transformation in Latin America and the Caribbean
subsector_nm: ENERGY INSTITUTIONAL STRENGTHENING AND CAPACITY BUILDING
objtv: This TC seeks to assess the extent to which IDB's Policy-Based Loans (PBLs) have contributed to transformative changes in the energy sectors of Latin America and the Caribbean and identify which policy reform elements have been most effective in improving sector performance across four key result areas. In particular, this TC aims to: (ii) evaluate how PBLs have influenced renewable energy adoption, emissions intensity, and climate resilience, identifying which policy measures most effectively advanced the energy transition; (ii) assess to what extent reforms have improved electricity access, enhanced affordability, and reduced energy poverty; (iii) determine the impact on system reliability, generation and transmission capacity, and financial sustainability (e.g., cost recovery, levelized costs); and (iv) analyze how effectively PBLs have attracted private investment and increased private market participation, identifying which reforms were most successful in opening the sector.

oper_nm: Quality and secure data: a cybersecurity strategy for National Statistical Offices
objtv: The main objective of this TC is to promote the adoption of a cybersecurity strategy tailored to the specific characteristics of National Statistical Offices (NSOs) in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). TC specific goals include: (i) assessing the current state of cybersecurity in NSOs (protocols established, existing infrastructure, among other aspects) to identifying the main risks, challenges, and obstacles faced by participating NSOs in ensuring their cybersecurity; (ii) acquiring South Korea's advanced legal frameworks and technologies for data security and disseminate them to Latin American countries; and, (iii) designing a regional cybersecurity strategy and roadmaps aligned with the specificities of the NSOs participating in the project, covering the entire data production process (collection, transmission, analysis, and dissemination).

oper_nm: Predicting and Explaining Development Effectiveness
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to develop predictive and causal inference models to understand and enhance the effectiveness of IDB operations. The specific objectives are: (i) to build a predictive system capable of dynamically identifying operations with a high likelihood of ineffectiveness at closure, as measured by PCRs and OVE validations, and (ii) to evaluate the causal impact of key instruments from the Development Effectiveness Framework (DEF)—specifically, the Development Effectiveness Matrix (DEM) and the Progress Monitoring Report (PMR)—on project performance. This initiative build upon previous analytical work, including studies conducted by OVE (2024), Alvarez et al (2021), and Corral et al (2022).

oper_nm: Improve the Bank's ability to report results
objtv: The proposal will strengthen the Bank's capacity to report on the results of its interventions and improve project effectiveness measurements. The project will utilize new technological tools to streamline and expand these processes and will be implemented as a pilot in active operations in the CAN portfolio.

oper_nm: Catalyzing LAC Innovation and Venture Capital through a Global Ecosystem Platform
objtv: The objective of this project is to strengthen Latin America and the Caribbean's entrepreneurial ecosystem by enhancing the capabilities, coordination, and global connectedness of key ecosystem actors—including Entrepreneur Support Organizations (ESOs), Venture Capital Funds, Family Offices, and Angel Investors.

oper_nm: Performance Evaluation of the Korean Trust Funds
objtv: This Technical Cooperation seeks to enhance the performance evaluation of the Korean Trust Funds (KTFs) by supporting the development of a framework, strengthening methodologies, and systematizing processes. Through these efforts, the TC aims to improve the effectiveness of KTF-financed projects, optimize resource allocation, and reinforce the long-term strategic partnership between Korea and the Inter-American Development Bank.

oper_nm: One Safe Caribbean for Vulnerable Populations I
objtv: The objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to enhance the capacity of member states within the Caribbean to effectively prevent violence against sub-populations that are at highest risk of interpersonal victimization: vulnerable families, women and young men. The specific objectives of this TC are to: (i) cultivate regional models that improve family resilience to violence; (ii) Enhance capacity for coordinated, violence prevention interventions targeting at-risk youth; and (ii) strengthen capabilities for data-driven, integrated service delivery to survivors of domestic and sexual violence across the region.

oper_nm: South Connection Regional Digital Infrastructure Plan
objtv: The general objective of this Technical Cooperation (TC) is to improve regional digital integration in South America by reducing gaps in access, quality, and resilience of digital infrastructure, thereby contributing to the strengthening of universal and meaningful connectivity. To achieve this, the proposal focuses on: (i) developing a regional roadmap to 2030 to guide joint investments in digital infrastructure and promote technical and regulatory coordination among beneficiary countries; (ii) identifying and overcoming barriers that limit the expansion of connectivity and interoperability, while strengthening the resilience of regional networks; and (iii) promoting equitable access to high-quality digital services through the integration of harmonized regulatory frameworks, the development of digital skills, and cooperation among governments, the private sector, and civil society.

oper_nm: Home Is Where the Hurt Is: A Regional Framework for Stemming Disaster Losses in Caribbean Housing
objtv: Develop a regional framework to strengthen the resilience of existing housing across Caribbean countries, addressing the shared vulnerability of aging housing stock to hurricanes and other climatic events. By producing standardized data, a regional policy and operational manual, and joint training, the initiative will lower compliance costs and improve access to climate adaptation finance

oper_nm: Strengthening Regional Energy Planning to Generate Greater Impact and Scale
objtv: This project will support long-term planning, cross-border interconnections, and the adoption of innovative low-carbon technologies by producing agreed roadmaps, regulatory frameworks, and investment-ready studies to unlock financing for strategic projects.

oper_nm: Rules of Origin Smart Calculator
subsector_nm: TRADE AND INVESTMENT AGREEMENTS AND REGULATIONS
objtv: This project will design and implement a Rules of Origin (RoO) Smart Calculator to help firms (especially SMEs) navigate the complex requirements of multiple preferential trade agreements. By delivering a multi-country calculator with agreed governance and technical standards, the initiative will simplify compliance, reduce costs, and expand the effective use of trade preferences.

oper_nm: Proposed Legal and Governance Framework for the Creation of the ACRS and the Development of an IT Tool for the Joint Evaluation of Medicines and Vaccines for SICA Member States
objtv: This project will establish the Central American Sanitary Regulation Agency to harmonize regulatory frameworks and strengthen access to safe, effective, and high-quality medicines and medical technologies. By delivering a regional governance model, standardized guidelines, and a digital tool for joint evaluation, the initiative will reduce duplication, accelerate approval processes, and improve regulatory oversight across countries.

oper_nm: Regional Hub for Digital Systems & AI in LAC: Scalable Solutions for Effective Anti-Money Laundering
objtv: This project will establish a Regional Hub for Digital Systems and AI to strengthen Financial Inteligence Units (FIUs) in Latin America and the Caribbean. By delivering open-source platforms for beneficial ownership and cryptoasset analysis, advanced AI models trained on regional typologies, and secure protocols for cross-border information exchange, it will generate economies of scale and shared tools for the region.

oper_nm: Minerals as leverage for growth in the Andean Region: Dashboard for investment needs
subsector_nm: NEW OIL AND GAS AND EXTRACTIVE INDUSTRIES
objtv: This project will produce a Regional Roadmap to accelerate the Andean critical minerals value chain and complementary sectors by aligning cross-border infrastructure, regulatory coordination, and trade facilitation. It will enable coordinated, cross-border investment prioritization and regulatory convergence under the South Connection framework. By delivering an agreed public roadmap (grounded in geospatial and economic analytics) and a StoryMap platform consolidating value-chain diagnostics, regulatory proposals, and prioritized corridors, ports, rail, energy, and digital links, it will create a shared decision tool for policy and investment.

oper_nm: TransportRating: Regional Benchmark for the Efficient Management of Transport Assets and Services
subsector_nm: PUBLIC TRANSPORT (BUS / TRAIN / CABLE). INFRASTRUCTURE AND EQUIPMENT
